Turn your Android phone into an on-the-go security command center for your hardware keys. Type ultra-secure passwords on any computer without touching the keyboard. Program OpenPGP identities on the fly. Wipe secrets instantly.
 Picture this: you are sitting at a bustling coffee shop, library, or airport gate with surveillance cameras overhead and people nearby. You need to log into a 32-character master password, your BitLocker/LUKS encrypted drive, a work laptop, or a remote server. Typing it out invites shoulder surfers, camera recording, and hardware keyloggers. Leaving that password permanently stored on your physical security key means losing your keychain compromises your account.
 With sub rosa , you get the best of both worlds: tap your NFC security key (or plug via USB) to your Android phone to load the password or OpenPGP key you need right now . Plug the key into any PC, Mac, server, or kiosk. Touch the gold contact. The hardware key acts as a standard USB keyboard (HID) and types your long, complex password in milliseconds. Done with your session? Tap the key to your phone again to erase it. If you lose your physical key on the train, it holds zero data .

 Picture this: you need to handle high-stakes digital tasks on the move. izzyondroid:pan.alexander.tordnscrypt.name: InviZible Pro **BETA**
izzyondroid:pan.alexander.tordnscrypt.summary: Combine the strengths of Tor, DNSCrypt and I2P for security and anonymity
izzyondroid:pan.alexander.tordnscrypt.description:
Preserves privacy, prevents tracking, and provides access to restricted and hidden online content. 
 InviZible Pro combines the strengths of Tor, DNSCrypt, and Purple I2P to provide a comprehensive solution for online privacy, security, and anonymity.
 Tor is responsible for privacy and anonymity. It acts like an unlimited free VPN proxy, but does so in the most secure way possible. Tor uses military-grade encryption and routes your internet traffic through a network of volunteer-run proxy servers. This helps protect your identity and location by hiding your IP address. It allows you to browse the internet anonymously, access websites that are otherwise restricted, and communicate privately. Tor also allows access to websites hosted on the Tor network, known as "onion services" or dark web, which are not accessible through regular browsers.
 DNSCrypt is responsible for security. Every phone uses DNS (Domain Name System) when visiting online resources. But this traffic is usually not encrypted and can be intercepted and spoofed by third parties. DNSCrypt ensures that your DNS traffic is encrypted and secure. It prevents unauthorized access and tampering of your DNS queries, providing an additional layer of protection against surveillance and data interception.
 I2P (Invisible Internet Project) provides secure and anonymous access to internal I2P websites, chat forums and other services that are not available through regular browsers. You may know it as the deep web. It works by routing your internet traffic through a network of volunteer-run proxy servers, allowing you to hide your identity and location. I2P provides a secure and private online environment, making it a great option for those who value anonymity and privacy.
 Firewall is a security feature that helps protect your device from unauthorized access and potential threats. It acts as a filter for incoming and outgoing network traffic, allowing you to control which apps can access the internet. By setting up firewall rules, you can choose to block or allow internet connection for individual apps. This helps enhance your privacy and security by preventing unauthorized communication and protecting your data while using your phone.
 InviZible Pro can utilize root access, if available on your device, or use a local VPN to deliver internet traffic directly to the Tor, DNSCrypt, and I2P networks.
 Core Features: ✔ Tor Network - Achieve full anonymity, bypass censorship, and access .onion sites securely ✔ DNSCrypt - Encrypt DNS queries to prevent ISP monitoring and manipulation ✔ I2P (Invisible Internet Project) - Secure and private decentralized networking ✔ Advanced Firewall - Restrict internet access per app and block unauthorized connections ✔ No Root Access Required - Works seamlessly on all devices without modifications ✔ Maintain complete privacy without a paid VPN - Stay anonymous for free ✔ Stealth Mode - Evade Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) and regional restrictions ✔ Free & Open Source - No ads, no tracking, no compromises

 Features 
 Quick Settings Tile : Toggle Private DNS on/off directly from the Quick Settings panel.
 Custom DNS Providers : Define one or more preferred hostnames (e.g., dns.nextdns.io) and seamlessly switch between them.
 Wi-Fi Filtering : Automatically disable Private DNS when connected to specific Wi-Fi networks.
 Automatic Blocking : Automatically blacklists the current Wi-Fi SSID when Private DNS causes connectivity issues.
 VPN Override : Automatically enforce a specific DNS hostname or disable Private DNS entirely whenever a VPN is active on your device.
 Backup & Restore : Export and import your configuration via password-encrypted files.
 Dynamic Tile Labeling : Rename the Quick Settings tile.
 Hide App Icon : Keep your home screen clean while maintaining access via the Quick Settings tile.
 Privacy & Permissions 
 No tracking, no ads, and no data collection.
 Location permissions are optional, and only used to identify Wi-Fi network names for the SSID Filter feature. They are never used to track your physical location.

fdroid:com.gpgapp.name: GPG Key Manager
fdroid:com.gpgapp.description:
GPG Key Manager is a complete OpenPGP / GPG toolkit for Android, designed for everyone who cares about privacy and secure communication. Everything runs entirely on your device — no accounts, no servers, no internet connection required.
EASY KEY MANAGEMENT
Create strong PGP key pairs in seconds. Choose the modern Ed25519 (sign) + X25519 (encrypt) combination for fast, short and secure keys, or stick with classic RSA keys up to 4096 bits for maximum compatibility. Manage all your keys in one place: list, view, import and export public and private keys. Import a key from a file — armored or the binary form written by GnuPG — or paste it directly, and save an export straight to a file. Open .asc, .pgp and .gpg files from any app: keys go through a confirmation before they are imported, and encrypted messages open in the Decrypt screen.
ENCRYPT AND DECRYPT MESSAGES
Encrypt any text with a recipient's public key and only they — using their private key — can read it. Decrypt incoming messages with your own private key, protected by your passphrase. Text encryption uses AES-256 with a fresh session key, and each message carries an integrity check.
SIGN AND VERIFY
Prove authorship and protect against tampering by signing text with your private key. Verify signatures with the corresponding public key to confirm that a message really came from its sender.
FULLY OFFLINE AND PRIVATE
All cryptographic operations are performed locally using the open-source Bouncy Castle library. Your private keys are stored encrypted at rest with AES-256 inside the app's private storage, and your passphrase is never saved. The app requests no permissions and makes no network calls — your secrets never leave your phone.
BEAUTIFUL AND ACCESSIBLE
A modern Material 3 interface with light and dark themes and Android 12+ Dynamic Color support. Text fields, dialogs and every action are designed to be simple and intuitive, and the whole app is available in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese and Thai.
F-DROID FRIENDLY
The app is built to meet F-Droid's strict reproducibility guidelines, so you can install and build it from source with confidence.
Requirements: Android 8.0 (API 26) or higher.

fdroid:com.stoutner.privacybrowser.stand.name: Privacy Browser
fdroid:com.stoutner.privacybrowser.stand.summary: A web browser that respects your privacy.
fdroid:com.stoutner.privacybrowser.stand.description:
The only way to prevent data from being abused is to prevent it from being collected in the first place. Privacy Browser has two primary goals.
1. Minimize the data that is sent to the internet.
2. Minimize the data that is stored on the device.
Most browsers silently give websites massive amounts of information that allows them to track you and compromise your privacy. Websites and ad networks use technologies like JavaScript, cookies, DOM storage, user agents, and many other things to uniquely identify each user and track them between visits and across the web.
In contrast, privacy sensitive features are disabled by default in Privacy Browser. If one of these technologies is required for a website to function correctly, the user may choose to turn it on for just that visit. Or, they can use domain settings to automatically turn on certain features when entering a specific website and turn them off again when leaving.
Privacy Browser currently uses Android’s built-in WebView to render web pages. As such, it works best when the latest version of WebView is installed (see https://www.stoutner.com/privacy-browser/common-settings/webview/). In the 4.x series, Privacy Browser will switch to a forked version of Android’s WebView called Privacy WebView that will allow for advanced privacy features.
Features:
• Integrated EasyList ad blocking.
• Tor Orbot proxy support.
• SSL certificate pinning.
• Import/export of settings and bookmarks.

fdroid:fr.framagit.jeromeo.etagere.name: Étagère
fdroid:fr.framagit.jeromeo.etagere.summary: Browse a Calibre library on your Nextcloud and download EPUBs
fdroid:fr.framagit.jeromeo.etagere.description:
Étagère browses a Calibre library stored on your own Nextcloud, shows the full record for every book, and downloads the files. It does not read books — that is your reading app's job, and you already have one you like.
 What it does 
* Signs in to Nextcloud through the browser, using a revocable app password
* Reads the Calibre catalogue and keeps it available offline
* Covers, authors, series, ratings, publisher, languages, tags, identifiers, descriptions
* Search, sort and filter by tag, author or series
* Downloads EPUB and any other format Calibre holds, in the background
* Serves the library to an e-reader over Wi-Fi, for devices that can download from a web page
 What it does not do 
* No reader built in
* Never writes to your server — the library is read-only
* No account, no telemetry, no advertising
 How it works 
A Calibre library is a folder with a metadata.db catalogue and one subfolder per book. Étagère finds that file over WebDAV, downloads it once, and reads it locally. Covers and book files are fetched on demand, never in bulk. The catalogue is only re-downloaded when it has actually changed, so the app stays usable offline.
 Sharing with an e-reader 
Many e-readers can download a file from a web page but cannot read OPDS catalogues. Étagère turns the phone into a small web server on your local network, with pages designed for e-ink: no JavaScript, no thumbnails in lists, pure black on white, large tap targets. A single book can also be offered under a short address that is easy to type on an e-ink keyboard.
Traffic on that local server is unencrypted, since e-reader browsers rarely cope with anything else. Use it on a network you trust.
 Requirements 
A Nextcloud account and a Calibre library stored on it. Étagère does not create libraries; use Calibre on a computer for that.
Free software under the GNU GPL v3.

THE ONE RULE
In Strict mode, leave the app or lock the screen before the round ends, and the round is lost, instantly. That's the whole trick: Roundi doesn't block anything, it just makes leaving cost something. Too strict? Allow locking, so the round continues on the lock screen, or switch to Lenient mode.
MADE FOR YOUR RITUALS

• Study — a 50-minute block with no pings
• Work — deep work sessions up to 2 hours
• Train — planks, dead hangs, rest between sets

POMODORO, IN SEQUENCE
A tag can hold rounds and breaks: four 25-minute rounds with 5-minute breaks, say. Roundi runs the whole sequence, fills a ring through each break and shows where you are.
REMINDED, NOT NAGGED

SAY IT, DON'T TAP IT

Pick one for a tag, or for rounds started from the dial, or play a file of your own. Set the volume from the speaker icon or on the running round, and tap the sound's name to mute it.
EVERY ROUND, KEPT
Finished rounds land as dots on your calendar, with your daily total and streak. Time becomes habit; habit becomes you. Did a round end by mistake while you kept going? Change its result; it's marked as edited.
YOUR ROUNDS, AS A REPORT

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Every day displays auspicious (Do) and inauspicious (Avoid) activities drawn from the traditional Chinese almanac. Plan important life events — weddings, moving day, business openings — the cultural way.
-- 24 SOLAR TERMS
Discover the 24 solar terms of the Chinese agricultural calendar, from Qingming to Winter Solstice. Each term includes its historical background, poetic meaning, and associated customs.
-- COUNTDOWN TIMER
Create personal countdowns for birthdays, anniversaries, travel, graduations, or any milestone that matters. An overview card shows all your upcoming events at a glance.
-- HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Add Midday Calendar widgets to your home screen in small, medium, or large size. See today's date, lunar date, and solar term without opening the app. Full monthly calendar widget also available.
-- MAC SUPPORT
Built with Mac Catalyst — enjoy the full Midday Calendar experience natively on your Mac.
-- 4 LANGUAGES
English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean — the interface adapts automatically to your device language.
-- PRIVACY FIRST
No account required. No ads. No data collection. Everything stays on your device.
Download Midday Calendar and rediscover time through both ancient wisdom and modern design.

Actual Budget is a fast, privacy-focused finance app based on the Envelope Budgeting method.
 It prioritizes user control, allowing you to manage your data independently with multi-device sync
 and optional end-to-end encryption. The app emphasizes user involvement over automation, offering
 quick, intuitive tools while keeping you in charge of your financial decisions.
 Designed for speed, Actual Budget has a streamlined interface that minimizes distractions, making
 it easy to navigate your finances. It operates locally, ensuring functionality without a network
 connection while syncing data across devices. This local-first approach also enhances privacy through
 end-to-end encryption.
 The budgeting system is grounded in real income, helping you track spending and savings accurately.
 The app simplifies managing transactions with a minimal, efficient interface, supporting features
 like split transactions and transfers. Additionally, Actual Budget offers customizable reports
 alongside default net worth and cash flow reports, enabling users to analyze your finances in a
 way that suits you.

flathub:com.adilhanney.no_more_backgroun.name: No More Background
flathub:com.adilhanney.no_more_backgroun.description:
A tool to manage which Android™ apps can run in the background using adb, Shizuku, or root.
 You probably don't need some random takeaway app doing anything in the background. And maybe you don't want that mobile game wasting your data when you're not using it.
 NoMoreBackground gives you a list of your apps and lets you choose which of them you want having background permissions, all on one screen, to help you get the most out of your battery.
 And the best part? When you're done, you can close NoMoreBackground and move on with your life. No need to "optimize" every day like some other tools: set and forget!
 Tip: Some apps may still run in the background even if you turn them off here.
If you use an app very infrequently, right click it and archive it. The app itself will be uninstalled but its data will remain. This means when you next open it, it'll be reinstalled and you'll still be logged in.
 Android is a trademark of Google LLC.

flathub:info.cinfinity.goldstein.name: Goldstein
flathub:info.cinfinity.goldstein.description:
Goldstein is a social media server with multiple client programs for handing different functions. It's modelled on IRC, but stores messages, on both the server and client. It aims to eventually replicate the basic functionality of Facebook, YouTube, Twitter, etc, but with the freedom of running one's own server.
 However, it's main purpose is to reliably preserve messages and files. If a server goes down (or is taken down) all messages and user information still function as normal in offline mode. This provides the user with a complete record of every message she has downloaded, across multiple servers. This is the origin of the name: from the propaganda character of Goldstein in George Orwell's Nineteen Eighty-Four, who was demonised for wanting to accurately preserve history.

fedora-packages:edac-utils/edac-ctl.name: edac-ctl
fedora-packages:edac-utils/edac-ctl.summary: Script to load EDAC driver and register DIMM labels
fedora-packages:edac-utils/edac-ctl.description: EDAC (Error Detection and Correction) is a set of Linux kernel modules that handle reporting of hardware-related errors. Currently these modules mainly handle detection of ECC memory errors for many x86 and x86-64 chipsets and PCI bus parity errors. The edac-utils project currently has three components: libedac, edac-util, and edac-ctl. The libedac library presents a standard API for reading EDAC error counts and other information from sysfs, and edac-util uses this API to generate standard reports from the commandline. The edac-ctl utility is a perl script which uses config files to load the appropriate EDAC driver for a given chipset and register motherboard DIMM labels if they are configured. An init script is also provided which uses edac-ctl to initialize EDAC at system startup. This package provides the edac-ctl script and the edac service.

fedora-packages:hivex/hivex.description: Hive files are the undocumented binary files that Windows uses to store the Windows Registry on disk. 'hivexregedit' (in perl-hivex) lets you export and merge to the textual regedit format. 'hivexml' can be used to convert a hive file to a more useful XML format. In order to get access to the hive files themselves, you can copy them from a Windows machine. They are usually found in %systemroot%\system32\config. For virtual machines we recommend using libguestfs or guestfish to copy out these files. libguestfs also provides a useful high-level tool called 'virt-win-reg' (based on hivex technology) which can be used to query specific registry keys in an existing Windows VM. For OCaml bindings, see 'ocaml-hivex-devel'. For Perl bindings, see 'perl-hivex'. For Python 3 bindings, see 'python3-hivex'. For Ruby bindings, see 'ruby-hivex'.

firefox-addons:2913552.name: YouTube Anti Translate - Official Port
firefox-addons:2913552.summary: A small extension to disable YouTube video titles/audios/descriptions autotranslation.
firefox-addons:2913552.description:
Summary 
This is the official port of the Chrome extension originally developed by zpix1 .
For raising issues or seeing the source code, visit https://github.com/zpix1/yt-anti-translate 
 Support The Firefox Developer at sponsors/namakeingo 
 Support The Chrome Creator at their donation page 
 Overview 
YouTube title translation is helpful for beginners, but once you know the language well enough to understand original titles, it quickly becomes frustrating. Even worse, there's no proper way to disable this — unless you change your YouTube country, which messes up your recommendations and trends.
This extension fixes the problem. Over 100,000 users trust it to restore YouTube the way it was meant to be.
Features:
✨ Restores original video titles and descriptions instead of auto-translated ones
🔇 Disables automatic audio translations (dubbing)
📑 Restores the original chapters of videos
📱 Supports YouTube Shorts — restores both audio and titles
📱 Also works on mobile ( m.youtube.com ) — untranslates both titles and descriptions
🔔 Fixes translations in notifications — get the real video titles back
⚙️ Works automatically — no configuration or API keys needed
🧼 Lightweight and safe — clean code, no tracking, open source
🌐 Works on homepage, trending, subscriptions, and more
💖 This is a completely free, open‑source project maintained by volunteers. If the extension has helped you, please consider supporting the original creator at https://zpix1.github.io/donate/ or the maintainer at https://github.com/sponsors/namakeingo 
GitHub page: https://github.com/zpix1/yt-anti-translate 
No more awkward or misleading title translations — get YouTube back the way it was meant to be.
Автоматический перевод заголовков на YouTube может быть полезен для новичков, но если вы уже понимаете язык, такие переводы начинают раздражать. Особенно неприятно, что отключить их нельзя — только сменой страны в настройках, что ломает рекомендации и тренды.
Это расширение решает проблему. Более 100 000 пользователей доверяют ему возвращение настоящего YouTube.
Возможности:
✨ Восстанавливает оригинальные заголовки и описания видео вместо автопереводов
🔇 Отключает автоматический перевод звука (дубляж)
📑 Восстанавливает оригинальные главы видео
📱 Поддержка YouTube Shorts — возвращает оригинальные аудио и заголовки
📱 Работает и на мобильной версии ( m.youtube.com ) — возвращает оригинальные заголовки и описания
🔔 Исправляет переводы в уведомлениях — возвращает настоящие заголовки видео
⚙️ Работает автоматически — без настроек и ключей API
🧼 Легкое и безопасное — чистый код, без слежки, с открытым исходным кодом
🌐 Работает на главной, в рекомендациях, подписках и трендах
💖 Это полностью бесплатный open‑source‑проект, поддерживаемый энтузиастами. Если расширение оказалось вам полезным, пожалуйста, поддержите оригинального автора на странице донатов https://zpix1.github.io/donate/ или мейнтейнеров на GitHub https://github.com/sponsors/namakeingo 
Страница на GitHub: https://github.com/zpix1/yt-anti-translate 
Больше никаких кривых или вводящих в заблуждение переводов — верните себе настоящий YouTube.
La traduzione automatica dei titoli su YouTube può essere utile per i principianti, ma se conosci già la lingua, queste traduzioni diventano presto fastidiose. Per aggiungere la beffa al danno, non esiste un metodo ufficiale per disattivarle — se non cambiando il paese nelle impostazioni, ma ció rovina le tue raccomandazioni e le tendenze.
Questa estensione risolve il problema. Oltre 100.000 utenti si affidano a lei per riportare YouTube com’era in origine.
Funzionalità:
✨ Ripristina i titoli e descrizioni originali dei video invece di quelli tradotti automaticamente
🔇 Disattiva la traduzione automatica dell’audio (doppiaggio)
📑 Ripristina i capitoli originali dei video
📱 Supporta YouTube Shorts — ripristina sia l’audio che i titoli
📱 Funziona anche sulla versione mobile ( m.youtube.com ) — ripristina titoli e descrizioni originali
🔔 Corregge le traduzioni nelle notifiche — riporta i veri titoli dei video
⚙️ Funziona automaticamente — senza configurazioni né chiavi API
🧼 Leggera e sicura — codice pulito, nessun tracciamento, open source
🌐 Funziona su home page, tendenze, iscrizioni e altro
💖 Questo è un progetto completamente gratuito e open‑source, mantenuto da volontari. Se l’estensione ti è stata utile, considera di supportare il creatore originale su https://zpix1.github.io/donate/ o il manutentore su https://github.com/sponsors/namakeingo 
Pagina GitHub: https://github.com/zpix1/yt-anti-translate 
Niente più traduzioni imbarazzanti o fuorvianti dei titoli — riporta YouTube a com’era stato pensato.

firefox-addons:835910.summary:
Save video from any Vine video in original format. 
1-click download any video directly from Vine.co.
Choose if you want video or just an image.
Addon uses 3rd party site (www.knowyourvine.com) for operation.
firefox-addons:835910.description:
Vine was a short-form video hosting service where users could share six-second-long looping video clips. The service was founded in June 2012, and American microblogging website Twitter acquired it in October 2012, just before its official launch. Users' videos were published through Vine's social network and can be shared on other services such as Facebook and Twitter. Vine's app can also be used to browse through videos posted by other users, along with groups of videos by theme, and trending, or popular, videos. Vine competes with other social media services such as Instagram and Mobli. Launched on January 24, 2013, by December 2015 Vine had 200 million active users. On October 27, 2016, Twitter announced it would disable uploads, but viewing and download would continue to work. On January 20, 2017, Twitter launched an Internet archive of all Vine videos, allowing people to continue watching previously filmed Vine videos.
Vine was founded by Dom Hofmann, Rus Yusupov, and Colin Kroll in June 2012. The company was acquired by Twitter in October 2012 for a reported $30 million. It originated in New York.
Vine officially launched on January 24, 2013 as a free app for iOS devices. On June 2, 2013, an Android version was released. On November 12, 2013 the application was released for Windows Phone.[10]
In a couple of months, Vine became the most used video sharing application in the market, even with low adoption of the app.[11] On April 9, 2013, Vine became the most-downloaded free app within the iOS App Store and on May 1, 2014, Vine launched the web version of the service to explore videos.
On October 14, 2014, an Xbox One version was released allowing Xbox Live members to watch the looping videos.
In July 2014, Vine updated their app with a new "loop count" meaning every time someone watches a vine, a number on top of the video will appear showing how many times it was viewed. The "loop count" also includes views from vines that are embedded onto other websites.
In August 2015, Vine introduced Vine Music, whose "Snap to Beat" feature creates perfect infinite music loops.
In June 2016, Vine announced that it was experimenting with letting users attach video clips up to 140 seconds.

firefox-addons:2910863.name: Cardmarket Companion: Pricing & Order Tools
firefox-addons:2910863.summary: Price and pack faster when you sell, never buy the same card twice when you buy. Cardmarket helper for MTG, Pokémon & more.
firefox-addons:2910863.description:
Cardmarket Companion is an unofficial browser extension (Chrome and Firefox) for Cardmarket sellers and buyers. It prefills your listing prices from live trend data, keeps you competitive against pro sellers, turns order pages into a pick-and-pack checklist, and stops you from buying the same card twice. Works with every game available on Cardmarket.
No more typing prices card by card.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💰 PRICE FASTER
• One-click price prefill from trend (1, 7 or 30 days), lowest price or average price
• Pro Mode: auto-undercut the first professional or power seller by a fixed amount or a percentage
• Price offsets per mode, plus a minimum price floor so nothing is ever listed too cheap
• Already listed a card? One click on your own offer moves it to the suggested price, without relisting
• Tick Foil, Reverse Holo or First Edition and the offer list filters itself on the spot, price guide included
• Hide the languages you never deal in: card pages open without those offers, and the suggested price follows
• Bulk listing: card images, a percentage box with undo, a "never below" floor and a quick expansion filter
• Preview panel before you list: card, condition, price and price source
📦 PACK ORDERS WITHOUT MISTAKES
• Tick off each line as you pick it; a counter shows what is left, saved per order so an interrupted pack resumes
• Works on single orders and on "Show all articles in paid shipments", every game included
• Quantities colour-coded (2-4 amber, 5+ red) so you never ship one card when two were sold
• Group an order by expansion to match how your stock is filed
• Cards below Near Mint or in an odd language are flagged for a second look
🛒 BUY SMARTER
• Never buy the same card twice: a card page tells you when you already ordered it recently, or when it is already in your basket
• Your basket flags every card you already ordered, with the order it came in
• One click in My Purchases reads your recent orders (last week, last month or last 3 months); new orders are added by themselves at checkout
• Estimated shipping cost shown on listing pages, no need to fill a basket to find the real total
• Card images instead of tiny camera icons on Offers, Products, Wants, Shopping Wizard and Orders
❤ WANTS LISTS
• Search all your wants lists at once and see which list holds a card
• Search by the card name you see or by its English name, accents and punctuation ignored
• "Show every want" puts all your lists in one table
• "Add to wants list" opens on the list you used last
⚡ WORK YOUR WAY
• Reusable comment presets (on card pages and bulk listing) and a default message signature
• Live tracker: cards listed and total value as you go
• Copy and export your card list to share with friends or teammates
• Toggle card images per page, hide social buttons, keep the layout you want
🔒 PRIVACY
Your prices, orders and wants lists stay in your browser. When the extension reads your own orders or wants lists, it does so slowly, one page at a time, so Cardmarket is never flooded. Nothing about your business is sold or shared.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Built by a Cardmarket seller, for Cardmarket sellers and buyers. Join the Discord from the extension to request features or report bugs.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Cardmarket / Sammelkartenmarkt GmbH & Co. KG.

firefox-addons:3047900.name: Dark Mode for Pinterest — Pink & Color Themes
firefox-addons:3047900.summary: Dark mode & pink themes for Pinterest: Hot Pink, Coquette, Velvet, Onyx true black, Matcha & more. Auto night mode, custom color.
firefox-addons:3047900.description:
PinDark — Dark Mode, Pink & Color Themes for Pinterest, by SortPin.com 
Give your feed a real dark mode in one click — or dress it up in pink, plum, matcha green or any color you love. Instead of crudely inverting colors like generic dark-mode tools, this extension is built on the site's own official dark palette, so every pin, board and menu looks pixel-perfect at night. A TRUE DARK MODE — NOT A COLOR INVERT
• Built on the site's own official dark palette — a real theme, not a filter
• Your photos keep their true colors — images are never inverted, dimmed or washed out
• No white flash — the theme is applied before the page paints
• Covers the interface, not just the grid: home feed, boards, pin close-ups, search, comments, profile and settings
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
NIGHT LOOKS
• Calico — the classic, balanced dark
• Onyx — pure true black, made for OLED screens
• Hot Pink — bold magenta on deep black
• Coquette — pretty in pink
• Velvet — rich, velvety plum
• Black Cherry — warm rosewood night
• Persimmon — burnt-orange glow
• Gilded — black and gold luxe
• Mocha — soft coffee brown
• Matcha — calm, gentle green
• Coastal — deep ocean blue
• Indigo — midnight blue-violet
• Aura — dreamy purple
• Graphite — soft charcoal, gentler contrast
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
DAY LOOKS & AUTO MODE
• Soft daytime faces: Bubblegum, Ballet, Strawberry Milk, Apricot, Cream, Latte, Meadow, Sky, Periwinkle, Lilac and Blush
• Auto follows your system — your night look after dark, your day look by daylight
• Timed — your night look between hours you set, like 7 pm to 7 am
• Mix & match: pair ANY night look with ANY day look
• Prefer the original by day? Keep Vanilla and the site keeps its own colors until night
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MAKE IT YOURS
• Custom color — one hue tints both faces, day and night
• Pick from a curated hue grid, or paste any #hex code
• "No tint" for a clean neutral gray
• Round or square — one tap turns every rounded card, image and button sharp, and back again
• Master switch — off means the site renders untouched, with your picks preserved
• Keyboard shortcut (Alt+Shift+P) to flip it on and off without leaving the page

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
EXTRAS — OPTIONAL, OFF BY DEFAULT
• Hover buttons — a clean grid without the Save and share overlays
• Bigger image — a pin's image shown larger, always within your screen
• Decor — a soft bows or hearts pattern behind the page, tinted to your look
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PERFECT FOR:
• Night owls and late-night browsers
• Anyone with eye strain or light sensitivity
• OLED screen owners who want real black, not dark gray
• Anyone who wants their feed to match their aesthetic
• Designers and creators who want a calmer canvas
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PRIVACY & SECURITY
• No data collection, tracking or analytics — ever
• No account or sign-in required
• Never makes a single network request
• Settings stay on your device (and sync through your own browser account)
• Minimal permissions: storage + side panel, and it runs on the site's own pages only
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
BUILT TO KEEP WORKING
Most theme add-ons break the week the site is redesigned. This one is re-checked
page by page whenever the site changes its look — down to making sure no text
ends up dark on dark.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PART OF THE SORTPIN.COM TOOLKIT
A companion to SortPin.com 's Sort & Download tool — the productivity suite for creators, marketers and businesses.
Questions or feedback? Visit SortPin.com or contact our support team.
Install now and give your feed the look it deserves!
Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Pinterest — a trademark of its owner, used here only to describe what this tool works with.

bluejetty:00077367:ios.summary: The day you’ve been dreading has finally come. A notification pops up on your screen and reads ‘iPhone Storage Full’. You attempt to make sense of the boundless sea of screenshots from your motivational quote phase. You come across an absur
bluejetty:00077367:ios.description:
The day you’ve been dreading has finally come. A notification pops up on your screen and reads ‘iPhone Storage Full’. You attempt to make sense of the boundless sea of screenshots from your motivational quote phase. You come across an absurd number of pictures of a spider that was in your apartment that one time, which in retrospect, wasn’t that big. Priceless memories are scattered throughout your gallery, but you’re bored and losing interest fast. Before you give up, you start selecting pictures by the dozen to delete. Only to realise days later that you actually needed that screenshot deleted in the masses and you actually didn’t mind how you looked in that group photo, the sun was just in your eyes. 
Organizing your picture gallery can be a daunting task and you’re not alone. Did you know the average iOS user has about 2400 pictures in their gallery? With all of those images to sort through, you can’t help but wonder if there is a better way. Well, get ready, the answer is here!
Say hello to PhotoPurge, a photo cleaner app designed to make organizing your gallery fun and simple! Our swiping feature takes you on a stroll down memory lane picture by picture, all you have to do is swipe right to keep and swipe left to delete. Cleaning up your gallery has never been easier or more engaging! 
Key Features: 
- Swipe right! Keep a Picture 
- Swipe left! Delete a Picture 
- Revert: Revert pictures If you accidentally delete or keep an image, you can easily bring it back with the revert button. 
- Bookmark: Save your favorite pictures and view them in an automatically generated file. You’ll never have to search for another picture again!
- Review: You can review deleted and kept pictures once you’re done swiping, just to make sure you’re happy with your swipes.
- Progress Bar: Perhaps you had to cut your storage clearance a little short, not to worry! When you come back, there will be a progress bar on the incomplete month, so you know where you’re at and how much is left to go. 
- Reach your storage goals: You can set storage goals you would like to accomplish on your storage saving venture, letting you achieve your goals effectively!
- Categorized by Month: You can work through your gallery by month, once you’ve completed it, the month will be checked off making it a breeze to see how much you’ve done already. 
- On This Day: Allowing you to sort through pictures taken on that date in the past, transporting you back in time!
Premium Features:
Unlimited Swipes & Bookmarks
Subscription options:
1-week & 1-year subscriptions
Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of current period. Your account will be charged according to your plan for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID account settings at any time after purchase.
Disclaimer:
PhotoPurge allows you to manage images based on your preferences, but we do not take responsibility for any unintended loss or deletion of photos and videos. PhotoPurge allows you to review all photos and videos before they are deleted and we advise to review them carefully to prevent any unintended data loss.
PhotoPurge presents its app through official profiles on Reddit, Snapchat, X, Twitter, Tellonym, Instagram, Threads, Facebook, Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, Messenger and TikTok solely for promotional purposes. It's important for our users to recognize that we do not own, nor are we associated with, the brand names or trademarks of these platforms. Our presence on these sites is independent and does not imply any endorsement or affiliation.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.photopurge.com/app-privacy-policy

bluejetty:00180139:ios.description:
Introducing BIGOJI: The Ultimate Emoji Experience for iOS!
Ever wished you could effortlessly add Apple Emojis to your iMessage pictures? Dreamed of sending larger-than-life Emojis that leave your friends in awe? Or perhaps you've wanted to swap out a cheeky Emoji someone sent you, or explore new and exciting Emoji fonts?
Your wishes have come true! With BIGOJI, you can now unlock the full potential of Emojis on your iOS device! 
BIGOJI offers you:
- Send BIG Emojis, make a BIG impact
- The ability to replace any Emoji in your messages
- Endless customization with new Emoji fonts and Sticker packs
Not only can you access all system Emojis, but BIGOJI also allows you to install your own custom Emojis or choose from a vast selection provided by the app.
It's time to elevate your messaging game with BIGOJI – the one-stop solution for all your Emoji needs! Download now and let your Emojis speak louder than words!
--------
How to add a sticker to a conversation:
1. Open Messages and tap the Compose button to start writing a new message. Or go to an existing conversation.
2. Swipe left or right over the app drawer to find the one that you want to use. 
3. Then tap the app to open it.
If you want to add a sticker, touch and hold the sticker and then drag it to the message bubble. The sticker will automatically be sent after you've added it to the message. You can also pinch or zoom to resize stickers before sending.
BIGOJI © Big Emoji Stickers contains subscription:
The app includes a monthly and an annual auto-renewable
 subscription with 3-day free trial for each.. It will be
charged to your credit card through your iTunes account and will
automatically renew unless you canceled at least 24 hours before
the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial
period will be forfeited when you purchase the subscription. Though
your subscription for the current week or month cannot be canceled, you
can turn auto-renewal off in your account settings after purchase.
See instructions here:
https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
You can read the terms of use and privacy policy here:
https://laszlotuss.com/pp?app=bigoji

bluejetty:00064166:ios.description:
Start a karaoke party from your phone! With over 20,000* licensed songs to choose from, it’s easy to start singing. 
Features 
- Songs in the style of Billie Eilish, Lil Nas X, Shawn Mendes, Queen, Bon Jovi, and many more 
- All genres: pop, rock, country, Disney, show tunes, and more 
- A wide range of eras: from yesterday’s classics to today’s hits 
- A variety of languages 
- Pre-made playlists (Holiday, What’s Hot, Just In, and more) 
- Personalized song queues of up to 100 songs 
- Compatibility with Airplay to mirror the karaoke app on Apple TV 
- The option of casting lyrics to TV with Google Chromecast 
- Possibility of singing along to lead lyrics or without them 
- Low-bandwidth option, by switching the karaoke player to display lyrics on black, rather than video 
Karaoke plans 
FREE: 5 full-length songs, updated monthly 
$9.99: Weekly access for unlimited access to all songs 
$14.99: Monthly access for unlimited access to all songs 
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at the time of purchase (or auto-renewal) in your local currency equivalent to the USD value as determined by the Apple App Store. 
You may manage your subscription and turn off the auto-renewal by going to your iTunes Account Settings and selecting Subscriptions > Sing with Stingray Karaoke 
View Stingray’s Privacy Policy: 
http://www.stingray.com/en/privacy-policy 
http://www.stingray.com/en/terms-and-conditions 
*Number of songs varies by territory

bluejetty:00029921:ios.description:
Welcome to the Hunt! Luxe Hunt is your virtual shopping assistant and 
the place to get the best deals every day!
How it works:
At Luxe Hunt we search hundreds of sales and sites daily to bring you the best deals in real time!
Simply click on the items you love and be linked to the retailers site to purchase the deal.
You will check out as you normally would on each retailer's site.
We don’t sell any products, we just find the best deals for you!
Be sure to sign up for an account and get the most up to date deals and save your favorites.
Deals come and go quickly but don’t worry new deals are always added!
Privacy Policy- https://www.luxehunt.com/privacy_policy
Terms of Use- https://www.luxehunt.com/usage_terms 
Developer
CodeMaya played a major role in the development of Luxe Hunt’s success story. The task in hand was to load the application with the latest deals (posts) on the top. In a nut-shell they wanted CodeMaya to deliver them not just an ecommerce web/mobile application but a platform where they will be able to share all their findings of all the trending luxury goods deals (and non luxury goods) as Luxe Hunt is a hunter for people that are looking for such items. The "hot" deals they post last for a maximum of a few hours so you have to act quick if you want that item!
https://www.codemaya.com/

bluejetty:00019514:ios.description:
Cobra con tarjeta desde tu celular y mueve tu dinero desde una sola app. Sin datáfono, sin RUC y sin cuenta bancaria para empezar.
Una sola app para todos tus cobros, presenciales y a distancia. Payphone procesa pagos con tarjetas de débito o crédito emitidas por cualquier banco del mundo, de forma simple y en segundos.
Cobros presenciales, en tu local
- Código QR: tu cliente escanea y paga en persona. Acepta también Diners Club y Discover.
Cobros a distancia, donde esté tu cliente
- Link de cobro: envíalo por WhatsApp o redes sociales y cierra la venta en el momento.
- Transferencias: envía y recibe dinero al instante entre usuarios Payphone.
Tu dinero, bajo control
- Estrena Mis finanzas: tus ingresos, tus gastos y el desglose de tu dinero (recargas, retiros, links cobrados y pagos recibidos) en un solo lugar.
- Recarga saldo, retira y revisa tu historial en tiempo real desde tu billetera digital.
- Pide tu tarjeta Payphone Mastercard costo cero y úsala en compras en todo el mundo
Precio claro, sin letras chiquitas
- Cero costos fijos: sin afiliación, sin mensualidades y sin fees de mantenimiento.
- Una sola comisión por transacción aprobada: solo pagas cuando cobras.
- Activación rápida: empieza a cobrar en minutos, no en semanas.
¿Para quién es Payphone?
Para personas que quieren manejar su dinero sin trámites y para quienes necesitan cobrar con 
tarjeta sin RUC ni cuenta bancaria: emprendedores, profesionales independientes y negocios que 
empiezan. Más de 550.000 personas ya cobran con Payphone.
Cobra con seguridad
Certificación PCI DSS 4.0.1, protocolo 3DS 2.0 y motores antifraude: cada transacción viaja 
protegida y cada movimiento queda registrado en tu app.
Payphone se renovó
Nuevo diseño más simple y más rápido para cobrar. Descárgala y cobra en minutos

bluejetty:00045168:ios.summary:
Are you applying for the Ohio DMV permit driver’s license test certification? Use this app to prepare, practice and clear CDL driver’s license test for Ohio state and get permit on the first go. 
This app includes questions based on offici
bluejetty:00045168:ios.description:
Are you applying for the Ohio DMV permit driver’s license test certification? Use this app to prepare, practice and clear CDL driver’s license test for Ohio state and get permit on the first go. 
This app includes questions based on official Ohio DMV state manual. The app allows you to prepare and practice for the Car, Motorcycle and Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) test for Ohio state and all practice tests are based on the latest manuals. So if you are searching for DMV driver’s license test preparation – this is the perfect DMV driver’s license test practice app for you. This app is a handbook manual to practice and prepare for CDL and DMV Knowledge Test Permit. 
It is designed keeping in mind the learning needs of a user applying for a driving license and driver’s license test and best learning practices established by researchers. It makes preparing for the driving permit test more enjoyable and fun. Users using this application finds it very easy to answer the questions asked in real DMV permit driver’s license test. 
Following is a brief overview of the facilities provided by the app.
- Practice tests design specially for you.
- Bookmark questions you want to look at a later stage.
- Keep your progress for each practice test and view history. 
- Scope of improvements suggested based on your performance. 
- Practice tests for Car, Motorcycle and Commercial Vehicle (CDL) driver’s license test.
- Exceptionally large set of practice questions which covers every aspects of the driver’s license test.
- Very intuitive and clutter free User Interface.
Following test categories are covered in this app : 
- General Knowledge Test
- Hazardous Materials Test
- School Bus Test
- Passenger Vehicle Test
- Air Brakes Test
- Comb. Vehicles Test
- D/T Trailers test
- Tanker Vehicles Test
- Pre-trip Insp. Test

bluejetty:00177103:ios.description:
Reclaim your inbox with Sifter, the intelligent and private SMS filter for iOS. Powered by a robust Message Filter extension and secure on-device processing, Sifter gives you absolute control over your messaging experience without compromising your privacy.
FOCUS ON WHAT MATTERS
Sifter empowers you to design personalized filtering rules to block unwanted texts while keeping your inbox clean and focused. With a refined interface built for speed and clarity, managing your rules is seamless and efficient.
KEY FEATURES
- RULE-BASED CATEGORIZATION: Easily filter and organize messages into Transactions and Promotions using your own custom rules.
- GRANULAR FILTERING: Tailor your protection with specific rules. From simple keywords to sophisticated patterns, you decide exactly what reaches your notification center.
- CONTACT MANAGEMENT: Protect your peace of mind by whitelisting trusted contacts or blacklisting specific numbers and entire contact lists.
- ADVANCED REGEX ENGINE: Leverage the power of Regular Expressions to create intricate, high-precision filtering rules for complex messaging patterns.
- PRIVACY-FIRST ARCHITECTURE: Sifter operates entirely locally on your device. Your messages never leave your phone, ensuring your personal data remains 100% private.
SUPPORTED RULE TYPES
- Whitelist and Blacklist Users (Contacts/Numbers)
- Whitelist and Blacklist Keywords
- Transactional and Promotional Categorization
- Regex-powered versions of all the above
Sifter is your personal gatekeeper. Whether you are blocking marketing noise or organizing important transactional alerts, Sifter provides a private and powerful solution to keep your messaging focused on what truly matters.
Download Sifter and take full control over your inbox.

bluejetty:00013941:ios.description:
Live flight tracker for Chicago O'Hare Airport (ORD). Free.
Arrivals, departures and flight status — on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled or landed. Gate numbers, baggage carousels and terminals, live. And keep the rest of your trip in the same app: boarding passes, where you parked, packing lists, tickets and bookings.
Perfect for travellers, frequent flyers, taxi drivers, airport staff and anyone meeting or seeing off passengers at Chicago O'Hare Airport.
FLIGHTS
• Live arrivals and departures board, refreshed with one tap
• Search by flight number, airline, city, airport, terminal, gate or baggage belt
• Status at a glance: on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled, landed
• Codeshare flight matching
• Domestic and international filters
• Favourite flights
• Weather and local time at both ends of a flight, with a 3-day forecast
• Flights-per-hour report and status sharing
• Dark mode, 12- or 24-hour time, °C or °F
• Available in 61 languages
MY TRIP — YOUR TRAVEL ESSENTIALS
• Boarding passes: snap a photo, the barcode is read and shown full-screen at the gate
• My car: photos, a note and (optionally) the location of your spot, with walking directions back
• Checklists: packing lists to tick off, with a starter list
• Bag tags: tag number, airline and a photo of your bag
• Receipts: snap a receipt and the total is read for you
• Tickets: train, bus, ferry and event tickets, barcode shown large
• Bookings: hotel, car hire and insurance, with tap-to-call, maps and the confirmation attached
• Links and notes: save links from other apps and keep trip notes
• Trip dates with a countdown
• Backup to a file, with an optional password
Everything stays on your phone. No account needed.
PRO SUBSCRIPTION
• Add and edit everything in My trip
• Both ends of every flight: times, terminal, gate and baggage
• Flight details: taxi-out, air time, taxi-in and delays at each end
• Aircraft type and registration (tail number)
• Security and customs queue wait times (supported airports)
• PDF export of your trip and receipts
• No ads
Download now and always know exactly where every ORD flight stands.
—
This app is not an official airport app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Chicago O'Hare Airport or any airline. For definitive flight times, please check the official airport or airline website. The developer accepts no liability for incidents resulting from use of the data shown.
Terms of Use (EULA)
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy

---
Perfect for Readers Who Want To:
• Build a consistent reading habit
• Borrow books from the library often
• Bring over their records from another reading app
---
Key Features
Easy Book Tracking
• Add books via search or barcode scan
• Keep print books, e-books, and audiobooks all in one place
• Organize books with collections & series
• Manage your library with custom tags
• Save books you want to buy to your wishlist, and pick your next read with a Random Book Draw

Loans & Purchases
• Track due dates for borrowed books and get return reminders

Reading Timer & Progress Tracker

• Track reading time with a built-in reading timer
• Check your timer on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• See your reading speed and time left to finish every time you log
• Set daily and yearly reading goals
• Keep your reading habit going with a reading streak, or switch to a weekly streak if every day feels like too much
• Log each re-read of a book separately

• Extract text from photos using OCR

• Daily and yearly reading statistics with page and reading time analysis
• Stats by author, publisher, language, star rating, and tag
• Reading calendar to visualize your progress
• Annual Rewind feature (available every December)
Import & Export
• Import records you kept in other reading apps from CSV or Excel files
• Export your reading records as text, Markdown, or Excel files
Customization & Security
• Multiple themes to match your style
• App lock with password and Face ID

• iCloud backup support (automatic backups available)

Premium Features
• Remove all ads
• Automatic sync across multiple devices, so you never have to worry about backups
• Unlimited text extraction (OCR)
• All statistics, plus the Daily Statistics timeline
• All themes, plus create your own custom themes
• Reorder and hide home screen sections
---

Bookmory is more than a book tracker.
It's a reading log, reading journal, reading timer, and reading goal app — all in one place.
Track your books.
Measure your reading time.
Build a lasting reading habit.

bluejetty:00024461:ios.summary:
Pray Watch is a simple, privacy-focused app that displays the Islamic prayer times in an elegant, modern interface. Known for its unique green “prayer ring” and other design elements; inspired by Apple’s own native apps.
100% Privacy. Alwa
bluejetty:00024461:ios.description:
Pray Watch is a simple, privacy-focused app that displays the Islamic prayer times in an elegant, modern interface. Known for its unique green “prayer ring” and other design elements; inspired by Apple’s own native apps.
100% Privacy. Always free. And no ads…ever. 
We understand the value of a great user experience, so we’ve thoughtfully designed Pray Watch to be quick, easy, and convenient to use…because we use it ourselves!
== Features ==
- Prayer times automatically configured for any city in the world
- One-of-a-kind “prayer ring” timer to easily visualize remaining time for prayer
- Prayer notifications with option to snooze and remind you later
- Set your masjid iqama times to be reminded to join congregational prayers
- Set a reminder to pray duha / ishraq prayer
- Choose from over 20 calculation methods, or add custom method
- Large selection of beautiful adhans from around the world
- Wide range of reminder sounds for more discreet notifications
- Pre-adhan reminder (to catch current prayer or prepare the for next one)
- Variety of Widgets for your Home and Lock Screen
- Seamlessly connect to your Apple Watch using iCloud sync
- Dynamic Apple Watch face complications
- Simple Qibla compass with haptic feedback - on iPhone and Watch
- Hijri date displayed on main screens, widgets, and complications
- Masjid Locator finds the nearest masjid in your area
- Long-press notifications for rich content like qibla compass and timer, without opening the app
- Prayer times list includes “Midnight” and “Last Third” to help you plan for tahajjud and qiyam
- Monthly Calendar with prayer times table
- Islamic Holidays displayed in app, widgets, and watch
- Arabic and Turkish language translations
- Built-in travel mode to update notifications and calculation method while traveling - without needing to open the app
- Optimized for lower data and battery consumption using the latest iOS standards
- Optional 24-hour time format
- Optional light/dark mode to match your iOS settings
- Beautiful colour themes to personalize the app, widgets, and complications
- Accessibility support
- iPad support

bluejetty:00070147:ios.description:
Universalis is a missal and a breviary, and more besides. It gives you the Liturgy of the Hours (Divine Office) and the Mass for every day; plus valuable additional material. 
The Catholic Calendar app lets you join in with the tens of thousands of people who use Universalis daily, through a free app plus a small monthly subscription of roughly $0.99 / £0.79 / €0.99 (the App Store will tell you the exact figure). If you prefer a single purchase instead of a monthly subscription, get the Universalis app instead of the Catholic Calendar app.
WHAT YOU GET FOR FREE
• A complete liturgical calendar listing every saint and feast for your region.
• The “About Today” page tells you what saints are being celebrated today, not only in your region but worldwide. It includes reflections and biographies.
• The Order of Mass with all the possible alternative texts.
• The Rosary with a verse of Scripture for every Hail Mary of every Mystery. Spoken audio is included if you want to listen to it.
• No Internet needed: everything you need is already built in.
• No cleverness needed: each day, Catholic Calendar works out exactly what you need to see.
• View any date: past, present and future.
• Use your own local calendar: USA, Canada, Singapore, Ireland, and every diocese in Australia, New Zealand and the UK.
• Easy to read and use: a choice of fonts; big or small type; dark or light theme; page-turning or scrolling.
• Help and support: tips and instructions are included; or press “Contact Us” to send us a message, and we will reply.
And more – Home Screen widgets; liturgical events for your iOS calendar; copy and paste into other apps; reminders and alarms.
THE MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTION ADDS:
(Your first month is free.)
LITURGY OF THE HOURS: The complete official Liturgy of the Hours of the Catholic Church, as used worldwide. Morning (Lauds), daytime (Terce, Sext and None), evening (Vespers), night (Compline) and the deeply reflective Office of Readings. Do as many or as few of them as you like.
• The psalms and canticles match the official English and American books. Scripture readings are from the Jerusalem Bible or the RSV.
• Latin if you want it: by itself or alongside the English.

bluejetty:00116066:ios.description:
Explore the planet in 3D like never before!
Globe 3D Map is your all-in-one tool for discovering the Earth in stunning detail. Whether you're a world traveler, geography enthusiast, student, or just curious about what’s happening around the world, this app transforms your device into a powerful and interactive Earth viewer with live GPS tracking, real-time compass, location-based media features, and live video streams from famous places.
With advanced 3D rendering, a user-friendly interface, and smart location tools, Globe 3D Map is designed to inspire exploration, enhance learning, and make navigation fun and intuitive.
Immersive 3D Globe
Enjoy a beautifully rendered 3D Earth you can rotate, zoom, and explore with ease. Move around the globe with smooth gestures and discover countries, cities, and natural wonders in full detail.
Live Location & GPS Tracking
Get your current GPS location instantly and see where you are on the globe in real-time. The app uses advanced location services to track your movement accurately as you travel, walk, or explore.
Location on Photo
Take photos directly from the app or import them and automatically tag the exact location where they were captured. Ideal for travelers, photographers, and social media enthusiasts who want to record memories with precise geo-data.
Built-in Compass
Navigate easily with the smart compass feature that helps you determine direction, orientation, and movement. It works perfectly for hiking, outdoor trips, and general navigation anywhere in the world.
Watch Live Videos from Around the World
Experience the world through live video streams! Watch real-time footage from famous landmarks, bustling cities, remote nature spots, and hidden gems. Stay connected to the beauty and diversity of the Earth from your mobile device.
Customizable 3D Globe Styles
Change the look and feel of your 3D globe with multiple visual themes and map styles. Choose from satellite view, terrain, classic atlas, night mode, and more to personalize your globe experience.
Why Choose Globe 3D Map?
Easy-to-use interface with powerful Earth exploration tools
Real-time location updates and map interaction
Educational value for kids, students, and teachers
Great for travelers and geography lovers
Constantly updated with new video sources and globe themes
Lightweight, fast, and works offline for many features
Whether you're planning your next trip, learning geography, exploring new cultures, or simply enjoying a virtual journey around the planet, Globe 3D Map brings the Earth to your fingertips.
In-App Purchases
Some features such as full access to live videos, advanced photo geotagging, premium globe styles, and ad-free usage require a one-time purchase or subscription. These optional upgrades enhance your experience but are not required for basic app usage.
Download Globe 3D Map today
And start exploring the world in a way you’ve never seen before – from your mobile device, anytime, anywhere!

bluejetty:00162051:ios.name: Friday: pagamento de contas
bluejetty:00162051:ios.summary: O app Friday é o assistente financeiro inteligente que funciona como assistente de pagamentos + organizador financeiro: gerencia contas, simplifica a sua rotina e te ajuda com o controle das suas finanças pessoais. Agora, organizar contas e
bluejetty:00162051:ios.description:
O app Friday é o assistente financeiro inteligente que funciona como assistente de pagamentos + organizador financeiro: gerencia contas, simplifica a sua rotina e te ajuda com o controle das suas finanças pessoais. Agora, organizar contas e pagar boletos vai ficar muito mais fácil!
A Friday te ajuda a organizar e pagar contas de um jeito simples e rápido. Você será lembrado por WhatsApp pelo nosso assistente de pagamentos no dia de vencimento e conseguirá pagar boletos em segundos e até mesmo com um Pix.
ASSISTENTE FINANCEIRO
Já pensou em ter suas contas pagas de forma automática, com inteligência artificial pra te ajudar com pagamentos, lembretes de contas por WhatsApp, conexão com contas de luz, gás, telefone, internet, relatórios financeiros sobre suas despesas e uma carteira compartilhada, tudo em um app só? 
Aqui, você pode pagar contas sem se preocupar mais: todos os meses as suas contas chegarão automaticamente pra você fazer os pagamentos de um jeito muito mais simples e seguro. A Friday é o primeiro assistente financeiro inteligente que busca, lembra, paga e controla suas contas por você.
FRED - Seu assistente virtual inteligente
Diga oi ao Fred! Seu assistente financeiro inteligente e organizador de contas que se comunica com você por WhatsApp para te ajudar com o seu controle financeiro e resolver de vez a gestão das suas contas.
Com o Fred, você receberá notificações de novas contas a pagar e lembretes de vencimento, pagará com um único Pix e receberá todas as informações necessárias sobre seu saldo para futuros pagamentos.
Use inteligência artificial para resolver pagamentos por você, analisar seus gastos e facilitar sua rotina.
FINANÇAS CONTROLADAS
Você está no controle sempre, mas o trabalho de pagar contas é todo nosso. Aprove no app, adicione saldo e receba os comprovantes. Você também pode pagar contas com 1 único Pix.
Além de te ajudar a poupar dinheiro que você perderia por atrasar as contas, a Friday funciona também como um gerenciador de contas, que te ajuda a identificar os maiores gastos: basta categorizar suas contas para ter relatório financeiro e saber quais são suas principais despesas!
COMPARTILHE - Controle de contas da família
Compartilhe uma carteira para pagar boletos em conjunto sem perder a privacidade e autonomia. Cada membro poderá adicionar saldo, incluir boletos e receberá lembretes de pagamentos, notificações de novas contas e comprovantes por WhatsApp.
Chega de ficar cobrando seu/a parceiro/a se aquela conta já foi paga. Para evitar discussões e ganhar tempo para amar, você terá acesso ao extrato do mês e uma calculadora de pagamento de contas.
O app que tira de você a tarefa de pagar contas:
• Tenha total controle de contas a pagar emitidas no seu CPF;
• Veja suas contas a pagar por ordem de vencimento.
• Seja informado sobre tudo por WhatsApp pelo Fred: lembrete de pagamento, vencimentos, comprovantes e muito mais.
• Conecte suas contas de consumo (luz, gás, telefone) e receba os boletos automaticamente.
• Cadastre uma só vez seus Pix recorrentes e não se preocupe em esquecer de alguém.
• Pague todas as despesas com um único Pix - boletos, contas de consumo e Pix recorrentes.
• Convide uma pessoa (cônjuge, amigo, parente, assistente) para juntar contas ou ajudar a pagar boletos e ter visibilidade sobre comprovantes de pagamentos.
• Parcele boletos com cartão de crédito.
• Categorize seus pagamentos e saiba quanto você gasta com nosso relatório em tempo real;
Atendimento real, feito por pessoas reais
Ficou com alguma dúvida? Receba atendimento via WhatsApp em uma experiência única.
Nós cuidamos das suas contas a pagar e oferecemos controle financeiro para simplificar sua organização financeira enquanto você usa seu tempo com a parte boa da vida!
Friday: o assistente financeiro inteligente que resolve de vez a gestão das suas contas.
Termos de uso: https://friday.ai/termos-de-uso

Dive into the world of Nut Sort Puzzle: Nuts and Bolts, a premier brainteasers game that combines strategy and color coordination to challenge your mental prowess.  Imagine a pile of nuts of different colors scattered all over the place. Your task as a nut sort puzzle master is to sort them out by color onto corresponding bolt. Sounds simple, right? Think again! The nuts and bolts color sort game presents a challenging task by mixing all the nuts, making it hard to find the corresponding bolt. The goal is to sort them out in the shortest time possible, with the least amount of moves possible. Just like in a well-crafted nut sort color sorting game, every move counts, and the puzzle-solving thrill is intense. There are some amazing nut sort color puzzle games to test your puzzle solving abilities, rivaling even the most complex color sorting game experiences.

 🔩 A record of your movements is kept for each level, so you can challenge yourself to complete levels in the nuts and bolts color sort game with the least amount of moves. This makes it a rewarding nut sort color sorting game for competitive minds.
 🔩 As you progress through levels, new challenges are introduced, like the Hidden Nuts Sort Levels. In these nuts sort levels, you won’t know what color nut is coming next, adding an extra nuts sort level of surprise and excitement to the nuts and bolts color sort game. It’s these unpredictable twists that elevate it beyond a standard color sorting game.
🔥 The Nut Color Puzzle game provides a twist to the classic nuts sort games that are easy to get hooked on. Nut sort color puzzle games is suitable for players who love the nuts and bolts color sort game and guarantees countless hours of fun and entertainment. For fans of nut sort color sorting game challenges, it’s a must-try title. Whether you’re into the classic color sorting game formula or looking for the innovative elements of a bolt sort puzzle, this game delivers it all. Download nuts sort games today and become a nuts sort Master in nut sort color puzzle games!

- This exciting and dynamic game is sure to bring you hours of fun.

- Plenty of interactive elements in the car.
- An interesting map of the city at night.

bluejetty:00023696:ios.description:
Otimize a gestão dos seus cartões com o aplicativo Unicred Visa! 
Por aqui, você tem controle total sobre seus cartões Unicred, com funcionalidades que facilitam seu dia a dia.
Confira o que o aplicativo oferece:
• Desbloqueio simples
Desbloqueie e ative tanto seu cartão titular quanto os adicionais em apenas alguns cliques.
• Fatura do cartão
Consulte sua fatura, gere boletos para pagamento e obtenha uma segunda via. Tudo de forma prática e acessível.
• Histórico de compras
Acompanhe seus gastos em tempo real diretamente na tela inicial do app.
• Alterar vencimento
Precisa reorganizar suas finanças? Experimente alterar a data de vencimento da sua fatura diretamente no app.
• Cartão virtual
Faça suas compras online e pague suas assinaturas com ainda mais segurança. Basta gerar um cartão virtual no app, é gratuito.
• Carteira digital
Adicione seu cartão Unicred Visa ao Apple Pay para efetuar pagamentos por aproximação com praticidade.
• Atendimento digital
Simplifique seus serviços sem a necessidade de telefonemas. Utilize o chat do app para resolver suas questões.
• Benefícios
Consulte todos os benefícios da Unicred e da Visa disponíveis para a categoria do seu cartão.
• Alteração e recuperação de senha
Esqueceu sua senha? Recupere-a com facilidade em apenas alguns cliques.
• Limites
Consulte o limite do seu cartão e gerencie os gastos dos seus adicionais.
• Débito em conta
Cadastre sua fatura em débito automático para mais praticidade no seu dia a dia.
• Aviso viagem
Ative o aviso de viagem para utilizar seu cartão com segurança em saques e compras no exterior.
• Parcelar fatura
Se necessário, parcele sua fatura e ganhe mais tempo para organizar suas finanças.
• Segurança
Bloqueie temporariamente seu cartão em caso de perda ou roubo para garantir a segurança das suas transações.
• Personalização do cartão
Crie apelidos para seus cartões facilitando a identificação e organização. Especialmente se tiver múltiplos cartões.
Ainda não é nosso cooperado? Associe-se pelo app Unicred Mobile e tenha todos os benefícios de uma instituição financeira cooperativa.
Ainda não tem cartão Unicred Visa? Solicite para sua gerência e aproveite os benefícios de um cartão feito especialmente para cooperados Unicred.

bluejetty:00149249:ios.name: Attendable: Attendance Tracker
bluejetty:00149249:ios.summary:
■ Leave the paper roster behind
Attendable is an attendance tracker for schools, academies, churches, clubs and any group that meets regularly. Record attendance on your phone instead of paper, then turn it into statistics and Excel files
bluejetty:00149249:ios.description:
■ Leave the paper roster behind
Attendable is an attendance tracker for schools, academies, churches, clubs and any group that meets regularly. Record attendance on your phone instead of paper, then turn it into statistics and Excel files instantly.
■ Made for
- Teachers and instructors taking attendance every class
- Homeroom teachers managing a class roster and attendance records together
- Church small group, ministry and choir leaders
- Club, study group, volunteer and sports team organizers
- Tutors, learning centers and daycare staff who need simple attendance management
■ Features
1. Check types you define
Beyond present and absent, create late, early leave, excused, online or any status your group actually uses.
2. One-swipe attendance
Swipe to mark attendance, apply a status to everyone at once, and record exact check-in times. Large rosters take seconds.
3. Roster management
Import names from your contacts or type them in. Split multiple classes and meetings into groups and manage them all in one app.
4. Statistics by period and person
Attendance rates are calculated automatically from saved records. See at a glance who has been missing.
5. Excel export
Export attendance data as an Excel file for reports, billing or sharing with parents.
6. Group sharing and permissions
Share a roster with co-teachers or other managers and assign owner, editor and viewer roles.
7. Attendance requests
Members can submit their own absence or late reasons for a manager to review and approve.
8. Calls, texts and notes
Call or text straight from the roster, and save frequently used notes as templates.
9. Home screen widgets
See today's attendance for up to six groups right on your home screen, and tap a group to open it. Choose which groups each widget shows.
■ Languages
English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), German, Spanish, French, Italian
■ Contact
https://attendable.app

bluejetty:00087367:ios.description:
Criesnyse is a no-code platform to build, run, and track machine learning models that classify market conditions across stocks, crypto, and forex. You're not just using AI — you're creating it. Cut through market noise: follow the data, not the influencers.
Here’s a set of unique features of what Criesnyse offers:
BUILD, RUN & MANAGE AI TRADING MODELS
- Criesnyse is the first platform allowing you to build, manage, and track your digital trading models.
- Securely and seamlessly digitalize your strategy, with each model encapsulated as an NFT.

bluejetty:00140290:ios.description:

EMPIRE brings Total War’s real-time battles and grand turn-based strategy into the 18th-century age of exploration and conquest. 
Lead great powers in a race for dominance — from Europe to India and the Americas. Command vast fleets and armies in an era of rapid scientific advances, global conflict and momentous political change.
This is the complete Total War: EMPIRE desktop experience, expertly adapted for iPhone and iPad, with redesigned user interfaces and extensive quality-of-life improvements.
LEAD THE NATION 
Grow one of eleven factions into a military and economic superpower.
DOMINATE THE BATTLEFIELD 
Master gunpowder warfare in seismic 3D battles decided by tactical genius and technological superiority.
RULE THE WAVES 
Outmanoeuvre rivals in spectacular sea battles — where wind direction, cunning and a well-timed broadside can prove decisive.
MASTER THE GLOBE 
Use statecraft and subterfuge to secure territory and lucrative trade routes.
SEIZE THE FUTURE 
Develop new technologies to power industrial expansion and military prowess.
COMMAND THE ACTION 
Forge your empire with intuitive touchscreen controls, or any iPadOS-compatible mouse & keyboard.
===
‘A NEW WORLD’ NOW AVAILABLE
Available via in-app purchase, this massive expansion unlocks:
 • 44 PLAYABLE FACTIONS: Lead all non-rebel factions in the Grand Campaign, from Greece and Gran Colombia to Mexico and the Mamelukes.
 • 2 NEW CAMPAIGNS: The Late Start Campaign brings EMPIRE’s global map into 1783, where technologically advanced empires fight to retain their distant colonies. In the Warpath Campaign, lead one of five Native American factions on a detailed, tightly focused map of the Americas.
 • 14 NAVAL UNITS: Enhances late-game naval combat with variants on existing vessels and favourites from Total War: NAPOLEON, including the giant 140-gun Santísima Trinidad.
===
We recommend playing Total War: EMPIRE on iOS 17 or later. You need 12GB of free space on your device, though we recommend at least double this to avoid initial installation issues.

 • iPhone XR and later
 • iPhone SE - 2nd Generation (2020) and later
Supported iPads: 
 • iPad - 7th Generation (2019) and later
 • iPad mini - 5th Generation (2019) and later

 • iPad Pro - 2nd Generation (2017) and later

bluejetty:00030824:ios.name: Flight Tracker Airplane Radar
bluejetty:00030824:ios.summary: With flight tracking app, you can access precise and dependable details concerning flights operated by various global airlines. You are granted the ability to view the flight path of any airplane, along with comprehensive flight information
bluejetty:00030824:ios.description:
With flight tracking app, you can access precise and dependable details concerning flights operated by various global airlines. You are granted the ability to view the flight path of any airplane, along with comprehensive flight information.
The main screen will display a global map showcasing all international flights in real time. To delve into further flight details, simply choose the aircraft of your interest. You'll then gain access to information like flight direction, flight number, departure and arrival times, as well as aircraft type.
To enhance the user experience with the flight tracker, the application includes the following filters:
- Flight by route
- Live flights by airline
- Airports by country
- Nearby airports
Here's how you can locate a flight by route: Just enter the ICAO or IATA code into the search box, and you'll receive information about all flights currently on the way.
Live flights by airline: Within the list, you'll discover a comprehensive collection of international airlines arranged alphabetically. Choose the desired airlines to access flight particulars, including arrival and departure dates and countries, along with aircraft types.
Airports by country: Locate the airport you're interested in by selecting from an extensive list of countries. Following that, you'll be presented with a comprehensive list of airports within that country. The app will show it on the map and provide you with detailed information about ongoing flights.
Nearby airports: This feature provides you with a comprehensive list of airports in close proximity. When you choose the one you're interested in, you'll receive detailed information about that specific airport.
Download Flight Tracker: Airplane Radar for iOS now!

bluejetty:00200161:ios.summary:
