Make every opening part of your st
bluejetty:00200161:ios.description:
Requires iPhone Duo for automatic fold counting and open-session timing. Standard iPhone models and iPad do not provide the required folding triggers. One-time manual setup in Apple Shortcuts is required.
Make every opening part of your story with Fold by Fold.
• Track today's openings, your lifetime total, averages, milestones, and your busiest day on a stats-focused Overview.
• Explore weekly, monthly, and yearly count charts, plus hourly and weekly completed-time charts.
• Pair Opened and Closed automations to measure sessions, completed time, average session length, and your longest session.
• Browse and filter counts and sessions by today, this week, this month, or all time.
• Correct daily counts, add missed openings, or undo the latest eligible recorded opening.
• Set an optional daily goal and choose optional local goal and milestone alerts.
• Choose Classic or Dashboard separately for each Fold by Fold widget, with small, medium, and large sizes, plus Weekly activity and Daily goal widgets.
• Preview both widget layouts inside the app using your history or labeled example data. Tap widgets to open relevant details.
• Choose from 16 coordinated themes, including Lime, Magenta, Sand, and Midnight.
• Adjust count size, contrast, and background decoration for readability.
• Export daily history as CSV, save a JSON backup, and restore with a recovery copy.
COUNTING AND TIMING HAVE SEPARATE SETUP
Connect Record a Fold to an Opened-only shortcut. For automatic session timing, create a separate Closed-only shortcut containing Record a Close. Enable automatic running and allow running while locked for both. The five-step guide includes a physical test. Counting and Timing readiness reflect recorded signals, not an inspection of your automations.
The troubleshooting guide helps with running timers, missing or doubled counts, and stale widgets. Support: spudappssupport@gmail.com.
No account, ads, subscription, analytics, or tracking. Counts and sessions stay on your device unless you export or share them. Support email sends nothing automatically.
History starts when recording begins. Missing closes and earlier durations cannot be reconstructed. Current-session timers follow recorded actions, not verified physical posture. iOS controls automation execution and widget refresh timing. Goals and achievements are personal activity markers, not durability estimates. One-time paid app. No in-app purchases.

bluejetty:00076610:ios.description:
Discover a world of unique and everyday treasures with CTBIDS, where bidding starts at just $1. Our user-friendly app makes online auctions a breeze, ensuring a seamless experience for all. Users of this app must be 18 years or older.
Welcome Home to CTBIDS:
•Bid from anywhere!
•Set maximum bids so that you don’t miss out on fun while you are away.
•Easily filter items by category, location, featured estate sales, and more.
•Stay in the loop with your bidding status every step of the way.
•Create favorites lists to explore more of what you love.
CTBIDS grew from an idea over 10 years ago by Caring Transitions owners across the country. These owners are carefully managing the treasures and everyday household items for their clients as they downsize or transition to new homes. These items have quality, value, and a history that are a perfect fit for someone else. Our mission was to create a platform where these estate sales are brought to you online. Instead of set pricing, bidding starts at $1. This process allows our bidders to find unique and everyday treasures for a great value. In addition, the repurposing of these belongings will have a positive and lasting impact on the world we all share. CTBIDS is powered by Caring Transitions. Established in 2006, Caring Transitions is the nation’s largest and most trusted organization specializing in downsizing, relocation, estate sales, decluttering, home cleanouts, online auctions, and other services. To learn more, visit CaringTransitions.com.

bluejetty:00187019:ios.description:
Zoho Assist is a reliable remote desktop app that allows you to easily and securely connect to remote PCs from any location at anytime. One of the best aspects of Assist is that it works seamlessly across all major platforms.
Technicians can use Zoho Assist to launch a remote support, screen sharing, or unattended access session to support customers and fix issues in real time. 
Key Features
Siri shortcuts: Start sessions, search for and connect to distant machines, and more using voice commands.
iOS widgets: With the iOS widgets feature, you may save your favorite URS device and access it directly from the home screen.
App lock: App lock provides a biometric lock to secure unattended remote support device. 
Dark Mode: Choose between dark and bright modes based on your preferences.
Power options at the remote end:
- Log off
- Reboot
- Shut down 
Schedule a remote session with a specific time, date, and other details.
Use Assist's text chat option to communicate effectively with your customer during an active remote support session. 
Multi-monitor navigation:
Technicians can access and control multiple monitors during a support session.
File transfer:
Send and receive files (up to 5 GB) from technician device to customer device during a remote session.
Session Notes: Take contextual session notes during a session without needing to switch between apps. 
Screenshots sync:
Screenshots captured during a session may now be synced up to the cloud.
In-App purchases allow users to subscribe to Zoho Assist which enables these features for them: 
-File Transfer
-Send Ctrl+Alt+Del
-Reboot and Reconnect
-Schedule Sessions
-Session Notes
Quick guide: 
Install Zoho Assist Technician app.
Install the Zoho Assist customer app on the device you need to connect to.
Initiate a remote support session on your device and then prompt the customer to join the session using the customer app.
Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions:
-https://www.zoho.com/privacy.html
-https://www.zoho.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00014234:ios.description:
Go People is changing the delivery industry by disrupting legacy “delivery and courier industry rules”, simplifying the point-to-point delivery process for both consumers and businesses, fulfilling the gap in service demand, raising service standards, and facilitating transparent and competitive pricing.
Customers (Senders) book their deliveries and pay via the Web based or smartphone app. A Runner bids for a job via the smartphone app and the Go People system selects the most suitable Runner. The selected Runner then collects the consignment from the pick-up location and delivers it to the recipient. 
Go People, its Senders, Runners and the Senders’ customer (the recipient) benefit from GPS tracking and instant communication from pick up to receipt. Delivery verification and signed confirmation is assured. The Runner then receives 85% of the winning bid price.
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00133577:ios.summary:
Prepare smarter for Junior Bible Quiz with JBQ Companion — an all-in-one JBQ study, practice, coaching, scoring, and training app for quizzers, parents, coaches, and teams.
JBQ Companion helps make Junior Bible Quiz preparation easier, mor
bluejetty:00133577:ios.description:
Prepare smarter for Junior Bible Quiz with JBQ Companion — an all-in-one JBQ study, practice, coaching, scoring, and training app for quizzers, parents, coaches, and teams.
JBQ Companion helps make Junior Bible Quiz preparation easier, more organized, and more engaging. Study questions, listen to them aloud, practice for competitions, improve response speed, run team practice sessions, keep score during matches, and access useful JBQ resources from one app.
LEARN JBQ QUESTIONS
Use the Learn section to study and memorize Junior Bible Quiz questions and answers.
Select the questions you want to practice and let JBQ Companion read them aloud. Quizzers can listen, interrupt while a question is being read, and practice responding like they would during a real quiz.
Features include:
• Listen to JBQ questions and answers
• Practice selected questions
• Read questions individually or continuously
• Stop a question when the quizzer interrupts
• Mark answers correct or incorrect
• Hear encouraging feedback for correct answers
• Search questions quickly
• Practice while traveling or away from home
PRACTICE FOR JUNIOR BIBLE QUIZ
The Practice section creates randomized JBQ questions for individual or team practice.
A standard practice set can include:
• 10-point questions
• 20-point questions
• 30-point questions
Randomized practice helps quizzers prepare for different question types instead of memorizing questions in a fixed order.
JBQ SCORE KEEPER
Use the built-in Score Keeper during practices and quiz meets instead of relying only on paper score sheets.
You can:
• Add quizzers to your team
• Add the opposing team
• Track individual and team scores
• Record question points
• Manage timeouts
• Record judges' rulings
• View remaining scoring opportunities
QUIZ MASTER
Quiz Master provides additional tools for running JBQ practice sessions and helps coaches manage quizzer responses more efficiently.
BUZZER & TRAINING TOOLS
JBQ Companion includes multiple buzzer-style tools that can be used during quizzer training and practice.
Use them to work on:
• Faster responses
• Question interruption timing
• Reaction speed
• Competition-style practice
ANSWER TIMER
Use the built-in timer to measure how quickly a quizzer responds and help improve answer speed during practice.
JBQ RESOURCES
Access useful Junior Bible Quiz reference materials directly from the app, including:
• JBQ Basics information
• JBQ score sheets
• Official JBQ guidelines
• Team structure and ordering information
• Additional quiz-related resources
BUILT FOR JBQ QUIZZERS, PARENTS & COACHES
JBQ Companion can be used for:
• Junior Bible Quiz study
• JBQ question memorization
• Bible Quiz practice
• Quizzer training
• Team practice
• Individual practice
• Question listening
• Response-time training
• JBQ scoring
• Competition preparation
• Bible knowledge development
Practice at home, at church, while traveling, or together with your JBQ team.
ONE APP FOR YOUR JBQ JOURNEY
From learning questions for the first time to preparing for quiz meets and tracking scores during competition, JBQ Companion gives families and teams practical tools for every stage of Junior Bible Quiz preparation.
Study. Practice. Listen. Train. Quiz. Improve.
Get JBQ Companion and make your Junior Bible Quiz practice more organized, interactive, and effective.

bluejetty:00146032:ios.summary:
Dive into an action RPG where you fight enemies and explore dungeons. Ready to be a hero? 
Dungeon Ward is an offline action RPG mixed with old-school grid-based dungeon crawler from a 3rd person perspective. The core is about real-time c
bluejetty:00146032:ios.description:
Dive into an action RPG where you fight enemies and explore dungeons. Ready to be a hero? 
Dungeon Ward is an offline action RPG mixed with old-school grid-based dungeon crawler from a 3rd person perspective. The core is about real-time combat, looting, RPG character building, questing and boss fights.
Character building
It takes the best from the action RPG games (leveling up characters, items, stats, skill trees, city with shops, quests, bosses etc.) to the classic dungeon crawler setting.
Unique classes
Play as a mighty Warden, shapeshifting Ranger or elemental Mage. Invest talent points to learn new skills such as spell reflection, lightning arrow or werewolf transformation. Learn passive talents or just increase stats to create exactly the character build you like.
Procedural hand-made dungeons
Dungeon Ward features 3D procedural dungeons from hand-made parts with unique boss rooms, deadly traps, teleports and story quests.
Offline play
This RPG game can be completely played offline (without internet). Everything is possible to buy via ingame currencies which are obtainable also by playing.
Grid-based controls, 3rd person camera
The grid-based controls are similar to old-school dungeon crawler games from 90s. That means 90 degree turning, movement on a grid. It features not only button controls but also virtual joystick. Now supports also controllers connected over bluetooth. 
Actively developed, Localized
Dungeon Ward is in active development by a czech solo developer. The game is localized to: English (EN), Czech (CZ), Slovak (SK), German (DE), Spanish (ES), Polish (PL), Italian (IT), Indonesian (ID), Brasilian Portuguese (PT BR), French (FR), Turkish (TR), Chinese (CN), Japanese (JA). No wifi needed.

Plexamp is the answer to the question "what would happen if you gave a handful of Plex music and pixel nerds a few cocktails and free rein to create the app of their
bluejetty:00026451:ios.description:
** You'll need a Plex Media Server and a Plex account to use this app **
Plexamp is the answer to the question "what would happen if you gave a handful of Plex music and pixel nerds a few cocktails and free rein to create the app of their dreams?"
Plexamp is a beautiful, dedicated Plex music player with tons of goodies for audiophile purists, music curators, and music fans of all ages looking for their next aural fix.
SUPER AUDIO PLAYER
Loudness leveling, true gapless playback, Sweet Fades™, soft transitions, a configurable preamp, a 7-band EQ, and more. Perfection for golden ears, buttery smooth touches for the rest of us. Custom pre-caching so your music keeps playing, because sometimes life brings you through tunnels.
MUSIC TO YOUR EYES
Experience your music collection like you’ve never seen it before, with our UltraBlur backgrounds, over a dozen hypnotic visualizers, and four visual themes to satisfy every taste.
FIND YOUR FIX
Radios built from your library and your cooler friends' collections. Travel through time, pick a style or mood, or listen album-by-album like the purist you are. Use the Mix Builder to explore and craft your perfect blend. Explore your personal charts and see what you were into last Fall or your top albums from the 60s.
OFFLINE BLISS
Grab a few hours of your favorite playlist or stations with just a few taps. Download a custom mix or artist radio for the plane. Simple but powerful offline support for when you’re in the woods or run out of cellular data.
IT’S THE LITTLE THINGS
Powerful search. Playback activity history. Swipe-up play queue peeking. Fun artist explorations. As many settings and tweaks as our resident UXpert let us add.
ENTERPRISE CLASS CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT
Just kidding. It's a music player.
Follow us on Twitter @plexamp or Mastodon https://mstdn.social/@plexamp
See the terms of service at https://www.plex.tv/about/privacy-legal/plex-terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00036060:ios.description:
WAWatch - Quick Reply WhatsApp Messages on Your Apple Watch
If you want to receive and reply WhatsApp messages on your Apple Watch, WAWatch is the correct choice. In WAWatch, you can sync WhatsApp chat list / contact list, receive and send WhatsApp messages on Apple Watch.
Key Features:
Receive / Send WhatsApp messages on Apple Watch
Custom quick reply list on iPhone and send reply on Apple Watch
Supported WhatsApp message types:
- Text
- Photo
- Audio
- Emoji
- WhatsApp Sticker
- Other type messages can be viewed on WhatsApp
Why WAWatch?
- Free to reply WhatsApp messages
- Great user experience
- Support almost all types which suit for Apple Watch
- Only need login first, WAWatch will sync chat list and contact list automatically
- Data security, WAWatch never save your privacy data
How It Works?
Open WA Watch on your iPhone.
Scan QR code through WhatsApp by Settings > Link Devices > Link a Device to link WhatsApp Account.
WAWatch watch app should use with paired iPhone / iPad app, please keep the iPhone / iPad nearby, so WAWatch can access the network. Without iPhone / iPad counterpart app, WAWatch can't work standalone on Apple Watch.
Disclaimer: WAWatch is a third-party client, which wasn't owned or supported by WhatsApp Team. We follow the WhatsApp Terms of Service and never collect user data in WAWatch.
If you want to support our further development, you can buy in-app subscription to unlock all features. Also, you can still use free version to send / receive messages.
Terms of Service: https://wawatch.watchchat.me/terms
Privacy Policy: https://wawatch.watchchat.me/terms

bluejetty:00120642:ios.description:
* This App is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by TED in any way
* LITE (FREE) version -> Search "TEDICT"
To become good at English, you need to listen to it often, but simply listening to English is not enough. Just like other languages in the world, English has many similar words that are difficult to distinguish by listening. That’s why you need to be able to confirm whether you heard them right. 
The key to gaining expertise is in mastering dictation! 
When you listen to the speaker and type in the words, the program will check them, letter by letter. 
Because it only takes a short period of time, you can use it on the bus or subway. You can also use it as a TED viewer through the video function with the subtitles activated. 
The notable feature is that a huge number of TED lectures are constantly added, which means an unlimited amount of available learning materials for you. 
TEDICT allows you to download as many TED lectures as you want, so you’ll always get new learning materials. 
The World’s Best Intellectual Archive, TED 
High-level TED speeches 
This program even features various kinds of English pronunciations from all over the world. 
Use TEDICT to listen to cool ideas from TED and improve your English skills!
* TEDICT differs from TEDICT LITE in the following ways:
- No ads
- iCloud Support – Save your study history by date, bookmarks, and learning progress to the cloud and sync your learning seamlessly between iPhone and iPad.
- Unlimited dictation

The key to gaining expertise is in mastering dictation! 

When you listen to the speaker and type in the words, the program will check them, letter by letter.

This program even features various kinds of English pronunciations from all over the world. 

Use TEDICT to listen to cool ideas from TED and improve your English skills!

Las novelas españolas en LunaNovela se actualizan diariamente. Reanuda tu lectura feliz y no te preocupes por un precipicio. bluejetty:00152734:ios.description:
Ever tried to say something backwards? Spoiler: it sounds ridiculous.
Dumb Reverse is the easiest way to turn any word, sentence, or inside joke into instant comedy.
How it works:
- Record yourself saying literally anything, or pick from our curated list of lyrics and funny phrases.
- The app flips it backwards.
- Try repeating the reversed version.
- Play it forward again to hear the chaos.
Play solo, with friends, or with your family. Dumb Reverse comes with levels to unlock, so the challenges keep getting harder (and funnier) the more you play.
Perfect for:
- Party games and family nights
- Creating inside jokes no one else will understand
- TikTok challenges and Reels that people can’t stop watching
Warning: once you start, you won’t be able to stop laughing at how cursed everything sounds in reverse.
Download Dumb Reverse and see how dumb you sound.

bluejetty:00127696:ios.description:
Habit Tracker: A simple daily planner to schedule and track your routine, making it easy to build lasting habits. 
Join 15M+ happy users, achieve your goals, and make every day count!
More than a self-care companion, it lets you share with others to grow and improve together. 
----Useful Features----
Sync with Apple Health: Track water intake, steps, sleep, exercise, and calories to seamlessly monitor your wellness journey. 
Build & Quit Habits: Create positive routines or break free from bad habits with tailored tracking.
Flexible Goal Tracking: Measure progress with specific units (e.g., minutes, glasses of water), not just checkmarks. 
Group Habits: Stay motivated by building, reminding, and tracking habits with friends or loved ones. 
Insightful Stats: Get detailed analytics to evaluate and celebrate your progress. 
Habit Reports: Weekly, monthly, and yearly reports to visualize your growth. 
Mood Tracking: Monitor your mental wellness to stay balanced and mindful. 
Smart Reminders: Set time- or location-based reminders to stay on track effortlessly.
Multiple Reminders: Add as many reminders as needed for any habit. 
Custom Sounds: Record or import unique reminder sounds for a personal touch. 
Widgets for Easy Access: Use Home Screen & Lock Screen to log habits instantly without opening the app.
HRV Stress Monitor: Track your heart rate variability (HRV) to measure stress levels and gain insights into your well-being
Habit Diary: Jot down notes to reflect on your journey in a personal habit memo. 
Focus Timer: Stay focused with natural sounds & create a calming, distraction-free environment
Cloud Sync: Back up and sync your data across devices for seamless access. 
Daily Inspiration: Enjoy motivational wallpapers and quotes to keep you inspired. 
Privacy Protection: Secure your data with FaceID or TouchID. 
Friendly Competition: Compete with friends to see who’s crushing their habits. 
ADHD Planner: ADHD friendly plans built-in to help.
Dark Mode: Sleek design for a comfortable experience, day or night. 
Habit Tracker helps you simplify your daily routine, clear your mind, stay on track with your goals, and build a better life.
Download now! Perfect for ADHD users, this app simplifies planning and tracking to help you stay focused, build routines, and thrive with ease.
NOTE: Habit reads data for some habits from Apple Health app (Steps, energy, walking, running ..etc). No data is being sent outside of your device. Health app access required.

bluejetty:00185220:ios.description:
LumaShare allows you to view and share your photo booth photos, videos and GIFs from dslrBooth or LumaBooth, the most popular professional photo booth apps. You can share strips, photos, GIFs, boomerangs, using e-mail, SMS, WhatsApp, AirDrop, and QR Code. All sharing features require no additional complicated configuration and work seamlessly. E-mail and SMS even work if you have no internet connection. 
LumaShare has a built-in slideshow feature and can play the slideshow in the background to any AirPlay 2 device such as Roku, AppleTV, or AirPlay-compatible Smart TVs or over an HDMI cable.
You can print your photos directly if you have a printer that supports AirPrint or to the printer connected to dslrBooth or LumaBooth. You can also add a disclaimer to be displayed to guests before they're allowed to share or print.
If you want to use the optional sharing features of LumaShare, you can subscribe to our LumaShare Cloud Storage and Sharing Subscription which offers unlimited sharing using SMS, E-mail, QR Code, and WhatsApp:
• Sharing within fotoShare requires a monthly renewable subscription that costs $8.99. 
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. 
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
• Please go to dslrbooth.com/terms-of-service/ and dslrbooth.com/privacy-policy for more information.

All Your Streaming Services in One Place.
Your Streaming Movie & TV Guide. Track, discover and find where to watch TV shows and movies from Netflix, Amazon Prime, Hulu, Showtime and over 100 more services.

Universal search to easily find where to watch TV Shows or Movies available across more than 100 sources like Netflix, Hulu, Amazon Prime, DirecTV, HBO GO, HBO NOW, Crackle, MTV, CBS, Vudu, FOX, CW, PBS, Lifetime, YouTube, A&E, History Channel, MAX GO, Showtime, Cartoon Network, Comedy Central, VH1, ABC, Starz, EPIX and Fandango, all in one app. What are you waiting for? With Yidio, finding what you want to watch has never been easier.
**PLEASE NOTE** While some streaming services make their movies and TV shows available for free (The CW, Tubi TV), other streaming services require a subscription or cable/satellite login (Netflix, Hulu, HBO GO) or a payment to rent or buy (iTunes). Yidio, however, is free to use to find where to watch your favorite movies and TV shows across all those services. Many of them require their app to be downloaded in order to watch. Yidio helps you install their apps and deep link into them.
--
Yidio is a top rated movie and TV show app with thousands of 4 and 5 star ratings!
5 Stars – “Easy to use. Finally able to view all available sources for shows and movies in one place.” –Tom777767
5 Stars – “Unlike other apps, Yidio keeps track of what you watch, what episode you left off on, updates on when shows are new, upcoming shows .” –414brooky
5 Stars – “Yidio is a great way to search for TV shows and movies across all of your sources like HBO GO, iTunes, Netflix, and so on. It’s easy to use! ...” –Bazial
--
Smart – Don't know what to watch? Yidio helps you discover new movies and TV shows with advanced search, filtering and recommendations.
Simple – Once you find what you’re looking for, just tap play to start watching on your iPad, iPhone or TV (via Airplay, Chromecast or Roku Remote).
Personal – Tell Yidio which movies and TV shows you want to watch. It will notify you when and where they are available.

bluejetty:00140414:ios.name: Good Habits
bluejetty:00140414:ios.summary: Develop skills and keep your new year's resolutions by doing a little every day. Get into the habit and don't break the chain! This app is based on Jerry Seinfeld's advice and makes it easy to keep track of your daily habits, with reminders
bluejetty:00140414:ios.description:
Develop skills and keep your new year's resolutions by doing a little every day. Get into the habit and don't break the chain! This app is based on Jerry Seinfeld's advice and makes it easy to keep track of your daily habits, with reminders so you never forget what you have to do.
Features
- Multiple habit chains
- Set a 'time to do' reminder and a daily deadline for each habit
- See all your habits in a checklist
- At-a-glance view of current and longest chain lengths
- Overdue tasks marked in red
- Calendar view for editing your chains
- Pick habit colors
- Pause and resume habits without losing your old chains
- Supports larger displays of iPhone 6 and iPhone 6 Plus
- Apple Watch app and Today widget let you track your habits for the day without launching the main app
- Apple Watch complication shows your progress for the day
- Home Screen Widget shows your progress for today
Advanced features (in app purchase)
- Record the reasons you broke your chains
- Chain statistics
Keep your habits small so you'll never break the chain. For example:
- Write 500 words every day
- Practice the piano for 15 minutes every day
- Do 20 press-ups each morning
- Meditate for 10 minutes every day
Pick something you want to be great at and do a little every day.

bluejetty:00150021:ios.summary:
Eis um aplicativo que toda mãe deveria ter ao seu alcance.

bluejetty:00150021:ios.description:
Eis um aplicativo que toda mãe deveria ter ao seu alcance.
Não faltam conteúdos sobre crescimento pessoal na Internet. Porém, nem sempre estes conteúdos se conectam à realidade das mães, que vivem desafios, preocupações, dores e alegrias muito únicas. 
Aqui a gente fala sobre a NOSSA realidade. 
Este espaço nasceu para ser um refúgio na era da distração digital. Somos uma geração de mães que foi bombardeada de conteúdos rasos e que se habituou a pular de post em post, de story em story. Sem se aprofundar, sem refletir, sem assimilar.
A palestrante e escritora best-seller Roberta Ferec compartilha reflexões, inspirações, conteúdos de qualidade, baseados em evidências científicas e, também, a sua própria experiência como mãe de três. Seus livros, cursos e redes sociais alcançam centenas de milhares de mulheres no Brasil e no mundo.
Neste aplicativo você vai encontrar conteúdos que vão te ajudar a fugir das distrações das redes sociais, enxergar a vida com mais clareza, tomar melhores decisões e viver uma vida mais inteira.
São áudios, vídeos, entrevistas, cursos, material por escrito e disponível para download e clube de vantagens. Receba, também, notificações com acesso às nossas LIVES exclusivas, transmitidas dentro do aplicativo.
Tudo de um jeito leve, divertido e que cabe na sua rotina.

bluejetty:00095848:ios.description:
Discover messages written for YOU but never sent
Ever wondered if someone typed your name in a text they never sent? Unsent Messages brings you the world's largest collection of anonymous confession messages - inspired by the famous the unsent project phenomenon.
Find Your Hidden Messages
Search through millions of unsent messages to discover anonymous notes that could be meant for you. Like the unsent project, every message represents real emotions from real people who wrote sincerely but never hit send.
Anonymous Confession Discovery
- Discover anonymous confession messages from exes, friends, and secret admirers
- Each message includes emotional words chosen sincerely by the sender
- Browse messages by time period - recent or from years past
Premium features (Paid content)
- Filter by location to find messages from your area (Paid content)
- Search by your name across millions of unsent messages (Paid content)
The Unsent Project Experience
Drawing inspiration from the original unsent project, our platform lets you explore the raw, unfiltered emotions people carry inside. Every anonymous confession tells a story of love, regret, hope, or closure that someone wrote sincerely but couldn't send.
Premium Features:
- Unlimited access to all unsent messages
- Advanced search filters for better discovery (Paid content)
- Daily notifications when new messages match your profile
- Anonymous confession categories (love, regret, friendship, family)
- Save and organize messages that resonate with you
- Color coded emotional context for deeper understanding
Why People Love Unsent Messages:
- "Finally found the closure I needed" - Like the unsent project, but personal
- "Discovered someone still thinks about me" - Anonymous confession magic
- "Better than the original unsent project website" - More advanced features
Like the unsent project, we believe in the power of unspoken words finding their way to the right person.
Whether you're seeking closure, validation, or simply curious about what people really think, Unsent Messages offers a sincerely emotional journey through the world of unspoken feelings.
Download now and discover what messages are waiting for you.

bluejetty:00126977:ios.description:
Timelines is an easy-to-use yet powerful time tracking app that helps you understand how you spend your day, improve your productivity, and build better habits. Track work, personal activities, health routines, and daily habits in one place, then visualize your time with an interactive timeline and charts to uncover patterns and make the most out of your time.
I personally wasn't happy with the way I was spending my time, so I decided to build a tool to help myself and others figure out a way to become more efficient. Timelines has been enabling me and other users to understand where our time is actually going, helping us improve our routines, build better habits, increase productivity, and achieve more in our personal and professional lives. I sincerely believe it can do the same for you.
– Lukas Petr, founder of Timelines
Timelines has been featured by Apple (New Apps We Love, App of the Day), and reviewed on 9To5Mac, MacStories, Tech Crunch, The Verge, Wired, and more.
▶ WHAT CAN YOU TRACK?
Timelines can help you track and understand how you spend time across all areas of your life:
- Work tasks and projects
- Personal activities and daily routines
- Habits and self-improvement goals
- Workouts, sleep, and health data
- Study sessions and learning
- Hobbies, side projects, and free time
- Family and social activities
- Anything you can imagine
▶ QUICK TIME TRACKING
- track time spent on work, habits, health, or any activity you want
- control tracking with just 1 tap
- grid mode of timers
- track from Home Screen with powerful widgets
- see your current activity on Lock Screen as a Live Activity
- easily edit and add past events
▶ POWERFUL VISUALIZATIONS
- see how you spend your time on an interactive timeline
- playful statistics mode with pie chart
- see trends over time using bar chart
- subcategories - breakdown of your events
- quickly filter categories
▶ SYNC BETWEEN DEVICES
- have an always up-to-date backup of your data with Timelines Cloud
- sync between your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, in real-time
- sign in using your email address or your Apple ID
▶ TIME-BASED GOALS
- define daily, weekly, and monthly time-based goals
- see your progress and stay on track
- periodic reports with rich notifications
- get rewarded for reaching a goal with confetti
▶ AUTOMATIONS
- build workflows with Siri Shortcuts
- use Siri to start and stop timers
- import workouts, sleep, and meditation from Apple Health
▶ AND MORE
- detailed PDF and CSV exports
- timely and customizable reminders
- archive unused categories
- lots of possible customizations
▶ APPLE WATCH APP
- watch face complication for quick access
- haptic feedback on start and stop of timers
- set event names using dictation or choose from recent
- adjust start and end times using the digital crown
- see active timer’s duration and category on watch face
- real-time sync with iPhone and iPad using Timelines Cloud
- see list of past past entries and edit them easily
- daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly statistics
▶ WHAT IS FREE?
- track up to 3 categories
- basic exporting
- pie chart
- see events on a timeline
- events log
- reminders
▶ TIMELINES PRO
- sync between devices
- unlimited categories
- bar chart
- goals
- detailed exports
- import from Apple Health
- subcategories
- support development
Timelines has been in active development for over 9 years now. Lots of effort, attention and care went into every detail of the app.
Start taking control of your time today. In just a few days, you'll begin to understand your habits, improve your productivity, and make better decisions about how you spend your time.
I love working on Timelines, and a big part of my vision is to listen closely to users and incorporate their feedback. If you have any questions or suggestions, please reach out to me at
lukas@timelines.app.
– Lukas Petr, founder of Timelines
* Privacy policy: https://timelines.app/privacy/
* Terms of Use: https://timelines.app/terms/

bluejetty:00126961:ios.summary:

If you have ever used a scale regularly you know this problem:
Your weight fluctuates from day to day and it’s dif
bluejetty:00126961:ios.description:
Your weight fluctuates daily. In contrast to other apps Scelta compares weekly averages and shows your real weight progress!
If you have ever used a scale regularly you know this problem:
Your weight fluctuates from day to day and it’s difficult to say whether you gained weight, lost weight or just had a heavy day. Salty food, hydration status, sleep, stress, and hormonal fluctuations are just some of the many factors that can influence your weight heavily in the short term.
To know what’s really going on you need to compare averages to each other. - eg. the average of the last 14 days to the average of the 14 days before. The difference, also known as delta, between these time spans is a very informative indicator of what really happens to your body weight.
Scelta calculates this “scale delta“ for you and makes weight tracking approachable, meaningful, a lot of fun and incredibly motivating.
Data visualisation of the next generation:
• Your real progress: Scelta compares your average weight for the selected time span to the previous time span, eg. 7 days vs 7 days prior
• Linear regression instead of peaks and valleys: A line of best fit shows your actual weight trend graphically
• Reach your own goal: select eg. “- 1 lb per week” (or “- 0,5kg per week” depending on your local unit) and see at a glance how good you’re doing by taking a look at your adherence percentage
• Hear your weight: Swipe on the graph to see the exact value of a data point and its linear regression, hear and feel (on devices with Taptic Engine) the value of your weight entries (you’ve never seen, heard or felt your weight this way!)
• Scelta shows your total progress and how far you have come since you started your goal
• After setting a new goal (eg. a lean gaining phase after losing fat) you can still go back to older goals to see your previous progress
• See a graph of your goal adherence for every day since you first set your goal. Swiping on it reveals your weekly rate of weight change and how well you adhered to your goal in the 7, 14 oder 30 day average comparison on that day. There has never been anything like it before.
And because everything is more fun as a game:
• The RPG where you are the main character: Collect Scelta Points by reaching your own goal and level up
• Prolific story: Unlock many different achievements for your adhering to your weight adventure
• Online leader boards: Compete with your friends or users worldwide to see who accomplishes their personal weight goals best
Losing weight on a fat-loss diet, keeping your lean-gaining phase in check or if you’re just trying to maintain your current weight:
Weight Tracking has never been this fun!
What position will you reach with your personal progress in the leader boards?
Download Scelta now and try it today!
———
Scelta integrates with the Apple Health app:
Scelta uses the Health app that is pre-installed on your iPhone to show already existing weight data and to save new entries. Because of this Scelta will ask you to grant read- and write-access to your weight data.
Your weight is only visible to you and is not sent or visible to anyone but yourself.
Achievements you unlock and points you collect to climb the leader boards are a result of how well you adhere to your goals and not your actual weight entries. The goal you set for yourself is not visible to anyone else as well.
Scelta Terms of Use - https://www.waldow.app/terms-scelta/
Scelta Privacy Policy - https://www.waldow.app/privacy-scelta/

This is a recordkeeping app. It does not offer gambling games, accept wagers, handle gambling funds, or award cash prizes.
FREE FEATURES
Calendar and notes
Record amounts spent and returned, add notes, and review daily and monthly net results on a calendar.
Reports and charts
See your total net balance, amounts spent and returned, record count, win rate, and averages. View daily results and your cumulative balance on a chart, with an expanded view for a closer look.
Custom tags and filters

CSV export

iCloud backup
Manually back up and restore your records with iCloud. An iCloud account is required. Records are not automatically synced between devices.

- Tag comparison: compare net results, record counts, and averages across your tags in one view.
- Monthly analysis: review monthly net results and an annual total, then open a month for more detail.
- Unlimited tags: remove the 9-tag limit.
- Ad removal.
Basic recording, reports, tag filtering, CSV export, and backup remain free.

bluejetty:00097327:ios.name: Driver Power App
bluejetty:00097327:ios.summary: This App is designed for people with disabilities who is legal to drive, especially those with autism, ADHD, a developmental delay, or any person who doesn’t have a neurotypical brain who want to get a job as a gig delivery driver. This app
bluejetty:00097327:ios.description:
This App is designed for people with disabilities who is legal to drive, especially those with autism, ADHD, a developmental delay, or any person who doesn’t have a neurotypical brain who want to get a job as a gig delivery driver. This app helps support diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility and create new barriers to opportunity for those less abled.
This app has used iPhone’s accessibility features, and it’s a complete game changer for those with neurodivergent brains (for example, those of us who have trouble concentrating on more than one thing at a time). The delivery apps are not fully ADA compliant, very distracting (including extremely distracting beeping) and forcing a decision making within seconds while a person is driving. This introduces extreme distraction especially to people who are differently abled. This app helps you accept delivery orders that are good for you and a great tool for people who simply cannot do math well, especially while driving. 
Use this app and keep all of us safer (not just keeping drivers safer but also others on the road safer)and not accommodating those of us with neurodivergent brains.
Having a job is very encouraging and enriches nearly every one’s lives, as it makes a person feel self sufficient. This app allows people who are differently abled to get a job even those who cannot drive because of a mental or physical disability but have a driver and can perform every other duty of the job very well. 
This app is a great safety tool for every driver to use, especially those with disabilities who struggle with math and may get taken advantage of because of this disability. It evens the playing field so everyone who is legal to drive, especially those with autism, ADHD, a developmental delay, or any person who doesn’t have a neurotypical brain
Supported Platforms: 
- Uber Eats
Key Features
Offer Calculator:
- Calculate offer numbers before you accept a delivery offer. Get the real picture of what your delivery offer by the gig apps is providing. 
The Offer Calculator helps you determine:
- Gas Cost for the specific offer trip 
- Hourly pay per hour
- Earnings after gas 
Track Driving Hours:
- Use our precise hour log to track driving hours effortlessly. At the end of your trip, view a map detailing the area you covered.
Gas Tracker:
- Monitor your gas usage in real time to ensure you are earning more than you spend on fuel.
Gig Expenses Tracker:
- Keep a record of all your gig-related expenses to better manage your finances.
Distance Tracker & Drive Tracker:
- With our accurate distance tracker and innovative drive tracker, measure every mile you cover as a dedicated delivery.
Remember IRS still requires detailed records of your miles, deliveries, gas expenses, and business costs for your entire gig driving operation, let Driver Power app help with it all.
How We Use This Data
 No data is shared with third parties.
Tax Advise Disclaimer
 Driver Power is not a financial advisor. All information provided by the app is for informational purposes only. Please seek advice from qualified tax professionals.
Affiliations Disclaimer
 This app is not affiliated with Uber(Uber Eats) and that any screenshots are intended solely for personal record-keeping and dispute resolution purposes.
Subscription terms:
- The subscription auto-renews at the end of each term.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://driverpower.app/privacypolicy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00166116:ios.description:
Millennia pass like dreams; seas turn to fields, yet the nightmare lingers.
Returning to the ruins, a glance reveals the terror that remains.
The boundaries between heaven and earth, between self and other, become blurred.
Who are we, and where do we belong in this enigmatic world?
“Paper Bride 6 Nightmare” is the sixth work to the Paper Bride series. Dive into a bewitching dream and immerse yourself in yet another immersive Chinese horror puzzle game!
In this chapter, we will transcend time and trace nightmares back to their origins. How will our protagonists prepare themselves for the ancient horrors that confront them, and unravel this timeless mystery? The Paper Bride series continues to evolve in this new and thrilling work!
[Refined Deep Research]
As always, we delve deep into the intricacies and provenance of Chinese folklore to ensure a professional and authentic experience. Newcomers may not be familiar with this, but we thrive on extensive research—it wouldn’t feel right otherwise.. For fans of our series, we continue to deliver on an immersive experience steeped in traditional culture, without compromise.
[Improved Visuals]
Eerie and otherworldly backdrops, a vibrant outfit system (really?!), and top-tier artwork with stunning visuals.
[Even More Heart-pounding Thrills]
Just a *little* scarier than the previous chapters. Just a little. Still makes for the perfect bedtime story.

bluejetty:00167962:ios.name: Battle Climb Racing
bluejetty:00167962:ios.summary:
Welcome to Battle Climb Racing — an action racing game combining vehicle building, physics-based racing, and PvP battles.
You are not only a racer, but also a battle vehicle engineer. Build your own custom machine, challenge the twelve zodi
bluejetty:00167962:ios.description:
Welcome to Battle Climb Racing — an action racing game combining vehicle building, physics-based racing, and PvP battles.
You are not only a racer, but also a battle vehicle engineer. Build your own custom machine, challenge the twelve zodiac alien tracks, defeat players worldwide through speed, collisions, and strategy, and race toward the ultimate Galactic Championship.
Build Your Own Battle Racing Machine
Customize every part of your vehicle, including engines, tires, suspension, armor, weapons, and boosters. Mix and match different components to create your unique racing style.
Choose between a heavy battle tank, an off-road climbing vehicle, or a high-speed racing machine built for explosive acceleration. Every combination creates a different performance experience. Experiment, upgrade, and build the ultimate battle racer.
Conquer the Twelve Zodiac Alien Tracks
Explore twelve zodiac-themed alien worlds featuring lava zones, traps, deserts, slippery surfaces, steep slopes, and low-gravity areas.
Each track offers unique terrain and challenges. Speed alone is not enough to win. Configure your vehicle wisely, master your driving rhythm, and overcome every obstacle to reach the finish line.
Intense PvP Racing Battles
Enter the multiplayer arena and compete against players worldwide in high-speed battles.
Crash into opponents, use weapons to gain the advantage, and activate boosters at the perfect moment to overtake. Balancing speed, stability, attack power, and defense will determine the final winner.
Unlock Parts and Upgrade Your Machine
Win races, earn rewards, and unlock new parts to upgrade your vehicle. Improve power, grip, balance, defense, and acceleration.
Different tracks and opponents require different strategies. There is no single strongest vehicle — only the best setup for each challenge.
Key Features
Free Vehicle Building: Combine parts to create your unique battle machine
Twelve Zodiac Tracks: Explore diverse alien racing worlds
Online PvP Battles: Racing, crashing, and combat combined
Physics-Based Driving: Master jumps, slopes, and challenging terrain
Extensive Parts System: Customize engines, tires, weapons, armor, and more
Vehicle Progression: Unlock rewards and improve performance
Strategic Customization: Adapt your vehicle for every track and opponent
Online & Offline Modes: Start your galactic racing adventure anytime
Start your engine, build your ultimate battle machine, conquer the twelve zodiac tracks, and become the Galactic Champion of Battle Climb Racing!

• Great fun for Sunday school lessons and activities, too

bluejetty:00137358:ios.description:
Discover thousands of cannabis strains with Al BudTender, advanced search, personalized notes, and expert growing tips. Your complete cannabis reference guide.
Strain Guide is your full-featured hub for quick and easy cannabis strain information. With thousands of cannabis strains, it provides detailed data (including strain reviews, growing information, history, and descriptions), along with the ability to search, save favorites, and add personalized notes.
Introducing Strain Hunter Advanced Search, an advanced tool that aggregates cannabis strain data from multiple sources, analyzes reviews, and resolves discrepancies to provide a reliable, unbiased overview of each strain’s effects, flavors, and characteristics.
This app helps you find the cannabis strains you’re looking for in seconds.
Key Features
 • Al BudTender, a technologically advanced strain assistant that helps you make informed cannabis decisions.
 • Save notes on specific cannabis strains for future reference.
 • Favorite strains to keep everything in one place.
 • Search by terpenes, aromas, flavors, and strain names.
 • Growing and harvesting information by strain.
 • Suggest new cannabis strains.
 • Tailored strain suggestions based on your saved strains.
 • Community ratings and comments to see what other users think.
 • Clean and beautiful interface for fast strain lookup.
 • Advanced filtering and search tools.
 • Adjustable text size.
 • Dark mode.
What You Can Learn
 • Best weed strains based on user reviews and ratings.
 • Growing and harvesting information by strain.
 • Cannabis genetics history and detailed strain descriptions.
 • Strain flavor, aroma, terpene profiles, and effects.
Become a weed pro in no time.
Strain Guide contains up-to-date cannabis information, including the latest growing techniques for each strain.
If you’re new to recreational marijuana, this app helps you track the strains you try and remember which ones work best for you.
Use the search section to find the right strain by aroma, flavor, terpene profile, or name.
Notice
This app is for reference and educational purposes only. Do not make health decisions without consulting a qualified professional. Follow local laws regarding cannabis use. You must be 18+ to download this app.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

listings.description:
You are a legendary treasure hunter, looking for the Stone of Silence, a powerful artifact that got lost in an old temple. There, you will find a series of weird machines full of puzzles to crack to gain your freedom!

Odd Machines: Lost Artifacts is a 3D escape room puzzle game where you have to solve complex mechanical puzzles, discover hidden objects, and unveil intriguing mysteries!

Dive into a world where cryptic vibes, complex mechanisms, and smooth controls from top escape room games blend to challenge your brain skills. You'll tackle unique puzzle sets on a mysterious, gripping adventure. Every machine is crafted to deliver the ultimate escape and exploration thrill.

Play the first 3 levels for free!

SOLVE UNIQUE PUZZLE BOXES
Embark on a puzzling adventure with an eclectic mix of original Victorian machinery, classic and architectural enigmas

EXPLORE AN ANCIENT TEMPLE
Step into a mesmerizing world where every move you make reveals new mysteries and changes!

COLLECT ALL THE FRAGMENTS OF THE STONE OF SILENCE
Once you get all 8 pieces of the lost stone, you'll be transported into a mystical scene where you'll have to crack numeric puzzles to put the pieces together and finally escape the temple

IMMERSIVE AUDIO
The sound effects and tunes are so mind-blowingly good that will whisk you away on an unforgettable, vibe-filled adventure!

MULTI-LANGUAGE SUPPORT*
Odd Machines: Lost Artifacts is available in English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, and Spanish. 

*The game language changes based on the device settings

Never be without the tides again!
You too can carry the tides with you as you walk along the shore, fly into a harbor, or sail off into the sunset. AyeTides XL displays tides and/or currents for over 12,500 locations worldwide. and unlike many other tide apps it does not require a network connection. With AyeTides XL you will never see those annoying ads or be asked to pay for additional features! Sailors, harbor pilots, beachcombers, nature photographers, and more use AyeTides to plan their outings on or around the world's oceans. 
And there are NO ads and NO subscriptions!
Here are some of the things people are saying about AyeTides... 
"AyeTides is a quality professional product”
"Your support has been the best I have experienced!"
“As a harbor pilot in New York I’ve been using your excellent tide and current app”
"I really appreciate the effort that you put into making AyeTides as accurate as it can be. It is a great program that has been very useful to us. I think we have 60 pilots using iPhones and iNavX and your app links in so well."

You can find a station on a map, by name, based on your current location, or set a favorite station and always have it handy.
AyeTides XL is updated regularly and stations are added whenever we find new data. We encourage our customers to contact us if you hare having any issues with the program. 
This app is designed to run on your iPad. It does not run on an iPhone or iPod Touch. If you have multiple devices, you may want to consider our bundle. Get both apps for a discounted price!
This is the only place to install AyeTides. Other websites may look like they have AyeTides, but they do not. We only support iOS, any other version of AyeTides is not ours.

Boy Howdy's Expert Sudoku has four tricky types of Sudokus to try:
• X Sudoku is the same as regular 9x9 sudoku, but both diagonals must contain 1 to 9 once only.
• Hyper Sudoku is 9x9 but with an additional set of four 3x3 blocks that must contain 1 to 9 once only.
• Jigsaw Sudoku is 9x9 but instead of 3x3 smaller blocks, the blocks are shaped like jigsaw pieces.
• Samurai Sudoku (iPad only, because it's HUGE!) is a super combo of five regular 9x9 sudoku puzzles, overlapping on one corner of one of the 3x3 blocks. Note that the normal row/column constraints are only within each 9x9 square.

• Beautiful, easy to read numbers!
• Full UNDO support!
• Fast and intuitive dual-keypad input system - just tap a cell and easily mark your answer or pencil marks!
• Pencil marks are auto-erased as you enter answers! (Can be turned off if you wish)
• Horizontal and Vertical guidelines make it easy to look at your current row and column (Can be turned off if you wish)
• Auto-highlight other cells with the same number as the currently selected cell
• Auto-highlight cells that have a visible conflict
• Auto-highlight pencil marks that have a visible conflict
(All of these highlights can be disabled if you wish)
• Hint function if you get stuck!
• Check your work function, to spot any problems you've got if you're unsure!
• Your progress is automatically saved, all the time, so go ahead and take that call or jump out to any other apps - you can come back and pick up playing right where you left off!
• Sounds can be disabled if you want a quiet game
• You can even listen to your own music while you play
Thanks for playing!

bluejetty:00177708:ios.summary:
Manglish Keyboard is a keyboard extension that makes Malayalam typing super easy:
• Type in English letters and get Malayalam words with our transliteration technology
• Type faster using word predictions
• Easily switch to English with the
bluejetty:00177708:ios.description:
Manglish Keyboard is a keyboard extension that makes Malayalam typing super easy:
• Type in English letters and get Malayalam words with our transliteration technology
• Type faster using word predictions
• Easily switch to English with the language key
• Word predictions and spell-correct is available in English also
• Emoji button is available after pressing 123
Open the app and follow instructions to get your new Malayalam keyboard:
• Enable keyboard from settings
• Activate the keyboard by holding the Globe icon and selecting "Manglish Keyboard"
• Type Malayalam everywhere!
Allowing full access:
• When enabling the keyboard, you may enable "Allow Full Access"
• This allows us to access crash reports and will help us improve the stability of the app
• We respect your privacy. No personal information is collected
• A standard warning is shown when you enable any downloaded keyboard app
How to access settings:
• Tap on the ⋯ button after opening the app and tap Settings. This option will be available after keyboard is activated
• Available settings: sound on key press, vibrate on key press, emoji row, number row
Using the clipboard:
• The clipboard lets you save text that you frequently use and paste them easily
• After you copy any text, it can be viewed from the clipboard by tapping on "Paste copied text". You can use the Pin button to save it permanently
• To show copied text automatically when clipboard is opened, you can change the "Paste from Other Apps" setting to "Allow"
Using stickers to make your chats more fun:
• Open the stickers page by clicking on the sticker icon on the keyboard. Click on any sticker you like to copy it
• Navigate back to your chat app and use your phone's Paste option in the message box
• The sticker will be pasted in the chat. Note that animations are currently sent as GIFs due to technical limitations
Do share your feedback and help us improve Manglish Keyboard. And don't forget to leave a review if you like it.

bluejetty:00073866:ios.description:
Mixing Station allows you to remote control digital mixers from various manufacturers in one unified UI.
The following mixer series are supported:
- Behringer X32 / M32
- Behringer XAir / MR
- Behringer WING
- A&H dLive
- A&H Avantis 
- A&H GLD
- A&H iLive
- A&H CQ
- A&H SQ / SQ+
- A&H Qu (new and legacy)
- Midas HD96
- PreSonus StudioLive3
- Soundcraft Si / Vi / Ui
- Mackie DL32S/16S DL32R DL1608
- Yamaha DM3 / DM7 / TF / CL / QL
- TASCAM Sonicview
- QSC TouchMix
- Violet Audio dMix
- Blackmagic Fairlight Live
You can fully test the app without a license!
Features:
- Fully customizable UI
- Create unlimited DCAs (IDCAs)
- Re-Gain / Clipping protection
- Customizable layers, layouts, channel strip and app theme
- RTA overlays
- Channel linking ganging
- Gain reduction history for gate and dynamics
- Peak hold for all meters
- MIDI support for external control
- High contrast mode for outdoor usage
- Popgroups
- Routing Matrix
- Mix copy
- Mixer independent channel presets and scenes
- FX presets
- Feedback detection for ringing out wedges
- More features available depending on the connected mixer model
- Community feature for sharing presets, themes and more with other users
Note: This app is not a DAW! It does not play any audio! It is for remote controlling only.
For more details visit the manual: https://mixingstation.app/ms-docs/feature-list/

bluejetty:00061169:ios.description:
With BookBeat, you can easily enjoy more than 1 million books, right at your fingertips. We have audiobooks and e-books for all tastes that are available to you at any time on your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. 
Try BookBeat – Find your next book today. 
We have new releases and classics in English as well as German, Spanish, French, Italian, Swedish, Finnish and other languages. Listen to an exciting thriller or read an interesting biography and find your next book with our inspiring tips and top lists. 
You can even download books to your device, so you can enjoy a great story when you don't have mobile data or wi-fi. This works on your iPhone, iPad and even your Apple Watch. Go running with your watch and leave your phone at home or listen through CarPlay during a long car ride. 
More about BookBeat 
• No commitments, cancel whenever you’d like 
• Stream or download audiobooks to listen offline 
• Get inspired by BookBeat’s recommendations and trending lists both for audiobooks and e-books. 
• Choose how much you want to listen and read each month based on your selected package. 
• Family account with up to 5 profiles. 
• Switch to a children's profile and get content tailored for kids in the app. 
• Use the timer function before bed 
• Choose your own playback speed 
• Share your book tips with your friends 
• Place a bookmark in your audio book and add a note to easily find your favorite part again 
• Stream or listen offline even on your Apple Watch 
• Discover your listening and reading habits with our User Statistics feature and share your stats with friends. 
BookBeat supports 
• iPhone 
• iPad 
• Apple Watch 
• CarPlay 
• Dark Mode 
• VoiceOver & accessibility 
We love feedback from our customers! If you have new ideas, opinions or problems you'd like to share, reach out via e-mail at support@bookbeat.com. When you contact us, we will process your personal data, such as your name, contact details, and the content of your inquiry. The processing takes place, among other things, to be able to handle your case. Read more in our privacy policy for information about your rights.

bluejetty:00114643:ios.description:
Pencil Loop! is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game where you sharpen pencils, move objects through a loop, and reveal colorful images step by step. Designed for fans of casual puzzle games, Pencil Loop combines smooth visuals with simple logic mechanics for a calming yet addictive experience.
This color match puzzle game is easy to play but challenging to master. Each level introduces new patterns, color combinations, and loop mechanics that keep the gameplay fresh and engaging.
How to Play
Move pencil boxes through the loop, sharpen and color them correctly, and reveal the hidden picture underneath. Every action matters. Plan your moves, solve the puzzle, and complete the artwork.
Pencil Loop is perfect for players who enjoy logic puzzles, color puzzles, and sort-style puzzle games.
Features
-Simple one-touch controls for easy puzzle gameplay
-Relaxing puzzle experience with no timers or pressure
-Satisfying reveal mechanics and smooth animations
-Hundreds of handcrafted puzzle levels
-Offline puzzle game – play anytime, anywhere
-Casual gameplay suitable for all ages
Why Play Pencil Loop?
If you like relaxing puzzle games, loop puzzles, or satisfying brain games, Pencil Loop offers a unique twist with art-based progression. It blends the calming feel of casual puzzle games with the challenge of logic and sorting puzzles.
Whether you want to relax, train your brain, or enjoy a visually satisfying puzzle game, Pencil Loop is the perfect choice.
Free Puzzle Game
Pencil Loop is free to play with optional in-app purchases.
Download now and enjoy one of the most satisfying puzzle games designed for relaxation, focus, and fun.

Transform your lifestyle with the 75 Soft App. Unlock your potential for 75 days with a sustainable program meant to fit your lifestyle. The program will push your limits, inspire discipline and help you achieve your goals. It’s time to prioritize your well-being on the journey with the 75 Soft Challenge app. 
With 75 Soft, you commit to a powerful daily routine aimed at enhancing your physical and mental well-being. For 75 days straight, you'll engage in four core activities, pushing yourself to new heights:
45-Minute Workout:
Dedicate yourself to a 45-minute workout session each day. Use our workout tracker for any style of workout including cardio, HIIT, and strength training. 
Book Reading:
Expand your horizons and nurture your mind by reading 10 pages of a book each day. Dive into captivating stories, gain knowledge from self-improvement books, or explore new genres. By committing to daily reading, you'll sharpen your intellect, boost creativity, and discover the joy of learning.
Hydration Goal:
Stay refreshed and invigorated by consuming a minimum of 3 liters of water every day. Proper hydration is vital for optimal bodily functions, supporting your overall health, and providing sustained energy throughout the day. Track your water intake effortlessly and witness the positive impact it has on your well-being.
Healthy Diet:
Nourish your body with a wholesome, nutritious diet. Enjoy a wide range of delicious and balanced meals that fuel your body with essential nutrients. The app provides daily meal suggestions, taking the guesswork out of healthy eating. Discover new recipes, maintain portion control, and cultivate a sustainable eating pattern for long-term success.
The 75 Soft app offers a host of features to ensure your journey is smooth, motivating, and well-tracked:
Progress Tracking:
Effortlessly monitor your daily progress in all four categories. The app provides intuitive trackers to record your workout sessions, book reading progress, water intake, and meals. Visualize your achievements and witness your growth over time, providing you with the motivation to keep pushing forward.
Personalized Insights:
Gain valuable insights into your progress and habits. The app analyzes your data to provide personalized feedback, helping you make informed decisions and optimize your daily routine.
Download 75 Soft Challenge now and unlock your potential for 75 days of self-improvement, discipline, and a healthier lifestyle. Join the growing community of individuals who have embraced this powerful challenge and witness the incredible results that await you. It's time to prioritize your well-being and transform your life, one day at a time.
By starting the 3-day free trial, the subscription renews at $9.99 a year after a three-day free trial. By subscribing, you agree to our terms and the auto-renewal.

bluejetty:00100369:ios.description:
SwiftClean helps you maintain a clean and organized device by optimizing your photos, videos, contacts, and calendar while offering essential device care tools. Improve storage, manage media efficiently, and enhance your device performance in one place.
Features:
Photo Optimization
Identify and remove similar or duplicate photos, as well as unnecessary screenshots, to free up storage while keeping meaningful content.
Video Optimization
Find similar clips and the largest videos occupying space. Review and clean them easily. Use the built-in video compressor to reduce file size without noticeable quality loss.
Contacts Manager
Merge duplicates, remove empty entries, and maintain a clear and accurate contact list.
Calendar Organizer
Clean old or duplicate events to keep your schedule structured and easy to manage.
Device Care Tools
Device status and OS check
Battery health insights
AdBlock for a smoother browsing experience
SMS filtering to reduce unwanted and promotional messages
Subscription Information
Weekly: $9.99 with a 3-day free trial
Monthly: $19.99
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at the time of confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your App Store account settings.
Privacy & Data Use
All analysis and cleaning processes occur directly on your device. SwiftClean does not upload, store, or share your personal photos, videos, contacts, or calendar data.

bluejetty:00176095:ios.description:
Introducing ShowingTime’s next generation mobile app, a modern, comprehensive toolkit designed to revolutionize how you manage real estate showings, gain invaluable market insights and enhance your productivity. This next generation experience helps you stay connected and transparent with clients and spend more of your time marketing listings and growing your business.
ShowingTime provides residential real estate agents, teams, offices, associations and MLSs with tools to manage showings and feedback, plus analytics and reporting tools to gain valuable marketing insights.
Join the hundreds of thousands of agents who rely on ShowingTime's cutting-edge mobile app, the go-to resource for scheduling showings, generating feedback and optimizing your business. ShowingTime+ products are used by hundreds of MLSs representing more than 1 million real estate professionals across the U.S. and Canada.
Why choose ShowingTime?
Effortlessly Schedule and Access Showings: Take control of your busy schedule with our intuitive mobile app. Seamlessly schedule showings, view instructions and access vital details anytime, anywhere. Buyers’ agents can plan a tour in minutes with an optimized Smart Route, adding multiple properties to a tour directly from the MLS and placing them in a cart.
Discover Listings Near You: Explore a vast selection of listings available for showings in your immediate vicinity. Effortlessly find properties that meet your clients' needs and take advantage of opportunities right at your fingertips.
Streamline Communication with Clients: Keep your clients in the loop by easily sharing listing activity and other important updates. Build trust and maintain strong relationships by providing timely and transparent information.
Manage Feedback Effectively: Gain valuable insights from buyers and colleagues by effortlessly managing and analyzing feedback for your listings and easily sharing it with your sellers. 
Personalize Your Experience: With a variety of interactive calendar views, you can view your showing appointments in the way that best fits your needs. Additionally, customize your viewing experience with multilingual support, or toggle between light and dark mode to fit your preferences or the time of day.

bluejetty:00168849:ios.description:
Experiencing struggles with math problems? The Math Solver app is here to save the day! Designed to provide quick answers and clear explanations, the app covers a wide variety of math topics. Whether you’re dealing with Algebra, Geometry, Functions, Calculus, or else, our app for math help is here for you. Just take a picture of your math problem or equation and get it solved right away!
HOW IT WORKS
Use Math Solver to handle any math problem and get the answer in a few easy steps:
Take a picture of your problem. Use your phone camera or the existing image in your gallery.
Crop the photo. Make sure that the photo includes only the area with the required math problem.
Get the answer. Once the image is scanned, the picture math solver will pick the right formula and provide the correct answer.
Why do you need Math Solver?
Here are the reasons why Math Solver is your best bet when dealing with complex math exercises.
► INSTANT SOLUTIONS
No need to waste time typing your math equation in Google search or texting your math-savvy friends to help you. Just take a picture of your problem and use our Math Solver tool to find the solution right away.
► CLEAR EXPLANATIONS
Forget about guesswork! Math Solver will not only provide the correct answer, but also detect and reveal the specific formula behind it. Learn and improve with step-by-step explanations of every task.
► VERSATILITY
Whether you’re a student, teacher, professional mathematician, or just a curious learner, our Math Solver got you covered. Suitable for various types of tasks and use cases, from simple arithmetic to advanced math equations, our solution is the best fit for any mathematical needs.
► ACCURATE ANSWERS
Our math app uses advanced methods and technologies to recognize various formulas and solve complex problems, providing error-free results.
The app can solve a wide range of problems including basic arithmetic, fractions, word problems, equations with variables, graph plotting, derivatives and more.
 It supports both school-level and college-level math, helping with topics in algebra, calculus, trigonometry and beyond.
 As a reliable tool for math learning, it turns solving problems into a consistent, step-by-step process that helps build real understanding over time.
It is also helpful for parents assisting children with homework, adult learners reviewing forgotten topics, and teachers who need fast solutions to check.
 Whether you're preparing for exams or learning new topics, Math Solver becomes your personal math companion throughout the journey.
Thanks to step-by-step breakdowns, the app helps you not only get the answer but also learn the process behind it.
This improves your understanding, boosts confidence and makes math more manageable.
Download Math Solver Now:
Join the community of mathematicians and problem solvers who have made Math Solver their go-to app. Download now and witness the transformation in the way you approach and solve math problems.
Solve math problems with no limits with premium access.

bluejetty:00022112:ios.description:
AutoPylot: The #1 Rated FAA-Approved Provider of B4UFLY and LAANC
AutoPylot is the highest-rated FAA-approved provider of B4UFLY and LAANC services and is trusted by over 100K drone pilots for its seamless user experience and powerful features. Whether you’re a recreational flyer or a professional operator, AutoPylot makes flying drones safer, easier, and stress-free.
Why AutoPylot?
FAA-Approved (B4UFLY & LAANC) & Trusted: AutoPylot is the easiest-to-use FAA-approved app, offering unparalleled reliability and a user-friendly interface.
Top-Rated by Pilots: Join the over 100K+ satisfied pilots and enthusiasts who have made AutoPylot the highest-rated drone app on the market.
Key Features
- Instant Flight Readiness (B4UFLY Status Indicator): Instantly know if you are good to fly, need approval (LAANC), or cannot fly in your planned flight area.
- Simplified Airspace Visualization: Take the guesswork out of airspace with clear, easy-to-read maps and advisories to remove uncertainty from your flight planning.
- Near Real-Time Authorizations (LAANC Approvals): AutoPylot is an FAA-approved LAANC provider that helps pilots get fast, near-real-time authorizations for flights in controlled airspace.
- Operational Awareness: B4UFLY, stay informed with detailed data on local drone rules, Temporary Flight Restrictions (TFRs), National Parks, wilderness areas, and wildlife refuges.
- Customizable Safety Checklists: Build pre-, during-, and post-flight checklists and add them to any missions to improve safety. Make tasks time-sensitive to receive reminders via push notifications.
- All-in-One Mission Management: Log, monitor, and edit mission details, access advisories, track weather, create notes, share flights, and more—all in one place.
- Mission-Specific Weather Tools: Plan with precise mission-specific weather insights, including hourly updates, 10-day forecasts, and wind/precipitation maps. Sign up for a free trial of AutoPylot+, our advanced pre-flight planning weather features!
Fly Smarter, Fly Safer
AutoPylot takes the guesswork out of drone flying, helping you confidently focus on your mission. Download the highest-rated FAA-approved app and experience the easiest way to manage your drone operations.
Download AutoPylot today and take flight like never before!
https://www.autopylot.io
AutoPylot: Ready, Set, Fly!
Terms: https://www.autopylot.io/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://www.autopylot.io/privacy/

bluejetty:00165898:ios.description:
KRTV NEWS Great Falls gives you up-to-the-minute local news, breaking news alerts, 24/7 live streaming video, accurate weather forecasts, severe weather updates, and in-depth investigations from the local news station you know and trust.
Connect to your community through our local news app. We're celebrating what makes our community great, giving you context to understand local issues and sharing solutions to help you solve problems.
LOCAL NEWS:
• Get up-to-the-minute breaking news alerts and stories.
• Tap 'Top News' to read the most important news of the day as curated by our local news teams.
• Tap 'Most Recent' to read the news stories published most recently.
• Get full support for Dark Mode and Light Mode based on your device preference.
LOCAL VIDEO:
• Watch our 24/7 live streaming news channel.
• Watch video on demand clips from recent newscasts.
• You're in control over what you want to watch and when.
LOCAL WEATHER:
• Get daily video weather updates from your trusted local weather team.
• Stay up to date with hourly and daily weather forecasts.
• View interactive weather radar to help you track rain, snow and storms.
• Get weather conditions and forecasts for your location.
We're committed to continually improving your experience in our app. Please let us know how we're doing by leaving a review in the App Store.
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00174619:ios.description:
Simply Yoga – Guided Yoga Routines for Every Body, Anywhere!
Start your at-home yoga journey with Simply Yoga, the easy-to-use yoga app designed for all skill levels. Whether you’re a beginner improving flexibility, trying yoga for weight loss, easing back pain, or seeking stress relief, Simply Yoga brings professional instruction right to your device. Begin a daily yoga practice anytime—at home, in the morning, or wherever life takes you.
KEY FEATURES:
YOGA ROUTINES FROM 20 TO 60 MINUTES:
Choose guided yoga sessions that fit your schedule, supporting goals like weight loss, flexibility, and stress relief.
YOGA CHALLENGES:
Stay consistent with yoga challenges that build daily habits, improve strength, and support back pain relief.
STREAMING YOGA CLASSES:
Access 30+ streaming yoga classes across popular styles, including Vinyasa, Hatha, and Yin yoga, led by expert instructors.
BEGINNER TO ADVANCED LEVELS:
Start with yoga for beginners and progress to advanced flows designed for strength, balance, and flexibility training.
VIDEO & VOICE INSTRUCTION:
Follow clear video and voice guidance from certified yoga teachers. Just press play and enjoy home yoga workouts anywhere.
CUSTOM YOGA WORKOUTS:
Create personalized flows from a library of yoga poses to match your needs—whether it’s stress relief, back pain, or weight loss.
FLEXIBLE PRACTICE, ANYWHERE:
Practice offline preset routines for morning yoga, home yoga, or daily practice, so you never miss a session.
HEALTH APP INTEGRATION:
Track your progress seamlessly with built-in Health app integration.
WHY CHOOSE SIMPLY YOGA?
Choosing a yoga app should be simple. With Simply Yoga, you don’t need expensive classes or special equipment—just press play and start practicing. Whether your goal is building strength, improving flexibility, supporting weight loss, easing back pain, or finding relaxation, Simply Yoga fits your lifestyle with routines you can do at home, in the morning, or anytime you have a few minutes. It’s your personal yoga studio, always ready when you are.
Download Simply Yoga today and make yoga part of your daily wellness routine!
