直感的な操作で、だれでも簡単に自分の音声配信チャンネルを開設することができます。
ポッドキャスト設定をすれば、自身のチャンネルのRSS URLをすぐに発行。配信したい各サービスで設定することで、stand.fmからApple Podcasts、Spotify、Google Podcasts、Amazon Mu
bluejetty:00161302:ios.description:
stand.fmは誰でも、どこにいてもスマホひとつで気軽に音声配信ができる「音声配信プラットフォームアプリ」です。ライブ配信と収録放送をどちらもお楽しみいただけます。
直感的な操作で、だれでも簡単に自分の音声配信チャンネルを開設することができます。
ポッドキャスト設定をすれば、自身のチャンネルのRSS URLをすぐに発行。配信したい各サービスで設定することで、stand.fmからApple Podcasts、Spotify、Google Podcasts、Amazon Musicなどへポッドキャスト配信も可能です。
毎日更新される多様な音声コンテンツは、通勤・通学、運動中、寝る前、家事の最中など、いつでも好きなタイミングで聴くことができます。
タレント、アーティスト、お笑い芸人、スポーツ選手、声優、インフルエンサー、YouTuber、子育てパパママ、ニュースと学びなど、配信コンテンツは多岐に渡ります。
【ライブで気軽に楽しく配信】
ライブ配信では、コメントやギフトでリスナーとリアルタイムコミュニケーションをしながら配信ができます。
BGMやエコー・ボイスチェンジなど、楽しく配信できる機能も搭載。
時間制限はなく、ライブのアーカイブ音声を公開することもできます。
※ギフトとコメントの機能はON/OFF設定可能
【収録でじっくり話せる】
話したい内容が決まっている人や音声を編集したい人には、収録放送がおすすめです。
誰でも気軽に「自分のラジオ番組」を実現することができます。
音声の切り取りや挿入といった編集や、BGMをつけることもアプリ上でかんたんにできます。
【離れていても、友だちとコラボができる】
相手もstand.fmのアプリをダウンロードしていれば、複数人での会話をライブや収録で配信することができます。
ライブ配信では10人、収録放送では4人まで同時にコラボすることができます。
【レター（お便り）で話題にも困らない】
レター機能を使うと、あなただけが見える形で質問や感想をかんたんに受け付けることができます。
レターでもらった話題に、音声でお返しするのがおすすめです。
【音声配信をもっと楽しく】
・会員限定のライブや収録を届けることができる「メンバーシップチャンネル」
・収録放送を有料販売することができる「コンテンツ販売機能」
・審査承認をされたチャンネルには、再生時間に応じた収益をお支払いする「SPPプログラム」
・音声ファイルをBGMとしてアップロード
・160曲以上あるstand.fmオリジナルのBGM
・事前に投稿日時を指定できる「予約投稿機能」
・配信URLを知っている人だけが聴ける限定ライブ、収録
・mp3, m4a, wavといった音声ファイルのアップ
・ライブや放送の予定、日常のつぶやきを投稿できる「告知機能」
・チャンネルのRSS URLを即時発行できる「ポッドキャスト設定」
stand.fmは音声配信をもっと気軽に楽しくするために、継続的な機能改善と新機能の提供をしていきます。
＜お問い合わせについて＞
アプリ内のマイページ → 設定画面 →「よくある質問・お問い合わせ」→ 「stand.fmについて」よりご連絡ください。
＜公式SNSアカウント＞
・Twitter　https://twitter.com/standfm
・note　https://note.com/standfm/
・Instagram　https://www.instagram.com/stand_fm/
・stand.fm　https://stand.fm/channels/61d6a136299c4d5005689105
＜利用規約とプライバシーポリシー＞
・stand.fm 利用規約　https://stand.fm/terms
・stand.fm プライバシーポリシー　https://stand.fm/privacy

bluejetty:00126996:ios.description:
Метод Тичера — программа для последовательного изучения английского: от нуля до продвинутого. Смотрите и слушайте объяснения преподавателей, проходите тренировку после каждого урока и экзамен после каждой темы.
Вам доступны 5 курсов:
Первый — для изучающих английский язык с алфавита.
Второй — для тех, кто знает алфавит и умеет строить простые предложения.
Третий — для тех, кто знает английский на уровне школьной программы.
Четвёртый — для структурирования знаний и увеличения словарного запаса.
Итоговый — для тех, кто знает английский язык, но чувствует барьер в общении с иностранцами.
Курс — это последовательность тем и уроков. Каждый урок включает в себя видеообъяснение темы, за которым следует набор простых тренировок для закрепления усвоенного материала.
Для проверки полученных знаний вы пройдёте интерактивные тесты и экзамены.
Изучайте английский шаг за шагом с приложением Метод Тичера!

bluejetty:00177894:ios.description:
Do you want to explore the underwater world? Have you ever wanted to be a Mermaid Princess?
Enter the world of mermaids and explore the underwater universe. Pretend to be a beautiful mermaid in the depths of the ocean. Take the mesmerizing experience of living underwater just like Mermaids and many other beautiful sea animals. 
This game is made for kids who want to explore the marine world with lots of exciting water games. Enjoy sea adventures like scuba diving and other diving games. Kids can also play different sea games along with sea animals. They can also get ocean experience with various ocean games. 
EXCITING STUFF FOR OUR LITTLE UNDERWATER MERMAIDS
Submarine Ride
Take a trip to the vast blue ocean in your own submarine. Wear pretty mermaid dresses and become a part of the sea animal family in the ocean. 
Underwater Home
In the Mermaid home, you can check out the wonderfully designed room filled with lots of items. Be a princess stylist and show off your skills. Help your character get ready like a Mermaid Princess. 
Supermarket
Whenever your princess is hungry, just head over to the supermarket and get some munchies. Get delicious food items for the characters! There's always something yummy available in this underwater supermarket. 
Hospital 
It's time to become a doctor and cure patients in your own hospital! This isn't an ordinary hospital, it's totally unique! Play doctor games in this pretend hospital and have tons of fun curing sea animals.
...And so much more!
Along with the other features, our little mermaids will also get the experience of an Underwater Salon, Police station, Restaurant, Daycare, and an Accessories Shop. Play with cute characters at these locations and have lots of fun.
Features of the app are:
* 10 unique rooms to explore.
* Play with fun new characters.
* Touch, drag and explore every object and see what happens!
* Kids friendly content without violence or scary treatments
* Made for kids of ages 6-8, but everyone will enjoy playing this game.
Start exploring the deep blue sea right away. Play exciting water games with fun characters. Download now!

bluejetty:00183250:ios.description:
Portillo’s
We're known for our famous Chicago-style hot dogs, Italian beef sandwiches, chopped salad, cheese fries, homemade chocolate cake, and chocolate cake shake. Our Italian beef is slow-roasted for four hours, thinly sliced, and served on freshly baked French bread. Then, it's dipped in hot gravy made with our homemade blend of seasonings that we've been perfecting for 50 years. Haven't tried Portillo's yet? Order an Italian beef, dipped with sweet or hot peppers (add mozzarella if you're feeling cheesy), or a Chicago-style hot dog "dragged through the garden" and you'll see what all the hype is about.
Enjoy these features of the Portillo’s app:
Free Cake on Your Birthday:
Join Portillo’s Perks and get a free slice of our famous Chocolate Cake on your birthday, half birthday, and sign up anniversary!
Delivery: Order delivery from your nearby Portillo’s. Track your order. Receive status updates about your order in real time.
Easy Ways to Pick Up: There are three easy ways: Inside the Restaurant, Delivery, or Curbside pickup at participating locations.
Save your Favorites: Easily save your favorite order and location so you can order quickly and come back again and again. Favorite Portillo’s locations that you order from the most.
Customize your Order: Want your Italian beef sandwich dry, cut in half, with hot peppers and mozzarella cheese and gravy on the side? No problem! Simply customize your Portillo’s favorites to get exactly what you want.

bluejetty:00170379:ios.summary:
Motra (formerly known as Train Fitness) is the first app to offer automatic exercise tracking, using only the motion of your Apple Watch. Trusted by 100,000+ weight lifters, Motra is the future of AI + gym workouts.
Our application monitor
bluejetty:00170379:ios.description:
Motra (formerly known as Train Fitness) is the first app to offer automatic exercise tracking, using only the motion of your Apple Watch. Trusted by 100,000+ weight lifters, Motra is the future of AI + gym workouts.
Our application monitors the motion of your Apple Watch, tracking reps for over 470 unique exercise types – completely hands free! Our app will track push ups, bicep curls, 12 types of bench press, squats, deadlifts, and hundreds more! No more manually logging each set.
This automatic tracking is made possible by our patented Neural Kinetic Profiling, an advancement in AI that allows workout tracking using wrist motion. 
Unsure what to do at the gym? Using the Motra app, you can generate workouts based on your recovery, goals, and fitness data with the help of AI. Our Smart Weights system will recommend specific workout plans, exercises, sets, and weight… entirely customized to you! Let artificial intelligence build the best possible workout for you, and stop guessing what to do at the gym. 
We built Motra because we too are lifters, gym enthusiasts, & fellow athletes, and we're tired of entering a workout log, manually. We believe that a gym workout tracker should be as easy as recording a run, and we’ll stop at nothing to get there. The Motra App is an all-encompassing workout log app that tracks how you move and helps you achieve your strength training goals at the gym. Simply strap on your Apple Watch, and see the magic unfold.
Our application runs on the Apple Watch Series 4 and newer. Unfortunately, we do not support the Apple Watch 1, 2 and 3.
We are very serious about data. We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Our data storage practices are designed to enhance user experience without compromising privacy. We only retain the essential data needed for a seamless experience. Please see our Privacy Policy & Commitment below for more details.
Any purchases will be applied to your iCloud account at the end of your free trial. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime directly from your iCloud account, or on the Motra application. For more information, see our terms of service or privacy policy.
Privacy Commitment: https://motra.com/privacycommitment
Privacy Policy: https://motra.com/privacy
Terms and Conditions: https://motra.com/terms
Support: hello@motra.com

bluejetty:00016061:ios.name: Binky
bluejetty:00016061:ios.summary: Binky is the most stress-free social media app ever! Think about all those times when you want to scroll through a feed on your phone, but you don't want to read depressing news articles or see photos from people who seem happier than you.
bluejetty:00016061:ios.description:
Binky is the most stress-free social media app ever! Think about all those times when you want to scroll through a feed on your phone, but you don't want to read depressing news articles or see photos from people who seem happier than you. Binky gives you the incessant micro-thrills of scrolling through stuff, never knowing what's coming next, without all the hassle. And the things you do in Binky don't end up on a server somewhere for the world to see. It's all the fun of social media with all the privacy you wish you had!
Features:
* An infinite list of random stuff (we call them "Binks"), with pictures. You won't care about some of them, but others will give you a fleeting feeling of satisfaction -- just like a real app!
* Each Bink has a Like button so that you can like it, just like a real app!
* Swipe left or right on Binks, because it's weirdly satisfying, just like a real app!
* Leave a comment! Unlike a real app, you don't have to stress about what to say. Just mash the keyboard and Binky will think of an appropriate comment for you! Where's THAT feature, Facebook?
* A "share" button that doesn't do anything!
* Scroll through over a thousand Binks, including: sawdust, Sam Cooke, rutabagas, laser tag, merman, mascara, puddles, and elbow.
If you read all the way through that last bullet point, you're already hooked. Download it today!

- Prepago: muestra el saldo actual y las recargas realizadas en los últimos meses. También puedes hacer recargas y programar recargas automáticas.
Cotillea y trastea todo lo que quieras, que para eso está ;)

bluejetty:00080954:ios.description:
Embark on a Spiritual Journey with our Bible Study companion application.
Experience a deeper connection with scripture through our app, designed to enrich your faith and provide meaningful insights. Our easy-to-use interface invites you to explore diverse interpretations and gain fresh perspectives on your spiritual path. Our application provides 15 unique versions of the Bible for you to explore. 
Why Choose Our Bible Study App?
- Daily Spiritual Guidance: Discover wisdom and guidance for addressing life's essential questions on love, loss, faith, and the challenges of modern living through in-depth scripture interactions. Engage deeply with the Bible to find answers and insights that help you navigate through life's trials and tribulations, enriching your spiritual understanding and providing solace and strength. Explore meaningful ways to interpret and apply the teachings of the Bible to everyday challenges, enriching your spiritual journey and fostering a deeper understanding of your faith.
- User-Friendly Design: Our intuitive interface is thoughtfully designed to ensure you can focus on your spiritual growth without distractions. Navigate effortlessly through our comprehensive resources, allowing for seamless access to scripture, devotional content, and personalized prayer guides.
## Key Features to Explore ##
- Structured Bible Study Plans: Delve into scripture with structured study plans that cater to your spiritual journey, whether you’re focusing on specific books, themes, or biblical concepts. We constantly add new and engaging Bible Study topics to keep you engaged in your spiritual journey.
- 15 Bible Versions: Explore the Scriptures in your preferred version with our extensive selection of translations. From the timeless King James Version (KJV) to the modern New International Version (NIV), we provide a variety of options including the English Standard Version (ESV), New English Translation, New King James Version (NKJV), Amplified Bible, and New American Standard Bible (NASB).
- Experience the Bible in a Whole New Way: Our Bible Study app brings the scriptures to life with audio support for all 15 Bible versions. Immerse yourself in the Word with audio narrations not only for the full texts but also for specific Bible Study passages and devotionals.
- Interactive Bible Trivia: Enhance your biblical knowledge with fun and challenging trivia games. Test your skills with thousands of questions and three difficulty levels to keep you entertained for hours on end.
- Verse Locator: Easily find specific verses and explore their context and meanings. Ask questions and receive real-time support on tough and confusing topics within the scriptures.
- Personalized Devotionals & Prayers: Start your day with devotionals and personal prayers that are tailored specifically to your spiritual needs and preferences. Our app helps you deepen your connection with the Divine by offering customized content that aligns with your faith journey.
- Engage with Biblical Figures: Dive into unique dialogues with iconic biblical characters like Peter, Moses, the Virgin Mary, and John the Baptist. Our app's advanced character simulations are informed by their historical teachings and life stories, providing you with insights as if chatting directly with these revered figures.
## Join the Conversation ##
- Explore the integration of faith with everyday life, examining its influence on personal relationships, professional pursuits, and overall well-being. Uncover new facets of your spiritual journey as you learn how religious principles can guide and enhance various aspects of your existence, from interpersonal connections to business ethics
For more information on our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, please visit:
https://pixelpioneersllc.com/terms
https://pixelpioneersllc.com/privacy

bluejetty:00158274:ios.description:
Now more and more people are trying the new dietary method of intermittent fasting.
As a dietary method, intermittent fasting has rapidly become popular worldwide in recent years, attracting a large number of people to try it. This dietary pattern is not only considered an effective weight loss method, but also believed to bring benefits to physical and mental health.
What is intermittent fasting?
Intermittent fasting is a dietary pattern that cycles between fasting and a normal diet. It doesn't specify which foods you should eat, but when you should eat them.
Intermittent fasting does not involve tracking calories. This dietary approach is mainly achieved by limiting the daily eating time, rather than by accurately calculating the amount of calories or protein, fat, and carbohydrates consumed.
HealthKit：
We import your exercise data from Apple Health to help you understand your daily exercise routine.
The intermittent fasting app will provide you with:
Fasting Tracking:
Intermittent fasting is tracked according to your fasting plan, and you can check your fasting progress at any time to see which stage of intermittent fasting your body is currently in.
Weight Tracking:
Record the trend of weight changes through daily weight check ins.
Drinking water tracking:
Set daily drinking water goals and track completion status.

Play the all-new online fantasy RPG based on the new hit anime, The Eminence in Shadow!
◆ Experience The Eminence in Shadow's epic story modes!
Continue the story with new chapters, beat exciting new challenges and get the latest characters after every new episode with anime-updates!
Featuring cutting-edge 3D graphics and anime cutscenes, Master of Garden's story spotlights characters with memorable scenes from the anime and untold events from the light novels!
Whether you're a fan of the light novels, or have yet to see The Eminence in Shadow, Master of Garden's story is sure to satisfy any anime fan!
◆ Every original "Seven Shadows Chronicles" and event story is supervised by Daisuke Aizawa, author of the original light novels!
Discover the fate of the Seven Shadows during their "missing two years" away from Shadow only in "Master of Garden"!

Destroy your enemies in exciting anime-style 3D graphics!

Plus, specific matches will result in special battle animations you can't see anywhere else! Share your favorite secret moves on social media!

Master of Garden's unique battle system generates combos based on your party's action order!
Strategize your best move from near-infinite character-order combinations!

Talk to your favorite girl on the Home Screen every day!

Experience the most elegant and precise Islamic app on the App Store.
Qibla Finder is reimagined with a stunning "Dark Cinematic" design, combining spiritual serenity with cutting-edge technology. Whether you are traveling or at home, find the Kaaba instantly and never miss a prayer.

GUARANTEED OFFLINE ADHAN

AR QIBLA & SATELLITE MAP
- Augmented Reality (AR): See the Holy Kaaba visually placed in your real-world surroundings using your camera.
- Satellite Precision: View your exact path to Makkah on a detailed map with high-contrast glass controls.
ROYAL QURAN EXPERIENCE
- Read the Holy Quran with the classic "Page-by-Page" feel.

HIJRI CALENDAR & EVENTS

- Auto-adjustment logic to align with your local moon sighting.
DARK CINEMATIC MODE
- Designed to be easy on the eyes during Fajr and Isha.
- A premium, ad-free aesthetic that respects your focus.
PRIVACY FIRST
We do not track you. Your location data stays on your phone and is used strictly to calculate Prayer Times and Qibla direction.
Download now and elevate your daily spiritual journey.

bluejetty:00185116:ios.description:
Mubeat is a platform for global K-POP fans.
*Watch [Stream HD Videos of Your Bias]
-See all of your bias’ videos, from their debut years up to now! 
Watch music shows, variety shows, MVs, and Mubeat original content clips in HD!
*Vote [Help Your Artist Win]
-Fans all over the world can now vote for the winner of Korean music programs like Show! Music Core, various contents in Mubeat Voting, and a THE SHOW TV spot ad!
*Support [Celebrate Your Artist's Anniversary]
-Celebrate your bias' anniversary with subway ads and rewarded video fandom ads through Mubeat Fandom Ads!
*Talk [Interact with Global K-POP Fans]
-Use the Community to interact with global fans, share your artist's info and how you stan them!
[Main Functions]
Your Very Own Hideout [Artist Channel]
Watch HD videos of your favorite artists like BTS, BLACKPINK, TWICE, Stray Kids, TXT, (G)I-DLE, SEVENTEEN, ATEEZ, ITZY, NCT, and GOT7!
[Artist Channel] Follow artists and receive notifications on their latest HD KPOP videos from various Korean TV channels!
Mubeat has everything, from Focused Cams, official MVs, music, and Korean variety shows to Mubeat's original content videos~
Also, they’re organized according to albums/members!
Enjoy all of this for free!
Show Off the Power of Fandoms! [Voting]
- Show! Music Core Global Voting: Global fans, pre-vote in Show! Music Core Global Voting and help your bias win!
- Mubeat Voting: Participate in super fun, Mubeat-exclusive content votes, and win tons of benefits!
- Mubeat I.Q Voting: Got an artist you want to talk to? Get to know your artist by voting for the artist you want to have a QnA with!
Take Charge of Your Bias' Anniversary! [Mubeat Fandom Ads]
Celebrate your bias’ birthdays, debut anniversaries, and comebacks!
Use subway ads and rewarded video fandom ads to gift your bias an unforgettable day.
Shortcut to Becoming a True Stan [Artist Community]
Express and share your love for your bias with like-minded global K-POP fans. The more you share, the more you grow!
For the Real Fans [Mubeat Charts]
Help your favorite artist top the charts by streaming their videos. The video views are reflected on the Real time Mubeat Chart and the Gaon Social Chart 2.0.
*Other Functions
Subtitles, Landscape Mode, Mini Player, Video Download, Full HD Videos, Display Board Notices, Wall, K-POP Quiz.
[Mubeat+ Benefits]
• Unlimited Ad-Free K-POP Video Streaming
• Unlimited Video Download
• TV Connection Via Chromecast
[Required Permissions]
• Device Information (Necessary): to identify devices and check the network conditions
• Photos / Videos / Files (Optional): to access the photo gallery regarding photos for profiles and walls
• Push Notifications (Optional): to notify the user about app services and marketing promotions
Mubeat only asks for permission to access essential functions for the app. Permission to access optional functions will only be asked when the said functions are used. The app can function without allowing the optional permissions.
[Customer Service]
• Address: 7F, 164, Nonhyeon-ro, Gangnam-gu, Seoul (06296)
• Phone Number: +82 2-784-8503, 10:00-18:00 on weekdays
(Lunch break: 12:00-13:00, closed on weekends and public holidays)
Contact support@mubeat.tv regarding issues or inquiries.
[Subscribe on iTunes]
ㆍ Subscription Period: 1 month (Automatically renewed)
ㆍ Subscription Price: USD 4.99 / 1 month (The subscription fee may vary depending on the membership. Check the specific prices on the product purchase page.)
ㆍThe payment will be charged to the iTunes account used to subscribe to the service.
ㆍTo automatically renew the subscription, the account will be charged with the same amount as the current subscription 24 hours before the subscription ends.
ㆍSubscriptions and auto-renewals can be managed through iTunes account settings after purchasing a product.

bluejetty:00128715:ios.name: WeStrive
bluejetty:00128715:ios.summary:
WeStrive allows clients to access fitness programs, track workout progress, and track their fitness journey while allowing personal trainers to run their business and message clients.
From the home page, view the messages from your fitness
bluejetty:00128715:ios.description:
WeStrive allows clients to access fitness programs, track workout progress, and track their fitness journey while allowing personal trainers to run their business and message clients.
From the home page, view the messages from your fitness coach, view your daily fitness statistics, and see your daily nutrition overview. On this page, we also work with the Apple Health App to keep track of your steps and calories burned.
From there, slide over one tab to the fitness calendar that will act as your daily workout planner. When your personal trainer assigns you a fitness plan, asks you to weigh yourself, track your daily nutrition macros, or requests a progress photo - you’ll find that to-do list right here. Clicking on the workout for the day will take you right to the first exercise of your fitness program.
Finally, you’ll spend most of your time in the Train tab. Here, you’ll have a full breakdown of your program week over week. See what days you need to train, the overview of exercises for that day, and then click into the plan to get started.
Once you’re in a plan, you can simply swipe left through exercises to move throughout the program. At the bottom of each screen you'll see a workout timer and the ability to record sets, reps, weight, and time. Each exercise comes with a photo & video so you’re never left in the dark when it comes to form on specific exercises. Recording your fitness programs in the program will help let your trainer know exactly how hard you’re working to achieve your fitness goals.
Trainers & Fitness Professionals - if you’re interested in growing your personal training business, download the app and you can start training your clients today. Through WeStrive, you can bring your fitness online with the number one app for personal trainers. You can instantly run your entire business through our website where you’ll be able to build programs, track client progress, handle billing, and so much more.
Have a great day!

bluejetty:00039585:ios.summary: Ayakkabı alışveriş keyfinizi mağaza ya da bilgisayar ile sınırlı tutmayın! İnstreet uygulamasını indirerek en trend sneaker ayakkabı modelleri ile onlarla uyumlu giyim ve aksesuarları tek tıkla satın alma imkanına sahip olun . Dahası Nike,
bluejetty:00039585:ios.description:
Ayakkabı alışveriş keyfinizi mağaza ya da bilgisayar ile sınırlı tutmayın! İnstreet uygulamasını indirerek en trend sneaker ayakkabı modelleri ile onlarla uyumlu giyim ve aksesuarları tek tıkla satın alma imkanına sahip olun . Dahası Nike, Adidas, Reebok, Puma ya da New Balance gibi dünyaca ünlü markaların en popüler modellerini özel indirim ve taksit imkanlarıyla gittiğiniz her yerde, istediğiniz her saatte satın alın.
In street mobil uygulamada neler var?
İhtiyacınız olan her şeyi instreet mobil uygulamasında bulmanız mümkün! Erkek, kadın ve çocuk için farklı kategorilerde onlarca markanın ürünleri yer alıyor. Sneaker, spor ayakkabı, koşu ve yürüyüş ayakkabısı, günlük ayakkabı, bot, çizme, sandalet, terlik ve outdoor ürünler in street mobil uygulamasında sizi bekleyenler arasında...
Kadın ayakkabı modelleri ve daha fazlası
Instreet mobil uygulamasında kadınların ayakkabı tutkusunu fazlasıyla tatmin edecek pek çok alternatif mevcut. Her mevsim kullanabileceğiniz günlük modellerin yanı sıra kış için bot ve çizme seçenekleri, yaz içinse rengarenk sandalet ve terlik çeşitleri arasından seçim yapabilirsiniz. Instreet’in kadın giyim kategorisinde t-shirt, sweatshirt, eşofman, polar, şort
ve tayt modelleri yer alıyor. Kombinini gözlük, çanta, şapka, atkı, bere ya da eldiven gibi detaylarla tamamlamak isteyenler ise aksesuar kategorisindeki ürünleri incelemeli.
En trend erkek ayakkabı modelleri
Hem hafta sonu hem de hafta içi rahatlığı tercih eden erkekler için pek çok spor ayakkabı seçeneği sunan ınstreet mobil uygulamasında Nike, Vans, Hummel, Skechers, New Balance ya da Adidas gibi markaların en trend modellerini bulabilirsiniz. Yaz ayları için sandalet ve terlik tercih edenler de unutulmuyor. Crocs, Kinetix, Nike, Birkenstock, Havaianas, Lumberjack, U.S. Polo Assn ya da Dockers gibi markaların tasarımları arasından tarzınıza uygun seçimler yapabilirsiniz. Instreet mobil uygulamasında erkekler için özel olarak basketbol ayakkabıları ile halı saha ayakkabısı ve krampon seçenekleri bulunduğunu da belirtmek gerek. Erkek giyim kategorisindeyse tüm ayakkabılarınıza en iyi şekilde eşlik edecek farklı renk ve beden ölçülerinde t-shirt, sweatshirt, eşofman, mont, polar, yağmurluk, şort, bermuda ve forma bulmanız mümkün.
Çocuklar için en renkli seçenekler
Çocukları adına her zaman en iyisini isteyen ebeveynler için oluşturulan ın street çocuk kategorisinde hem erkek hem kız çocuklar için farklı seçenekler yer alıyor. Spor ayakkabıdan bot ve çizmeye, sandalet ve terlikten günlük ayakkabıya kadar aradığınız her modelin en renkli ürünlerini bu kategoride görebilirsiniz.
Onlarca marka bir arada!
Nike, Adidas, Reebok, Puma, Vans, Kinetix, New Balance, Skechers, Asics, Lumberjack, Superga, Palladium, Us Polo, DC, Etnies, Tommy Hilfiger ya da Dockers gibi kendi alanlarında lider onlarca markaya İnstreet mobil uygulaması sayesinde tek tıkla ulaşabilir; güvenilir, kolay ve hızlı alışverişin tadını çıkarabilirsiniz.
İndirim fırsatları cebinizde
Instreet mobil uygulama ile tüm fırsat ve indirimlerden her an haberdar olabilirsiniz. Uygulamanın bildirim seçeneklerini açık tuttuğunuz takdirde size özel uygulanacak indirimi anında yakalayabilir, dünyaca ünlü markaların ayakkabı, giyim ve aksesuar modellerine en avantajlı fiyatlarla sahip olabilirsiniz. Dilerseniz Outlet kategorisine girerek farklı indirimlerden de yararlanabilirsiniz.
Ücretsiz kargo imkanı
Instreet mobil uygulamasından yaptığınız alışverişlerde ücretsiz kargo fırsatı var. 300TL ve üzeri tüm alışverişlerinizde kargo ücreti alınmıyor.
Taksitli alışveriş seçeneği
Uygulama üzerinden alışveriş yaptığınızda farklı ödeme seçeneklerini değerlendirebilirsiniz:
• Kredi kartı ve / veya banka kartı ile tek ödeme
• Kredi kartı ile taksitli ödeme
• Kapıda nakit ödeme
Kredi kartı ile ödemelerde anlaşmalı bankaların kredi kartlarına taksit imkanı da sağlanıyor.

Spor ayakkabıdan bot ve çizmeye, sandalet ve terlikten günlük ayakkabıya kadar aradığınız her modelin en renkli ürünlerini bu kategoride görebilirsiniz.

Onlarca marka bir arada!

Nike, Adidas, Reebok, Puma, Vans, Kinetix, New Balance, Skechers, Asics, Lumberjack, Superga, Palladium, Us Polo, DC, Etnies, Tommy Hilfiger ya da Dockers gibi kendi alanlarında lider onlarca markaya İnstreet mobil uygulaması sayesinde tek tıkla ulaşabilir; güvenilir, kolay ve hızlı alışverişin tadını çıkarabilirsiniz.

İndirim fırsatları cebinizde

Instreet mobil uygulama ile tüm fırsat ve indirimlerden her an haberdar olabilirsiniz. Uygulamanın bildirim seçeneklerini açık tuttuğunuz takdirde size özel uygulanacak indirimi anında yakalayabilir, dünyaca ünlü markaların ayakkabı, giyim ve aksesuar modellerine en avantajlı fiyatlarla sahip olabilirsiniz. Dilerseniz Outlet kategorisine girerek farklı indirimlerden de yararlanabilirsiniz.

Ücretsiz kargo imkanı

Instreet mobil uygulamasından yaptığınız alışverişlerde ücretsiz kargo fırsatı var. 300TL ve üzeri tüm alışverişlerinizde kargo ücreti alınmıyor.

Taksitli alışveriş seçeneği

Uygulama üzerinden alışveriş yaptığınızda farklı ödeme seçeneklerini değerlendirebilirsiniz:

• Kredi kartı ve / veya banka kartı ile tek ödeme
• Kredi kartı ile taksitli ödeme
• Kapıda nakit ödeme

Kredi kartı ile ödemelerde anlaşmalı bankaların kredi kartlarına taksit imkanı da sağlanıyor.

REWIRE YOUR MIND
Built on extensive research in addiction science, our innovative brain-rewiring system guides you step by step to regain control. Transform your mind into your greatest asset.
MAKE EVERY DAY COUNT
Engaging daily exercises help replace temptation with motivation and a fresh perspective. Stop craving, start thriving.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Monitor your improvements in relationships, mental clarity, and overall well-being with our real-time progress tracker. Don’t just notice the difference—measure it.

LEVEL UP YOUR FUTURE
Rebooting your brain unlocks significant mental and physical benefits. Begin today and transform your life permanently.

"Now I feel stable, focused, and confident. Instead of facing massive roadblocks, I see small hurdles that I can step over with ease."
"I feel like a whole new person. I'm more engaged in social settings, sharp at work, and fully present. After years of struggling, I finally feel like myself again."
"The clarity and relief from depression were immediate. I used to think something was fundamentally wrong with me—now I know I just needed to break free. That realization was life-changing."
"Confidence. Walking down the street, I no longer feel self-conscious. I can talk to anyone without fear or hesitation. I’m not arrogant—I just finally see myself as equal to everyone around me. My social anxiety is gone."

bluejetty:00064260:ios.description:
Intro
Tower of Fortune 3 is a retro style Slot/RPG. You play as a hero who must explore the legendary tower and find the way home.
Story
The third tower has been found... Some believe it holds stairs that lead to heaven, while others say it's the remains of an ancient god. After parting with his daughter and wandering through time and space for years, the Hero's only desire is to find his way home. But to reach it, he must travel through nine bizarre worlds within the tower and uncover secrets beyond imagination...
Features
- Whole new combat wheel mechanic: you spin what you equip
- Customize your combat wheel with sword, shield, ring or gun!
- Multiple options for interacting with NPC
- Whole new tavern, including VIP room, gallery and secret places
- Collect trophies for your VIP room to gain special abilities
- Choose your faction and offer tribute to get unique equipment sets
- Slot of Fun: Combat Slot, Event Slot, Trap Slot... and more to challenge! 
- 4 suspects inside; solve the case and find the murderer!
- 9 bizarre worlds with tons of locations, secrets, and dungeons to explore
- 9 endings with 9 powerful rewards. Replay the journey to collect them all
- 20 Achievements to master
- 50+ NPCs to interact with
- 50+ hero skills to upgrade
- 100+ enemies stand between you and your way home
- 150+, 11 equipment types to collect, forge, and upgrade
- Endless spin, respins, and fun!
-----------------------------------------------------------
Facebook 
http://www.facebook.com/TowerofFortune
Gameplay Movie 
https://youtu.be/y-mN79_9qDg

Tahoe Snow Map allows you to quickly view and compare the latest (and past) snow report information for all of the major Tahoe resorts in a single glance by displaying the information on a map of the Tahoe area. Tahoe Snow Map allows you to:
- View the currently reported 24-hour snowfall totals, 3-day totals, or 7-day totals across all resorts. 
- See the same statistics for past dates by swiping left or right on the map, allowing you to see how much snow each resort received yesterday, two days ago, etc. 
- Understand how storms in the Sierra Nevada can impact different parts of the Lake Tahoe region, helping you decide whether to head to North Lake Tahoe, South Lake Tahoe, or Donner Pass. 
- Review a detailed snow history for each resort by clicking on the resort to view the resort-specific page within the app. This allows you to see many days of snowfall history. 
- View base depth statistics across all resorts.
- See the last date each resort received snow by clicking on the "Last Snowfall" button.
- Zoom in on the Donner Pass area (upper left corner of map) to reveal additional ski resorts.
*** Find Your Snow! ***

bluejetty:00123383:ios.description:
SIMPLE, EASY & FAST CALORIE COUNTING
Calory is your ultimate calorie counter and a quick way to count, track & tally your calories during the day.
WHY COUNT CALORIES?
Everyone has a personalized number of calories they should eat every day based on factors including their weight, height, activity levels, and weight loss/maintenance/gain goals. It’s hard to track calorie intake, though, not least because it’s easy to forget everything you eat during a busy day. Recording your calories as you eat gives you a clearer picture of the calories you are consuming. It also enhances your awareness of food values and nutrient levels, all of which helps you make healthier choices when eating.
HOW CALORY WORKS
Based on your weight, height and activity level, Calory will calculate a suggested daily calorie goal for you. The daily goal will also factor in if you want to maintain, lose or gain weight.
After you know your daily energy requirements, your challenge is to eat the right number of calories. Calory, meanwhile, will remind you throughout the day to record your calorie intake. Even better, there is no registration or sign up required! All the information you enter into Calory is stored on your iCloud, protecting your privacy.
GREAT CALORY FEATURES
※ Fasting Tracker
※ Quick Value Add: Instantly add calories you have consumed
※ Create custom plates based on your preferences
※ Daily Calorie Intake Calculator: Advised daily intake tailored to your needs
※ Journal View: Alternative home screen to see all of your data at a glance
※ Today Widget: Quickly log favorite plates
※ Siri Shortcuts: Let Siri log your food
※ Apple Watch app: Quick calorie counting on your wrist
※ Apple Health integration: Read/write dietary data to Apple Health
※ Keep track of your weight: Read/write weight from Apple Health
※ Daily history snapshot where you can review your logged meals
※ Weekly, monthly, and yearly progress charts: A fantastic overview that also helps you make comparisons
※ Custom Reminders / Notifications to keep you on track
※ Dark Mode!
※ Multiple theme colors to choose from so you can customize Calory
※ Ability to change the App Icon
※ NO registration or sign up required! All information is stored and kept on your iCloud
※ AI Food Scanning
※ Macro Tracking: Track macronutrient goals
※ Water Tracker: Track your daily water intake needs
※ Create Custom Foods
※ Recipes
※ Barcode food UPC scanning
REMEMBER:
¤ Stay hydrated
¤ Eat whole foods rich in healthy nutrients
¤ Avoid processed foods
¤ Be more active and move!
-------------------------

bluejetty:00035507:ios.name: StreetPro Racing
bluejetty:00035507:ios.summary: StreetPro invites you to a realistic and exciting driving experience. This game offers 30+ different vehicles and 10+ large maps, allowing you to enjoy all types of driving. The variety of maps gives you various options to test your driving
bluejetty:00035507:ios.description:
StreetPro invites you to a realistic and exciting driving experience. This game offers 30+ different vehicles and 10+ large maps, allowing you to enjoy all types of driving. The variety of maps gives you various options to test your driving skills and have fun.
Maps and Missions:
StreetPro features 10+ maps, each offering different experiences. One of the maps offers a comprehensive vehicle test track. Here you can test your car's performance with suspension tests, slalom and drift courses. The other maps are designed for free roaming, drifting and speeding. You can drive through different areas such as cities and highways, explore freely and reach high speeds. There is also a mission track with 20 levels, full of various challenges and missions.
Vehicle Features:
Vehicles in StreetPro are highly interactive and realistic. Each vehicle has 4 windows and 4 doors that can be opened. You can get out of the vehicle and walk around, open the doors and get in. Vehicles also have detailed interiors; the turn signal lever moves when signaled, gas and brake pedals work realistically. All functions such as wipers, lights, quads and signals work like the real thing. The time slowdown mode makes your driving experience even more enjoyable.
Drift and Modification:
Drift mode offers a realistic and fun drifting experience. There are many options for vehicle modification, from color changes to license plate, from neon lights to headlight light color. The steering wheel, seats, suspension settings and rims can also be changed. Interior decoration options can include various objects such as chicks, spiders, turtles, iguanas and birds. It is also possible to add a computer and game console to the right front seat. You can customize the exterior of your vehicle, such as additional lights and spoilers.
StreetPro is the perfect game to improve your driving skills, customize vehicles and enjoy a realistic driving experience. Realistic graphics, detailed in-car functions and a wide range of modification options take your driving experience to the next level. With fun missions, free roaming areas and impressive drifting features, StreetPro gives you an unforgettable driving experience.

Real Madrid Club de Fútbol is a Spanish professional soccer club based in Madrid.
The club is one of the most widely supported teams in the world. Real Madrid is one of three founding members of La Liga that have never been relegated from the top division since its inception in 1929, along with Athletic Bilbao and Barcelona. The club holds many long-standing rivalries, most notably El Clásico with Barcelona and El Derbi with Atlético Madrid.
Real Madrid was recognized as the FIFA Club of the 20th Century on 11 December 2000 and received the FIFA Centennial Order of Merit on 20 May 2004. The club was also awarded Best European Club of the 20th Century by the IFFHS on 11 May 2010. In June 2017, the team succeeded in becoming the first club to win consecutive Champions League titles, then made it three in a row and four in five seasons in May 2018, extending their lead atop the UEFA club rankings.

bluejetty:00017207:ios.description:
StarMaker Lite is a popular singing app with 50M+ users globally. You can sing on your own, or sing alongside recordings of popular artists. Record your voice, create your MVs, and enhance your voice with professional audio editors. 
Sing Karaoke Songs
Supported by professional music team, the audio editor function offers you the chance to get varied sound effects when recording songs. 
No matter you like Pop or Hip hop, R&B or folk, just pick your favorite songs from millions of songs, sing along with the high-quality backing music and rolling lyrics, edit your recordings with a selection of voice effects and video filters.
Enhanced Singing Experience
Whether you want to sing the newest chart-toppers or timeless classics, the songbook team provides a well-rounded selection with updating songs weekly. Choose songs by Taylor Swift, Morgan Wallen, Drake, Zach Bryan, SZA, Nicki Minaj and more singers freely. Also, you can tailor the songs to your vocal range to give compelling and authentic performances every time.
We have added a bunch of features for a better singing experience! Such as:
+ Pick your favorite songs and latest hits from millions of local and international songs.
+ Record your karaoke recordings with various voice effects like Distant, Warm, Vinyl, Party, Fascinating, etc.
+ Edit your selfie music videos with beautiful filters like Vintage, Paris, Sunset, Urban, Spring, etc.
+ Use Pitch correction to make you sound like a pro singer.
+ ‘Hook’ allows you to sing the best part of your favorite songs! 
Pick from all the hit songs now Including:
+ Heat Waves - Glass Animals
+ Stay - The Kid LAROI & Justin Bieber
+ Easy On Me - Adele
+ Ghost - Justin Bieber
+ Shivers - Ed Sheeran
+ Bad Habits - Ed Sheeran
+ Cold Heart (PNAU Remix) - Elton John & Dua Lipa
+ Thats What I Want - Lil Nas X
+ Need To Know - Doja Cat
+ Enemy - Imagine Dragons X JID
+ Pushin P - Gunna & Future Featuring Young Thug
+ Levitating - Dua Lipa
+ Industry Baby - Lil Nas X & Jack Harlow

b) 1 Month - $14.99

5. bluejetty:00042045:ios.description:
Are you ready to rumble? 
Sequel to the smash hits Mr Bullet and Mr Ninja, a new competitor enters the ring to satisfy your puzzle obsession! With hands that are registered lethal weapons, wearing only his trusty speedo, control Mr Fight as he jumps, flips, flicks, and swipes his way through enemies. This challenge is about much more than just brute strength though, and you will have to flex your brain muscles as well to rise to the occasion. Do you have what it takes to become king of the ring, brother!? 
Outwit your enemies and land the killing blow as you travel to new levels, save hostages, and unlock new fighting skills. Start your adventure now! How quickly can you dispatch your rivals!?
 Game Features:
1. Become the champ! 
Use your brain and your brawn to take out the bad guys. From enemy spies, to zombies, to evil lumberjacks and aliens, they are all in your way on the path to becoming the champ.
2. Endless levels
The challenge never ends with tons of unique levels! How smart are you? Can you solve all the puzzles? Use your fighting skills to make objects fall and explode to create chain reactions and do whatever it takes to win! 
3. Hilarious Physics Puzzler
With skills like these who need clothes! It takes more than just accuracy to make it through. Speed, timing and patience are all things you will need to become king of the ring! Can you get three stars on every level?
4. New Features Constantly Added
Never get bored! Mr Fight is constantly updating with new unique levels, weapons and other skins. You will NOT want to miss out on the action.
If you liked Mr Bullet and Mr Ninja, you will LOVE Mr Fight
Visit https://lionstudios.cc/contact-us/ if have any feedback, need help on beating a level or have any awesome ideas you would like to see in the game!
From the Studio that brought you Mr. Bullet, Happy Glass, Ink Inc and Love Balls!
Follow us to get news and updates on our other Award Winning titles;

bluejetty:00015517:ios.description:
The bell is ringing at the My Town : School! Let your child show you what they’re in their classroom by visiting the My Town classroom. Do your children play an instrument? Let them play some music for you in the My Town music class where they can learn notes and play the piano, strum along to some tunes on the guitar or make some noise on the drums! Become a mad scientist in the science lab, but don’t miss the Tesla before you head out to the school yard where the coach will teach a variety of sports like tennis, baseball, basketball and even badminton!
FEATURES:
*9 brand new locations
*10 experiments to play with and learn from in science class
*8 musical instruments 
*11 new multicultural kids characters all set to learn and play!
*7 brand new adult characters including a three different teachers, a coach, new parents to choose from and even a grumpy principal! 
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room.

The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com

It does this by allowing you to link and manage your Smart products on one app from your smart device.

Manage temperature notifications and probe settings all within the app to get desired doneness levels via Bluetooth pairing with your smart device. 
Use the Kenmore smart thermometer to track grill temperature with an ambient probe, monitor desired grilling results with 4 food probes. 
A WiFi router and Internet connection are required to control devices remotely.
Learn more about Kenmore Smart Appliances at www.kenmore.com/smart.

Relay is the #1 app for anyone seeking recovery from lust or addiction to adult content.

Our mission is to build a platform that is 10x easier and more effective than anything else out there.

bluejetty:00169647:ios.description:
Experience the next generation of AI-powered interaction with Heat - AI Girlfriend Companion – Interactive Chat & Story Experience, a smart virtual character simulator designed for users who enjoy engaging conversations, creative storytelling, and personalized AI interactions. Powered by advanced generative AI, this app delivers dynamic, adaptive conversations with visually rich, anime-inspired characters in a safe and entertainment-focused environment.
Whether you want meaningful conversations, interactive stories, or a creative space to explore different character personalities, AI Companion offers a fully customizable experience tailored to your preferences and interests.
* AI-Powered Smart Conversations Interact with intelligent AI characters that respond naturally and adapt to your communication style. Every conversation evolves over time, creating a unique and personalized experience.
* Interactive Story Experiences Explore story-driven scenarios with engaging character interactions. Discover new dialogues, unlock story paths, and enjoy creative narratives designed for entertainment and imagination.
* Customizable AI Characters Choose from a variety of anime-style characters, each with distinct personalities and communication styles. Personalize your AI companion’s appearance, tone, and interaction style to match your preferences.
* Progression & Unlockables Unlock new content, character interactions, and story elements as you continue engaging with your AI companion. The more you interact, the more the experience grows.
* Safe & Entertainment-Focused This app is designed strictly for entertainment and creative interaction. It does not provide real-world dating services or interactions with real individuals. All characters are fictional and part of a simulated environment.
* Premium Access & Subscriptions Upgrade your experience with premium access, including:
* Full character access and extended story content
* Enhanced AI interaction depth
* Regular content updates and new experiences
Subscription Details:
* Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
* Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
* You can manage your subscription in your Account Settings after purchase.
* Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited upon subscription purchase.
* Premium access is available through weekly, monthly, and yearly plans.
Note:
This app is for entertainment and companionship purposes only. It does not offer real-world dating, live chat with real individuals, or any adult/pornographic content. All characters are fictional and intended for fantasy simulation within a respectful and private environment.

bluejetty:00183476:ios.description:
Never forget who you borrowed money or who you owe money. Who Owes Me - Debt Manager is a simple App to remember debts or split expenses between friends. You can mark debts as paid and always have an overview of money you lent to friends.
You can also use your contacts to quickly add new debts. 
Easy to use interface to quickly manage debts. 
Features
 - Remember debts/IOUs
 - Split expenses (e.g. on holidays or for birthday presents)
 - Cloud Sync between multiple devices
 - Touch/Face ID
 - Multiple folders
 - Notifications
 - Use contacts for faster inputs
 - Over 155 Currencies
 - Part payments
 - Mark as paid
 - Export data
 - Generate PDFs
 - Remind people via SMS/WhatsApp/E-Mail
 - Recurring entries
All pro features, unlimited entries and Cloud Sync between multiple iOS devices can be used after a one time payment or an active auto-renewal subscription. This three in app purchases can be bought in the app.
Subscription informations
 - You can choose between a monthly and a yearly auto-renewal subscription. 
 - Subscriptions include all pro features, unlimited entries and Cloud Sync between multiple iOS devices.
 - The subscription will renew automatically 24 hours before the end of the current period.
 - The subscription price depends on the subscription period you choose.
 - You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your iTunes Account Settings.
Free trial
 - Yearly subscription includes a free trial period.
 - You will not be charged until your trial has ended. 
 - Your iTunes Account will only be charged once your purchase is confirmed. 
 - Any unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited after purchase.
Terms of Service: https://whoowesme.app/tos.pdf

bluejetty:00039801:ios.summary:
Skred is the first secure peer-to-peer instant messaging app - No need for an email address or phone number to use it.
Skred is free, without subscription, without a provider, without a SIM card, and without leaving a trace.
Skred is deve
bluejetty:00039801:ios.description:
Skred is the first secure peer-to-peer instant messaging app - No need for an email address or phone number to use it.
Skred is free, without subscription, without a provider, without a SIM card, and without leaving a trace.
Skred is developed based on privacy-by-design and leverages the highest levels of authorization encryption. Skred enables a private, unique and secure connection with each of your contacts. Only the two participants in a call can communicate with each other excluding anyone else.
With an interface that is easy to use without impacting the learning experience, Skred enables easy exchange of messages, images, videos, voice calls and video calls.
The SkredBoard, which is accessible by simply swiping down, allows for generating many identities that are separated from each other for absolute confidentiality. You can also use groups to exchange with several friends at once.
When you delete a message on Skred, it also disappears from the mobile phone of your caller.
All exchanges are encrypted from start to finish, from mobile to mobile. They are not stored on any server. The encryption technologies are open source and based on the work of hackers and hacktivists of the Guardian Project.
Skred originated from the Skyrock Group, which in turn came from the free radio movement in France. It defends freedom of expression on the air and on the internet.
With Skred, you are free!
Terms of Use: https://www.skred.app/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00153030:ios.summary: This app is a unique puzzle match-3 game based on the principle of "creation before elimination." Unlike traditional match-3 games, players cannot directly eliminate primary elements (red, yellow, blue). Instead, you must combine two differ
bluejetty:00153030:ios.description:
This app is a unique puzzle match-3 game based on the principle of "creation before elimination." Unlike traditional match-3 games, players cannot directly eliminate primary elements (red, yellow, blue). Instead, you must combine two different primary elements to synthesize advanced elements (orange, green, purple), then match and eliminate these advanced elements to complete each level's objectives.
With vibrant visuals inspired by painter's palettes and alchemical magic, each level introduces new challenges, special power-ups, and strategic depth. Enjoy smooth animations, clever mechanics, and a fresh twist on the classic match-3 genre!
Key Features:
Innovative synthesis & elimination mechanics
8x8 dynamic game board with vivid visuals
Challenging levels with clear objectives and move limits
Special elements & obstacles for advanced strategies
Progress saving and intuitive UI

bluejetty:00141911:ios.description:
2Cam – Dual Camera Video Recorder
Capture more of every moment with 2Cam. Record with your front and back cameras at the same time, create reaction videos, vlogs, interviews, tutorials, and more — all from one app.
> Made for Creators
Whether you're filming reactions, daily vlogs, interviews, tutorials, travel moments, behind-the-scenes content, or everyday memories, 2Cam gives you flexible tools to capture both perspectives at once.
> Dual Camera Recording
Record yourself and what’s happening around you simultaneously. Choose your preferred camera layout and easily switch camera positions to create videos that show both sides of the moment.
• Record with front and back cameras at once
• Switch camera positions
• Choose different picture-in-picture shapes
• Adjust the camera overlay directly on the preview
• Record in portrait or landscape mode
• Use flash when available
> Built-In Telepromter
Stay on script without looking away from the camera. The built-in teleprompter helps you record presentations, tutorials, talking videos, and other content with confidence.
• Type or paste your script
• Display your text directly over the camera preview
• Adjust font size and text alignment
• Choose text color and opacity
• Set your preferred scrolling speed
• Play, pause, and navigate through your script while recording
> Customize your Video
Get more control over how your videos look and feel.
• Choose between 24, 30, and 60 FPS
• Select 720p, 1080p, or 4K resolution
• Record in 9:16, 4:3, or 1:1 aspect ratio
• Enable video stabilization
• Adjust audio quality
• Mirror the front camera
• Use a grid for better framing
• Control recording with volume buttons
• Add location data to your media when enabled
> Your Media Gallery
Keep the photos and videos you create organized directly inside 2Cam.
• Browse your recordings by date
• Preview photos and videos in full screen
• Select and manage multiple files
• Save media to your device
• Share your creations
• View video duration and playback progress
• Quickly access your latest capture from the camera
> Autosave
Want your captures saved automatically? Enable AutoSave to streamline your workflow and keep your media ready outside the app.
Some features and recording options may depend on your device capabilities. Certain features require Premium access.
Dual recording is available on:
iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max, iPhone XR, iPhone 11 and above to latest version
Privacy Policy: https://2cam.io/privacy
Terms of Use: https://2cam.io/terms
Contact: support@visionapps.link
Subscription Terms
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You can manage or cancel your subscription through your account settings. Your account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, may be forfeited when purchasing a subscription where applicable.

bluejetty:00083797:ios.description:
Connect, express and celebrate effortlessly with everyone in your life by shopping the Celebrations Passport app! Share the joy of our curated selection of gourmet foods, flowers, personalized gifts, and more to meet all your entertaining needs this fall. 
Gift giving has never been simpler when you can shop from renowned brands like Harry & David, 1-800-Flowers, Cheryl's Cookies, Personalization Mall, and more - all from one app. 
Stuck on what to send someone? Let our app help you find the perfect gift for every occasion, holiday, and moment: 
* Discover unique gifts for everyday moments, special occasions, and the holidays. 
* Snap a photo of a gift from our printed catalogs to navigate to it quickly or explore matching gift ideas. 
* Get inspiration for hosting celebrations and this fall's get-togethers with recommendations from our editors. 
* Set reminders about the people in your life and their special moments, like their birthday, anniversary, or an upcoming wedding! 
Whether you need same-day delivery or prefer planning for weeks or months ahead, our app caters to you and your recipient's scheduling needs. Once you add everything to your cart, check out with ease. 
Explore our extensive range of gifts for every occasion: 
* Browse through gourmet gift baskets for birthday gifts, graduations, saying “Thank You," or...simply to brighten someone’s day from Harry & David. 
* Send a bouquet from 1-800-Flowers.com and experience the convenience of same-day delivery through our nationwide network of local florists. 
* Indulge in Cheryl's Cookies decadent treats, like our famous buttercream-frosted cookies and fudgy brownies. 
* Savor Wolferman's delectable baked goods, from mouthwatering muffins to tantalizing pastries. 
* Create unique and charming gifts from Personalization Mall that add that extra touch of warmth and customization. 
* Delight in 1-800-Baskets's beautiful gift baskets, perfect for celebrating any occasion with a variety of gourmet treats and indulgent surprises. 
* Indulge in our signature chocolate-dipped treats from Shari's Berries, creating sweet moments with every bite. 
* Relish The Popcorn Factory's irresistible popcorn flavors, perfect for gifting or snacking. 
* Enjoy the freshest, wild-caught seafood from Vital Choice, offering premium fish and shellfish directly to your door. 
Want free shipping? Become a Celebrations Passport member! A Celebrations Passport membership, available for $29.99 - often on sale for as low as $19.99 - unlocks exclusive benefits such as free shipping/no service charge. You'll also receive access to member-only sales and content, along with curated gift collections for life's special occasions. 
Even if you're not ready to join, you can still enjoy the app and explore offerings from our Family of Brands. 
Every Celebrations Passport delivery includes our 100% smile guarantee. Our caring and award-winning service team is ready to help you with your order and welcomes your feedback!

Daily Planner & Tasks is a simple and powerful daily planner designed to help you plan tasks, manage your to-do list, and stay focused throughout the day.
Create tasks for any date, organize your daily schedule, and track what’s done and what’s overdue. This app works as a clean task manager for work, personal life, and daily routines — without clutter or distractions.

Everything syncs securely with iCloud, so your tasks stay available across all your Apple devices.
Key features:
• Daily planner and task manager
• To-do lists for any date
• Multiple reminders per task
• Simple habit-friendly workflow
• Optional daily notes and visual pages
• iCloud sync
• No ads, no noise
If you’re looking for a focused daily planner, a reliable to-do list, and a clean task management app, this is built exactly for that.

Make friends worldwide, chat with real people, and discover meaningful pen pal connections.
Bottled is a modern twist on the classic message in a bottle. Write a message, send it out to sea, and let serendipity connect you with someone, so
bluejetty:00120964:ios.description:
Make friends worldwide, chat with real people, and discover meaningful pen pal connections.
Bottled is a modern twist on the classic message in a bottle. Write a message, send it out to sea, and let serendipity connect you with someone, somewhere in the world.
Whether you’re looking for new friends, a pen pal, emotional support, or just a meaningful conversation, Bottled helps you meet real people through chance, curiosity, and conversation.
HOW BOTTLED WORKS
Write a message and put it in a bottle
Throw it into the sea and let it drift to a random person anywhere in the world
If they keep your bottle, you match and can start chatting
If they release it, your bottle sails away to someone else
Every bottle can lead to a unique connection
WHY PEOPLE LOVE BOTTLED
Make friends and meet pen pals from around the world
Chat at your own pace, without pressure
Send text, photo, and voice messages
Follow your bottles’ journeys in real time
Play Spin the Bottle with fun questions and challenges
Discover supportive, meaningful conversations with new people
Join over 5 million users in a positive social app designed to help you meet new people and have genuine conversations.
Chat without expectations.
Talk freely.
Let chance create real connections.
If you have any questions or just want to say hi, feel free to contact us on Instagram (@appbottled) or by email at contact@bottledapp.com
Bottled is free to download and use, and all main features are available for free.
If you’d like to meet even more people, faster, you can subscribe and become a Cruise Member.
We offer weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly subscription options.
Terms of Use: https://bottledapp.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://bottledapp.com/privacy

bluejetty:00146934:ios.summary:
Track your workouts. See your progress. Know what to do next.
FitNotes makes it easy to log strength training and cardio, organize your routines, and follow your progress over time. Whether you're starting your first routine or refining an
bluejetty:00146934:ios.description:
Track your workouts. See your progress. Know what to do next.
FitNotes makes it easy to log strength training and cardio, organize your routines, and follow your progress over time. Whether you're starting your first routine or refining an established training plan, keep your workouts and results together in one place.
TRAIN YOUR WAY
Create routines that span multiple days, organize exercises into supersets, and build workouts of the day for CrossFit-style training. Set progression rules to adjust your targets for future workouts as you progress.
LOG THE DETAILS THAT MATTER
Record sets, reps, weight, time, and distance. Track warm-up sets, add notes, and use rest timers to stay focused between sets. Review previous sessions when planning your next workout.
SEE WHAT YOU ACHIEVED
Finish each workout with a summary of new personal records, goal progress, and training volume compared with your previous session. Get suggestions for next time that take your progression rules into account.
FOLLOW YOUR PROGRESS
Explore your training history with charts and a workout calendar. Set exercise goals and track body measurements over time, without needing to enter a measurement every session.
KEEP YOUR TRAINING ORGANIZED
Customize exercises, equipment, and categories to match the way you train. Export workout logs as CSV, import compatible CSV files, and create backups of your FitNotes data.
From your first set to your next personal best, FitNotes helps you keep track of the work you put in.
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00066229:ios.description:
Discover! Create! Survive!
Your home is an endless ocean. Your neighbors are ruthless sharks, dangerous sea creatures, and relentless forces of nature. Your only refuge is a raft. Upgrade it, craft everything you need, escape the dangers of the ocean, and survive at all costs!
Why you'll love our raft survival game:
Realistic survival simulator
Monitor your health, thirst, and hunger. Defend yourself from shark attacks, overcome countless challenges, and do everything you can to stay alive. Your fate is in your hands!
Gather resources
Use your hook to collect drifting resources such as debris, barrels, and chests. Every item can help you on your journey.
Build and upgrade your raft
Expand your floating home, strengthen its defenses, and transform a small raft into a safe survival base.
Hundreds of crafting recipes
Catch fish, cook meals, collect fresh water, and craft weapons, armor, tools, building materials, storage, and everything else you need to survive.
Uncover the mystery of the endless ocean
What happened to this post-apocalyptic world? Why are the last survivors stranded at sea? Complete quests and discover the secrets hidden beyond the horizon.
Find out more:
SURVIVAL EXPERIENCE CLOSE TO REAL LIFE
Raft Survival is a 3D survival game that delivers an immersive and realistic gameplay experience. Test your survival skills as you explore the open ocean, craft essential tools, and fight to stay alive.
YOUR LIFE IS IN YOUR HANDS
Craft powerful weapons and useful equipment to face every danger. Search abandoned shipwrecks for valuable resources, upgrade your raft, and defend yourself against deadly sharks that never stop hunting you.
Key Features:
• Beautiful 3D graphics
• Realistic survival base-building experience
• Challenging gameplay
• Deep crafting system
• Dangerous ocean exploration
Join our community on social media to discuss upcoming updates and share your ideas for improving the game!
Take screenshots, record videos, and share your survival achievements with players from around the world!
SUBSCRIPTION
Subscribe now to get:
1. 6 simultaneous production processes
2. Food and water consumption reduced by 30%
3. No ads (only bonuses for the video)
4. 50 coins every day
5. Sandbox mode available at once
Premium subscription details:
- Start with a free three-day trial. When the trial ends, a paid weekly subscription will begin automatically.
- Subscriptions are available in weekly, monthly, and annual plans.
- A weekly subscription costs $11.99, a monthly subscription costs $19.99, and an annual subscription costs $59.99.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel your subscription or free trial at any time. To prevent automatic renewal, cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
- You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
- Read our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
https://survivalgamesstudio.com/privacy.html
https://survivalgamesstudio.com/terms_of_use.html

bluejetty:00186436:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00186436:ios.description:
Guide Miffy through her day. Help her explore, create and play, making art and reading books with her friends and family.
Based on the Dick Bruna inspired Nick Jr. hit series. Join Miffy as she plays and learns about her world in this gentle and beautiful 3D interactive app from StoryToys: 
• Start the day with a bath and brush Miffy’s teeth
• Help her choose which clothes to dress in
• Exploring the outside world. Have fun in the family garden
• Play with Snuffy the adorable dog or feed her pet fish
• Play with her toys. Scoot around the house, fly her kite around the garden or with blocks in the living room
• Help Miffy as she grows her very own fruit and vegetables, then bake a yummy cake
• When Miffy gets sleepy, just tuck her into bed 
• Fly through the clouds and collect stars in her dreams
Every day brings surprises and new things to discover. The more you play with Miffy the more fun activities you unlock. Miffy’s World is full gentle learning as it stimulates curiosity and creativity through fun educational activities. Learn by doing, as you help Miffy takes care of her daily routine, cooks delicious cakes and looks after her pets.
EDUCATIONAL DEVELOPMENT:
Miffy’s World benefits children’s abilities in multiple ways:
1) Health Knowledge and Practice:
– Tucking Miffy into bed shows children how vital sleep is for wellbeing 
– Children practice daily tasks such as brushing teeth and dressing independently from adults
2) Approaches to Learning:
– Helping Miffy complete daily tasks encourages initiative
– Growing fruit and vegetables and baking a cake with Miffy develops attentiveness and curiosity
3) Logic and Reasoning: 
– Engaging children in simple pretend play with familiar tasks; for example, tucking Miffy into bed
4) Physical Development:
– As children digitally learn with Miffy’s World they also develop fine motor skills
5) Creative Arts Expression:
– Color and Paint with Miffy. Encourage creativity and imagination

bluejetty:00159116:ios.description:
Elevate Your Apple Watch with Luxury Watch Faces!
Luxury Watch Faces transforms your Apple Watch into a personalized timepiece that exudes style and sophistication. Browse a huge gallery of luxury watch faces ranging from classic analog designs to modern digital displays. Whether you own the latest Apple Watch Ultra 2 or an earlier series, you’ll find the perfect face to match your mood, outfit, or occasion. 
Key Features:
Extensive Watch Face Collection: Choose from hundreds of watch faces – from timeless analog clocks inspired by luxury brands to cutting-edge animated live watch faces. New designs are added every week to keep your watch fresh and on-trend.
Wallpapers & Widgets: Not just faces! Personalize your experience with matching Apple Watch wallpapers and handy widgets. Deck out your devices with coordinated backgrounds and watch complications for a complete luxury theme.
Customization Made Easy: Tailor each watch face to your taste. Adjust colors, styles, and add complications (widgets) to display useful info. It’s easy to create a watch face that’s truly yours.
Free & Premium Designs: Enjoy a variety of free Apple Watch faces to get started, with the option to unlock exclusive premium designs. Everyone deserves a touch of luxury – many features are free, with more to explore in the premium collection.
Regular Updates: Receive weekly updates with new watch faces, wallpapers, and improvements. Stay ahead of the trends with seasonal themes, holiday specials, and designs inspired by iconic timepieces.
Seamless Setup: Compatible with Apple Watch Series 1 through Ultra 2. The app guides you through an easy setup – just download, sync, and apply new faces in seconds. No hassle, simply tap and enjoy your watch’s new look.
Why Choose Luxury Watch Faces?
Your Apple Watch deserves the best. Don’t settle for the default. Join thousands of users who’ve upgraded their wristwear with our app. Whether you’re a watch enthusiast or just love changing your style, Luxury Watch Faces Gallery offers an unparalleled selection and convenience. Turn heads with watch faces that look and feel like high-end luxury timepieces on your wrist. Download now and give your Apple Watch the luxury treatment it deserves. Customize your watch face today and shine with every raise of your wrist!

Price: Lifetime - $9.99, Monthly - $4.99
Cancellation

bluejetty:00177950:ios.name: Axis & Allies 1942 Online
bluejetty:00177950:ios.summary:
JOIN THE BATTLE!

*Note: Apple Account
bluejetty:00177950:ios.description:
JOIN THE BATTLE!
Play Axis & Allies 1942 Online on your iPad! It’s the official digital version of Hasbro’s classic board game, Axis & Allies 1942 Second Edition. Strategy is key as you command armies across the globe!
*Note: Apple Accounts held by users aged 12 and under will not be able to access our online multiplayer features.
Team up with friends across platforms, get competitive in ranked seasons, play solo against the A.I., or pass & play with a pal on one tablet!
FEATURES
Official Rules 
- Adapts rules from Hasbro’s Axis & Allies 1942 Second Edition
- Choose from two game scenarios & victory conditions!
- Allies: Command your forces as the United Kingdom, United States, or Soviet Union
- Axis: Take control of Germany or Japan’s armies & prepare for battle!
Learn to Play 
- Great for new players— no setup or cleanup required!
- Tutorials & In-Game Tooltips help beginners dive in
Turn-Based (Asynchronous) 
- Fully turn-based gameplay fits into your busy schedule! 
- Ranked games allow 24 hours to take your turn
- Instead of playing for hours on end, get notified when it’s your turn, then use the War Diary to check out what you missed! (or stick around & watch the battle unfold in real time— that’s an option too!)
Player Accounts & Profiles
- Track your stats & win/loss rates for each alliance
- Your commander account syncs across devices
- Switch seamlessly between iPad & desktop to take your turns, view your stats & connect with friends
Dice Modes
- Standard mode mimics random dice results
- Low Luck dice use averages to calculate hits
- Biased dice favor rolls of 2, 3, & 4, over 1 & 6
Immersive Gameplay
- High quality graphics, music & sound effects add drama to your battles!
GAME MODES
Single-Player
- Enjoy casual games with A.I. computer players
- Great for learning to play or testing out strategies
Hot Seat
- Pass the tablet around to play with friends & family
Online Multiplayer
- Cross-platform play between tablets & computers
- Create custom games for 2 to 5 players
- Games can include a mix of humans & A.I. players
Ranked Seasons
- Challenge the world’s top Axis & Allies players in official ranked seasons
- Rise through the ranks to take top honors: Wood, Bronze, Silver, Gold & Platinum Tiers!
- Matchmaking pairs you with similarly ranked players
SPRING 1942...THE WORLD IS AT WAR
German tanks mobilize in the west, blitzing into France and pushing back the Soviet Union in eastern Europe. The United States rises in response to Japanese aggression in the Pacific. The United Kingdom rallies allies as bombers menace the skies. The year is 1942, and the world is at war! 
Victory goes to the side that conquers its opponents on the field of battle and occupies the greatest cities of the world. Will the Axis continue to spread across the globe unchecked, or will the Allies rally to push back against imperialistic tyranny? Challenge your friends and change the course of history!

bluejetty:00151126:ios.description:
Would a hero like you assassinate the president of the United States to defend the right to be Powered?
As the corrupt President Victon launches his oppressive campaign of Powered Regulation, your Legendary heroic rise transforms into something much more: you must become a political icon fighting to restore Powered rights in America. This new battle takes a twisted turn when your once-greatest enemy, Prodigal, tells you President Victon’s darkest secret....
Now you are faced with the biggest choices of your career: Do you trust the word of your archenemy? Will you evade President Victon's gang of criminal bounty hunters? Can you save your family and complete your rise as a Legendary hero?
"Heroes Rise: HeroFall" completes the epic Heroes Rise trilogy by Zachary Sergi, featuring the smash hits "Heroes Rise: The Prodigy" and "Heroes Rise: The Hero Project," interactive novels where your choices control the story. The Heroes Rise trilogy is entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and driven by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination. 
All of your decisions lead to this epic conclusion, where you must truly define what you believe is right and what you stand for as a hero—and what (or whom) you’re willing to sacrifice for those ideals. Play as male or female, gay or straight, and decide how your story will end. How many alternate endings can you unlock?
How high will you rise?
