bluejetty:00061647:ios.name: Screen Recorder,Screen Capture
bluejetty:00061647:ios.summary: Screen Recorder, Screen Capture is the easy way to record your iPhone and iPad screen. Start a full-screen recording with a single tap and stop it just as fast. Capture gameplay, videos, apps, video calls, and anything else on your screen —
bluejetty:00061647:ios.description:
Screen Recorder, Screen Capture is the easy way to record your iPhone and iPad screen. Start a full-screen recording with a single tap and stop it just as fast. Capture gameplay, videos, apps, video calls, and anything else on your screen — with an accurate on-screen timer and a clean, friendly interface.
Whatever your device is doing, this app records it all — your games, videos, and favorite apps — in high quality, ready to edit and share. No ads.
RECORDING
• One tap to start a full-screen recording
• One tap to stop
• Unlimited recording length
• Accurate recording timer
• Choose your quality: 480p, 720p, 1080p, or Original (screen resolution)
• Choose your frame rate: 30 or 60 fps
• Add your microphone with a single toggle — turn mic sound ON or OFF
• Recordings are saved automatically with clear file names and sizes
BUILT-IN VIDEO EDITOR
• Trim your video to change its length
• Change speed — slow motion (0.25×, 0.5×) or fast (1.5×, 2×, 3×)
• Mute the audio
• Rotate the video
• Add text overlays and drag them anywhere on the video
ADD TEXT TO VIDEOS
• Choose from a range of built-in fonts
• Change the font size
• Change the text color
• Add an optional highlight (background) color behind your text
• Position text anywhere by dragging
EXPORT & VIDEO FORMATS
• Export in MP4, MOV, or M4V
• Choose the codec: H.264 (most compatible) or HEVC (smaller file)
• Choose the export resolution: Original, 4K (2160p), 1080p, 720p, or 480p
• Saves your finished video straight to your Photos library
LIBRARY & SHARING
• Your recordings and edited videos live in one place
• Play videos right inside the app
• Save to your Photos / Camera Roll
• Share to Messages, Mail, and almost any app via the iOS share sheet
MADE FOR IPHONE & IPAD
• Universal app for iPhone and iPad
• Quick Action from the Home Screen to jump straight to recording
• Siri & Shortcuts support to start recording hands-free
• Built-in Settings and Help
• See how much free storage you have left
• No ads
• Use your Apple Watch as a remote control to start screen recordings on your iPhone with a single tap.
Perfect for tutorials, gameplay, demos, reactions, presentations, and saving video calls.
—
Subscription pricing and terms:
Screen Recorder offers an auto-renewing subscription with the following options:
• All Access — 1 year
• All Access — 3 months
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial, where offered, is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://iapps.app/Privacy
Terms of Use: https://iapps.app/Terms

Features:
Brand Search: By searching for the brand you want in the search section, you can quickly find out whether it is boycotted or not.
Brand Suggestion: From the suggestion section, you can suggest the brands you want to be added to the application.
Trademark Objection: You can object to brands that you do not think should be boycotted in the objection section.
About: You can get information about the mission and team of the application and contact us from the About section.
Privacy: You can easily access our privacy policy and learn how your data is protected.
Review your shopping habits and become a more conscious consumer with Boycott Detective. For a fair and sustainable world, manage your shopping with ethical values.
NOTE: There may be missing items in the application, they will be added as soon as possible. Thank you for the support you provided us during this process.

bluejetty:00149229:ios.summary:

You work in the warehouse alongsid
bluejetty:00149229:ios.description:
The world is changing, but you still have to go to work.
Step into the satirical world of Boxbound, a story-driven endless puzzle game that blends simplistic puzzle gameplay with a captivating narrative.
You work in the warehouse alongside your stressed and overworked co-worker, Peter. Together, you tackle the endless stream of packages, solving day-to-day complications in the workplace while massive events unfold outside. Political upheaval, economic shifts, and a charismatic new leader changing the world — but within the warehouse, the grind never stops.
It's not just a puzzle game - you’re diving into an ever-evolving experience. The game offers 9223372036854775807 levels, ensuring endless gameplay that will keep your brain fit for a lifetime (or around four billion lifetimes, to be precise, if you spend one second on each level).
But it’s not just about sorting packages. Unexpected challenges and mini-games regularly disrupt your routine, forcing you to adapt and think creatively. Sweep up trash, work in the dark during power outages, or even drive the delivery truck from time to time. The surprises never stop, just like the work.
Features:
• Endless Puzzle Gameplay: Dive into an infinite supply of challenging levels designed to test your organizational skills and creativity.
• Dynamic Events: Encounter unpredictable scenarios that keep gameplay fresh and exciting.
• Compelling Storytelling: Experience a twisting, satirical tale of ordinary work-life amidst extraordinary world events.
• Competitive Leaderboards: Prove your skills by climbing the ranks and showing off your efficiency.
• Relaxing Yet Intriguing Atmosphere: Enjoy a unique blend of soothing puzzle-solving and dark humor.
Get Boxbound today to immerse yourself in a one-of-a-kind puzzle experience. Whether you’re chasing the top spot on the leaderboard or just looking to unwind, Boxbound will keep you coming back for more.

bluejetty:00161600:ios.description:
Introducing App Lock - the ultimate iPhone app manager and privacy protection tool.
Take complete control over your app usage and ensure your privacy remains intact with App Locker. This powerful app provides a comprehensive suite of features designed to keep your personal information secure and your app activities private.
With App Locker, you can conveniently manage and protect your apps with advanced locking mechanisms. Set specific time restrictions, implement password protection or fingerprint authentication, and enjoy the assurance that your apps are inaccessible to unauthorized individuals. App Locker gives you the power to define when and how your apps can be accessed, allowing you to maintain focus and manage your screen time effectively.
App Locker goes the extra mile to protect your apps from unwanted removal. The app uninstall prevention feature ensures that no app can be uninstalled without your explicit permission. This added layer of security safeguards your apps from being accidentally or maliciously removed, giving you peace of mind.
Account and password management is made simple and secure with App Locker. Safely store and manage your important accounts and passwords within the app, knowing that they are shielded from unauthorized changes and access. Your valuable credentials remain protected, allowing you to navigate the digital landscape with confidence.
App Locker also empowers you to take control of in-app purchases. By denying in-app purchases, the app prevents accidental or unauthorized transactions that could lead to unexpected expenses. This feature not only protects your finances but also ensures responsible app usage.
Experience the ultimate app management and privacy protection solution with App Locker. Download now to enjoy the benefits of enhanced privacy, secure app management, and peace of mind.

bluejetty:00187518:ios.summary: LandGlide® is the original parcel data app, trusted by professionals and property seekers since 2015. With access to 160 million parcel records across 3,229 counties, covering more than 99% of the U.S., it's the most comprehensive land and
bluejetty:00187518:ios.description:
LandGlide® is the original parcel data app, trusted by professionals and property seekers since 2015. With access to 160 million parcel records across 3,229 counties, covering more than 99% of the U.S., it's the most comprehensive land and property data tool available on mobile.
Wherever your work takes you, LandGlide gives you instant access to the property data you need. Use live GPS to pinpoint your exact location, confirm property boundaries in real time, and search any property by owner name, address, or parcel number. Hover over any property to instantly view key details, save your favorite locations, add notes, upload photos, and export data with ease.
With one subscription covering all 50 states, you get full nationwide access to parcel data wherever your work takes you, so you're never without the data you need, no matter where you are. And with offline map downloads, you stay connected to parcel data even in remote areas with no signal.
With up to 100+ attributes per parcel, LandGlide goes beyond basic boundaries. Know the owner, understand the acreage before making an offer, review sales history, check zoning and land use, assess building details, and more — everything you need to make faster, more confident decisions.
Property Finder
• Search 160 million parcel records across the U.S. by owner name, address, or parcel ID
• Confirm property lines with live GPS in real time
• Access up to 100+ attributes per parcel including ownership history, sales records, building data and land use
• Download offline maps for reliable access in the field, even without signal
Property Data for Every Use
• One subscription covers all 50 states, no state-by-state limitations
• View ownership details, acreage, market value, sale price, transfer date, zoning, school district, elevation and more
• Save locations, add notes, upload photos and export data with ease
Built for Professionals
• Used by real estate agents, appraisers, surveyors, and land professionals across the U.S.
• Identify property owners and access contact details to prospect faster
• Make informed decisions with sales history, zoning, land use, and building data at your fingertips
• Access parcel data on the go, even offline in remote areas
LandGlide for Teams
• Corporate accounts available for teams of 2 or more
• Progressive discounts up to 50% off for larger organizations
• Equip your entire team with reliable parcel data under one account
• Scales with your business, from small teams to large enterprises
Get started with a free 7-day trial and access millions of parcel records across the nation at no cost. $9.99/month or $99.99/year thereafter.
View our terms of service at https://reportallusa.com/solutions/landglide/terms_of_service.html

Strategic insights and contextual intelligence from the World Economic Forum. Explore and monitor the issues and forces driving transformational change across economies, industries and systems.
FEATURES
- Learn about hundreds of topic areas, ranging from industries, regional and global issues, all driving change in today’s world
- Many topics are co-curated in partnership with experts from leading research institutions
- Browse articles, videos and reports, drawn from over 250 different sources for each topic
- View data visualisations of relevant trends
- Understand the strategic landscape by exploring connections between the topics
WHY STRATEGIC IQ?
The digital revolution has transformed our lives and continues to ensure that the volume of information we are exposed to grows daily. In fact, it has been estimated that 90% of all the data in the world has been generated over the last two years. This has led some commentators to coin the phrase "information overload" to reflect our collective inability to surface signals from the noise and focus on what is truly significant. In parallel, the Fourth Industrial Revolution is disrupting industries and economies at rapid pace, leading to further transformations, opportunities and risks to monitor than ever before.
Strategic Intelligence, from the World Economic Forum, addresses this challenge and enables leaders, decision-makers and global citizens to keep abreast of an increasingly fast-moving and interconnected world. We hope you like it!
CONTACT
If you have any questions or queries, please reach out to intelligence@weforum.org

Scan text from signs, menus, books, or documents and get instant translations, no typing needed.

Speak naturally and receive real-time voice translations for travel, work, or daily conversations.

Access meanings, pronunciation, and examples with the built-in dictionary. Improve vocabulary, understand usage and grammar, and build stronger communication skills
6) Text to Speech

bluejetty:00121540:ios.description:
Enjoy the new Seekers adventure in this hidden object games puzzle! Play mystery games, find items, search for clues, play wonderful puzzles! You and your sister Margaret have been hired by the British Library to play investigation games as consultants to sort out the catalog of mysterious and even dangerous books! You both are excited to play a game with hidden objects for iPad & iPhone and delve in and start looking for interesting detective games, books and manuscripts of the Library, but things quickly take a dark turn when Margaret is sucked into a mysterious dangerous book! Everything in this hidden object adventure games looks like she has been transferred to another Universe! Will you follow her inside the book to save her? It’s up to you to travel through new worlds of this adventure and go through search & find games and puzzles to save your sister. Do you have what it takes to stop an evil conqueror and survive the deadly arena in this point & click games adventure? 
· A MYSTERIOUS BOOK WILL OPEN NEW WORLDS!
While working as a volunteer consultant in the British Library, your sister Margaret finds a enigmatic book written by someone named Aspir. Suddenly, a magical glowing opens a portal and pulls her inside the book! Will you dare start new hidden object games for iPad & iPhone quest and follow her there, and explore three magnificent world?
· LEARN MORE ABOUT THE WORLDS OF ORDER AND CHAOS!
Find out who’s terrorizing the World of Chaos and the World of Order! Solve challenging games, puzzles and riddles, find the hidden objects and play point & click games in every location of the World of Chaos, Order and Arena, enjoy interesting plot twists and chase Aspir! Will you be able to help the residents of several worlds from Aspir’s tyranny?
· FIND HIDDEN COLLECTIBLES TO UNCOVER MORE ABOUT THE GAME WORLD!
Enjoy playing adventure games, solve puzzles and riddles and look for collectible collections. Will you find all the pages from Aspir’s diary to learn everything about the tyrant’s childhood? How about finding all the morphing objects and special currency for your room?
· PLAY EASILY USING THE HANDY STRATEGY GUIDE!
Stuck while playing hidden object adventure games and solving mysterious riddles? Use the accessible and handy Strategy Guide that will always hint you on what to do next, where to find objects and how to solve a puzzle

bluejetty:00070160:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00070160:ios.description:
Four cells. Fifty-two cards. No luck involved.
Free Cell is the solitaire for people who want to think. There is no hidden deck and no shuffle that decides your fate: every card is face up from the start, and almost every deal can be won if you play it right.
HOW IT WORKS
Build four foundation piles from Ace to King, one per suit. The four cells in the corner are temporary parking for cards you need out of the way. The cleaner you plan, the faster it falls apart in your favour.
WHY IT PLAYS BETTER HERE
- Supermove: drag a whole ordered run at once instead of card by card
- Magnetic card movement, so pieces land where you meant them to
- Drag and drop or tap to move, whichever you prefer
- Unlimited undo: change your mind as often as you like
- Big, high-contrast cards that stay readable through a long session
- A clean table with nothing flashing at the edges
STRATEGY, NOT SHUFFLING
Unlike Klondike, nothing here is hidden. If you lose, it was your plan. That is the appeal: look at every card, think three moves ahead, and use those four cells sparingly. Filling all four is usually how a deal dies.
DIFFICULTY THAT MEANS SOMETHING
Several levels, from deals that almost solve themselves to boards that genuinely need a plan before you touch a card.
PLAYS FULLY OFFLINE
No connection needed. On a plane, on the train, in a waiting room or anywhere the signal drops. Battery-friendly for long sessions.
BUILT FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
Portrait or landscape, phone or tablet. Customisable backgrounds and card designs. Score tracking on every completed deal.
Free to download and play. An optional Remove Ads upgrade is available for $0.99 if you want to play without interruptions.
Deal. Plan. Solve.

bluejetty:00089405:ios.summary:

YOUR INDIVIDUAL ROUTINE

bluejetty:00089405:ios.description:
YOUR ROUTINE SCORE
The Routine Score is an indicator that shows you how consistently you exercise. It evaluates your training consistency and helps you to build up a sustainable workout routine.
YOUR INDIVIDUAL ROUTINE
Create and schedule your own workout routine from a variety of sports.
Activate reminders and never miss a workout.
MOTIVATING GOALS
Set yourself motivating goals and improve step by step.
AUTOMATIC TRACKING
Use your data from Apple Health for automatic tracking.
TRACK OVER 80 SPORTS
Whether running, cycling or strength training - track all your sports!
Features:
YOUR ROUTINE SCORE
The Routine Score is an indicator that shows you how consistently you exercise. It evaluates your training consistency and helps you to build up a sustainable workout routine.
The score is between 0% and 100%. A high score (> 75%) means that you perform your sports activities very consistently over a longer period. It does not evaluate how long or intensely you exercise.
YOUR INDIVIDUAL ROUTINE
Create your own workout routine from over 80 types of sport. Decide on which days you want to exercise and the duration of your workouts.
Based on your settings, you will receive a daily overview of your upcoming training sessions. Activate the reminders so that you never miss a workout.
AUTOMATIC TRACKING
Habiz allows you to track your sports automatically via Apple Health without having to enter data manually. For example, if you use an Apple Watch to track sports activities, these workouts are automatically displayed in the app. 
You can also use other training and fitness apps. All you need to do is activate Apple Health synchronization.
TRACK OVER 80 SPORTS
You can track over 80 different sports in Habiz or create custom types. Whether it's running, cycling, strength training, swimming or soccer - you're sure to find your sport here!
HISTORY OF YOUR ACTIVITIES
The history of the last 12 months gives you a good overview of your training success. You can see at a glance how active you were in the respective month. Key figures such as the number of activities, training duration, average weekly activities and average training duration per week show you whether you are on the right track.
PROGRESS ALWAYS IN VIEW
Charts show you your progress in terms of duration and number of activities at a glance. If you have set yourself a goal, you can see directly where you currently stand. Choose between weekly and monthly views.
SET YOURSELF GOALS
Goals are a good way of staying motivated in the long term and constantly improving.
Choose whether you want a specific duration or number of activities as a goal. Also decide whether you want to achieve your goal every day, every week or every month. 
For example, the WHO recommends that adults aged 18 and over should be moderately physically active for at least 2.5 hours per week. Set yourself this as a goal!
Please note our data privacy regulations at https://habiz.app/privacy-policy-app.
Apple's Terms of Use apply, which you can find at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/.

bluejetty:00014521:ios.summary: Okta Verify is a lightweight app that is used for 2-step verification so you can confirm your identity when you sign in to your Okta account. This gives you an extra layer of security so that you - and only you - can access your application
bluejetty:00014521:ios.description:
Okta Verify is a lightweight app that is used for 2-step verification so you can confirm your identity when you sign in to your Okta account. This gives you an extra layer of security so that you - and only you - can access your applications.
When you sign in to Okta, you can use Okta Verify to obtain a temporary 6-digit code or to approve a request notification sent to your device (your organization must enable notifications to use this feature).
Okta values your privacy. Okta Verify does not store personal information - we request permission only for your device camera, which is used to scan a QR code to register your device with Okta.
App Features
* Enroll in Okta Verify as a new user by registering your mobile device with your Okta account.
* Add one or more Okta accounts that require Okta Verify for authentication.
* Manage 2-factor authentication for non-Okta applications and web services that require the use of passcodes.
* Approve or deny sign-in requests on your device from a push notification (if enabled).
For more information, check out our docs at:
https://help.okta.com/en/prod/okta_help_CSH.htm#ext_okta_verify

bluejetty:00062665:ios.name: Script Rehearser
bluejetty:00062665:ios.summary: Hit the ground running. Save yourself hours and turn up knowing your lines. Whether it’s a stage script, screenplay, speech or presentation, you can rehearse and memorize on the go in an effective and convenient way. There’s no need to asse
bluejetty:00062665:ios.description:
Hit the ground running. Save yourself hours and turn up knowing your lines. Whether it’s a stage script, screenplay, speech or presentation, you can rehearse and memorize on the go in an effective and convenient way. There’s no need to assemble the rest of the cast, or have a rehearsal partner or reader.
Actors, TV personalities, business people, public speakers and students - learn your material more effectively with Script Rehearser. You can even practice English language conversation.
You can just start recording your own voice straight away. Or you can import your theater or movie script* or simply type in your lines. Script Rehearser will read them back to you whenever you want using its customizable options to prompt you. Optimize how you rehearse as you progress.
Features include:
 • Record your own voice directly into the app, and have it automatically transcribed †
 • Use digital voices for the other characters †
 • Import a script from a PDF file ‡
 • Import a script you've created on your PC or Mac, or just type it into your device
 • Customize scripts with your own notes and stage directions
 • Clearly distinguish your lines from others
 • Show your lines; hide you lines; show the first letter of each word
 • Play the whole script, or skip forward to your next cue
 • Play other parts while you self-tape
 • Share the recorded script †
 • Choose light or dark color mode
 • Designed for phones and tablets
Script Rehearser can be configured to support your personal learning style. For example:
 • Listen Along: Script Rehearser speaks, you listen. You can play, pause, and jump forward to your next line or back to your previous one.
 • Wait For Me: Script Rehearser pauses for each of your lines until you’re ready to continue
 • Repeat for Confirmation: Script Rehearser leaves a gap for you to say the line, then automatically speaks the line for confirmation and carries on
 • Run Through: Script Rehearser leaves a gap for you to say your line, then automatically carries on with the next line
† Pro Features
To enable us to continue developing the app, the following are Pro features:
 • Recording your own voice
 • Choosing which digital voice to use for each character
 • Exporting a script
There’s a 30-day free trial of Pro features, with no sign-up required and no automatic conversion to a paid subscription. After this you can keep using everything you’ve done, even if you don’t subscribe. 
Keep in contact: 
 • For news and updates follow us on Twitter: @ScriptRehearser
 • Find us on Facebook: www.facebook.com/ScriptRehearser
 • Join us on our forum: www.ScriptRehearser.com
‡ Note that for a PDF file to import it must contain the text of the script, not just pictures of the text. Some PDFs contain scanned images of the text rather than the text itself, and the app can't import these files as it needs the actual text to work with.
Terms of use can be found at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00146907:ios.description:
Green 19 app replaces the conventional cardboard scorecard and lets golf tournament participants keep track of the tournament in real time. Each team records its score after each hole and is immediately notified of its ranking in the tournament. An aerial view of the current hole reveals any obstacles so that players can adjust their strategy. In addition, the GPS function indicates the distance between the team and the green, and a radar equipped with augmented reality identifies the green even when it’s hidden by obstacles. Participants can also snap pictures which are automatically shared with the other players.      
Event sponsors can also benefit from the app by adding their logos which are presented to users at just the right time. The spectator mode lets volunteers use the app, too, whether to check rankings or take photos.  Also, organizers have the option of using the Green 19 management platform to send messages to participants. 
A leaderboard is available in the tournament management system to present the rankings at the end of the day along with any photos taken by participants. 
Learn more about the app at https://green19.com

bluejetty:00091104:ios.name: Repo: Photo Recovery
bluejetty:00091104:ios.summary:
Deleted photos do not have to stay gone.
Repo looks after the albums you choose, on this iPhone. When a photo under that care leaves your library, scan for it and bring it back. It returns with the date it was taken, ready to sit in your l
bluejetty:00091104:ios.description:
Deleted photos do not have to stay gone.
Repo looks after the albums you choose, on this iPhone. When a photo under that care leaves your library, scan for it and bring it back. It returns with the date it was taken, ready to sit in your library again.
Nothing leaves your device. There is no account to create for your photos, and no copy is sent anywhere.
Find what is missing
Open the Recover tab and scan. Photos that were in Repo's care and are no longer in your library show up together. Tap the ones you want, or restore the whole set. Premium places no limit on how many come back.
The scan is specific. It looks for photos Repo was already looking after, then shows you what the library no longer has. You review them before anything returns, so a restore is a choice, not a surprise.
You set the scope
Look after every album, or only the ones that matter. Change that choice whenever you like. Each time you open Repo, new photos inside the scope you picked are brought into the same care, without a button to press.
Videos and Live Photos in that scope are included. Storage used by this care is shown in the app, and you can clear it when you no longer want it.
Share with less attached
A photo often carries more than the picture. The place it was taken, the camera, the lens, and the time can sit inside the file, and they travel with it when you share.
Clean one photo for free. Repo shows those details, then prepares a copy with them removed, at the same quality. Share that copy when the picture is welcome and the extra details are not.
Premium goes further and removes location from every photo that still has one. Useful before you hand someone an album, post a set, or pass a phone to another person.
A quieter place for private photos
Some photos do not belong in the camera roll. The vault is unlocked with Face ID or the device passcode. Move one photo there, or select several. They leave your library and stay inside Repo.
You can bring vault photos back to the library later, or delete them from the vault for good. App Lock can sit in front of the vault so opening Repo is not enough to see them.
Saved logins stay with the app as well, locked the same way, if you want account details kept beside the photos rather than in a note.
Free
• Care for the albums you select, refreshed whenever you open Repo
• Clean one photo and share it without its location, camera, or timestamp
• Choose which albums are included, including video and Live Photos
Premium
• Scan for deleted photos and restore them, with no limit on how many
• Remove location from every photo that still has one
• A Face ID vault for private photos, with several selected at once
Good to know
A photo can come back when it was already in Repo's care before it left your library. A photo deleted before you installed Repo cannot be brought back, and Repo cannot open Recently Deleted.
Restored photos keep the date they were taken. Cleaning a photo retires the older protected version of that same photo, so a location you removed is not kept. Photos you place in the vault stay in the app. iOS may still keep its own copy in Recently Deleted until you empty that album yourself.

Privacy Policy: https://www.privacypolicies.com/live/3a736f6a-2624-4ecd-b128-bfc7f45ec7d2
Support: reporecoverdeletedphotos@gmail.com

* Secured file transactions

* Preview your document before/after sending a fax

With Examplify from ExamSoft, assessments can be delivered to students securely via iPad, without the concern of exam takers accessing other apps or the Internet during the exam. ● Restricted access to other applications
● Activity tracking throughout the exam
● Zoom in/out on attached multimedia 
● Answer choice elimination
● Customizable mid-exam alarms
● Question filtering and flagging
● Basic and scientific calculator options
This application is free to download. Students who attend schools/universities who have licensed the use of ExamSoft, with iPad accessibility enabled, may use the application.

apple-macos:6835344822.name: ElmScanner
apple-macos:6835344822.summary: Download ElmScanner by Grant Jun Otsuki on the App Store. See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips, and more apps like ElmScanner.
apple-macos:6835344822.description:
ElmScanner turns the barcode on the back of a book into a citation-ready record. Hold the book up to your camera, and the title, author, publisher, year and more are filled in for you. When you're done, export the whole list for your reference manager.
SCAN OR TYPE
• Point the camera at an ISBN barcode in any orientation. On iPhone it starts on the back camera, with a button to switch; on the Mac you can choose among connected cameras. A green check confirms a book was recognized; a red X means the barcode wasn't a book.
• Or type an ISBN by hand.
• Scan a book twice and ElmScanner won't add it again. It scrolls to the one you already have.
• Books you've looked up before are remembered on your device, so scanning them again works without an internet connection.
REVIEW AND EDIT
• See exactly what will be exported for every book, with missing details flagged.
• Tap (iPhone) or double-click (Mac) any book to correct or complete it.
• Book details come from Open Library (a project of the Internet Archive) and from the national libraries of Japan (NDL Search), Germany (Deutsche Nationalbibliothek), France (Bibliothèque nationale de France) and Spain (Biblioteca Nacional de España) for books in those languages.
EXPORT TO MANY FORMATS
• RIS, BibTeX, Excel (.xlsx) and CSV first, then BibLaTeX, CSL JSON, MODS, MARC, MARCXML, EndNote XML, RefWorks, Web of Science, Refer/BibIX, Zotero RDF, Bibliontology RDF, Dublin Core RDF and XML ContextObject.
• These are formats that reference managers such as Zotero can import.
• Keep one running Excel list: choose an Excel or CSV file you exported earlier and the new books are added to the end (books already in it are skipped).
• On iPhone, save to the Files app or send the file by email as an attachment.
NEVER LOSE YOUR LIST (iPHONE)
• Books you've scanned but not yet exported are kept safely, even if the app closes unexpectedly.
• One tap clears the list when you want a fresh start.
EARN RANKS
• As you scan more different books, you reach new ranks, from Beginner up to Little Bookstore on the Corner, with a little celebration.
A FRIENDLY LITTLE EXTRA
• Smile at the camera and ElmScanner says hello. It's all on your device; nothing about a face is saved or sent.
ENGLISH AND JAPANESE
• Fully localized in English and Japanese, including Japanese book lookups.
FREE AND OPEN SOURCE
• The source code is available under the MIT license.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking.
• The camera image never leaves your device (smile detection runs on the device too). Only a book's ISBN goes to Open Library or, for Japanese, German, French and Spanish books, the national library of that country, to look up its details; your email address (which Open Library asks every app to send) goes to Open Library only.
ElmScanner works with Zotero's import formats but is not made by or endorsed by Zotero.
